title: Lead Go Language Developer
description:
We're seeking an experienced Lead Go Language Developer to architect and grow scalable backend systems, enhance automated testing practices, and ensure dependable service operations. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams, weigh in on architectural choices, and help elevate overall engineering quality — join us and leave your mark.

Responsibilities

  • Interact directly with customers, addressing their inquiries and needs promptly
  • Build and sustain testing frameworks that support both unit-level and automated test coverage
  • Architect, build, and maintain backend services capable of handling scale and delivering strong performance
  • Coordinate with teams throughout the organization to consider broader implications beyond pure technical execution
  • Take part in code review processes to uphold quality standards and spread knowledge among team members
  • Take responsibility for developing or evaluating technical design documents and proof-of-concept work
  • Champion strong engineering practices and advocate for raising the bar on technical standards
  • Foster a mindset centered on operational reliability through diligent testing, system monitoring, thorough documentation, and active on-call participation supporting service health

Requirements

  • 5+ years of direct, applicable experience building applications using Go
  • A minimum of one year spent guiding and overseeing development teams
  • Considerable background architecting, deploying, and sustaining cloud-hosted web services and microservices, with AWS experience considered a plus
  • Hands-on experience using SQL and relational database systems, particularly PostgreSQL, for storing, querying, and managing data
  • Meticulous and self-driven, with genuine enthusiasm for code excellence, sound engineering methods, continuous delivery, and automated testing
  • Comfortable operating as a versatile, multi-language developer, adjusting to whatever tools and technologies best suit a given task
  • Capable of interacting with customers directly and resolving their requests independently, without needing oversight
  • Strong communication capabilities with English fluency at B2 level or above, sufficient to interpret business needs and shape them into technical designs

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with gRPC for enabling fast, efficient communication between services
  • Knowledge of Protobuf for organizing and serializing data shared across services
  • Understanding of GraphQL for crafting adaptable, efficient API designs

  • International projects with top brands

title: Cyber Security Trainee
description:
Cyber Security Placement Programme - No Experience Required Are you looking to benefit from a new career in IT and Cybersecurity? Skills shortages in the IT sector are driving the need for qualified, entry-level career seekers and career changers.

The best part is you will not need any previous experience as fully accredited training, which includes tutor support and mentoring, provides you with the skills, practical knowledge and qualifications for you to secure a professional job and career in IT. You will also have the reassurance of a job guarantee (30K-£35K) upon completion.

Whether you are working full time, part time or are unemployed, this package has the flexibility to be completed at a pace that suits you and can be completed in a few weeks or a few months (step 1 to 4 below). Your job and career goals are completed in 4 easy steps.

Step 1 - Accredited Online Training

The first step is completing a selection of professional, accredited and industry recognised courses from CompTIA which is the global leader in IT Technician, Networking and Cybersecurity training. The training is delivered via multimedia rich video tutorials, practice labs, presentations and quizzes through a portal that you study from home. You will also be assigned an expert tutor and a support mentor to help you throughout your training.

Step 2 - Practical Training

You will gain practical experience by using practice labs which enable you to practice and master what you have learned. Gaining practical hands-on experience gives you confidence to be proficient in your first IT role. This combination of theoretical and practical skills is what line managers need you to have to be effective and confident in your role.

Step 3 - Official exams

You will then go on to sit the CompTIA A+ and the CompTIA Network+ exams to give you the official certifications which will be recognised not only in the UK, but worldwide. The CompTIA A+ is the most asked for certificate for entry-level IT roles

and the certification most IT Managers start their own careers with. All PCs in a professional environment are networked to servers, cloud based or otherwise and the Network+ gives you a needed foundation level of knowledge in networking.

Step 4 - IT Technician placement (£30-£35K)

We work with you to secure your first role as an IT Technician, with a starting salary of anywhere between £30K-35K. Ideally you will need to gain two years’ experience in this role before you can progress into a cyber security role. While working as an IT Technician, we will release your second batch of training which is specifically designed to qualify you to move into the cybersecurity field. This official, accredited training consists of online training, practical training and an official exam (CompTIA Security+). Further we can tailor the package to include courses like the Certified Ethical Hacker and Certified Network Defender depending on your requirements and future direction.

Cybersecurity Role

Once you have completed all the mandatory training in step four and have gained two plus years experience in the IT industry, you will be ready to move into higher paying Cybersecurity roles. Our recruitment support team specialises in the IT and Cybersecurity space and roles at this level have an average starting salary of £35K.

We have been helping career changers and new career seekers gain new careers since 2009 and we are a CompTIA Gold Partner, accredited by the BCS (Chartered Institute of IT/ British Computer Society) and the EC-Council to ensure we provide the highest levels of training.

In addition, we are also ELCAS approved to help members of the Armed Forces, Service Leavers and Veterans gain rewarding careers in IT and Cybersecurity.

Job Guarantee

Due to the success of this programme and the skills shortage of entry-level IT staff, we can guarantee you will secure a job upon completion of your study programme or we will refund you 100% of your course fees back. This is subject to our terms of learning/ terms of business.

Passionate about starting a career in IT? Apply now and one of our friendly advisors will be in touch.

title: Senior Fullstack Developer
description:
We're aiming to bring a Senior Fullstack Developer onto our expanding team. This position connects high-level business priorities with hands-on technical implementation across a widely distributed, multi-department organization. You'll infuse structured engineering rigor into fluid, still-forming problems, all while contributing to how the organization adopts and integrates new technology. It's an opportunity to make a real difference in how enterprise systems scale and connect.

Responsibilities

  • Work hand-in-hand with product owners and stakeholders across IT, Sales, Finance, and HR, coordinating schedules to support live, direct collaboration
  • Convert vaguely defined internal use cases into robust architecture designs, UX/flow diagrams, API contracts, and a development-ready backlog for the team in India
  • Develop and interconnect agentic workflows spanning enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Jira, Glean, and Oracle HCM
  • Take charge of demanding integration projects, covering authentication setup, MCP tool access, data contract design, RBAC configuration, error handling, and production launch
  • Sync up daily with the India-based team to resolve outstanding questions, review pull requests, eliminate integration hurdles, and maintain quality standards ahead of release
  • Build out prototypes when needed, spanning UI components, agent flow design, or MCP/LLM integration work, then deliver a production-ready backlog to the India team
  • Incorporate security, observability, and reusability principles into every build so agents deliver lasting value rather than functioning as one-time demos

Requirements

  • Three-plus years of hands-on, relevant full-stack engineering experience, supported by a current and active delivery record
  • Strong expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript paired with a modern frontend framework such as React or an equivalent tool
  • Solid backend development background using Node.js or Python, combined with strong API and integration design capabilities
  • Established track record delivering AI/LLM-driven solutions, including tool calling, RAG, agent frameworks, MCP, prompt workflows, or similar practical delivery
  • Demonstrated ability to translate stakeholder workshop findings into functional architecture and a practical, actionable backlog
  • Hands-on AWS delivery experience covering Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, IAM, and CloudWatch, plus enterprise authentication approaches such as SSO/Okta and RBAC
  • Capable communicator who can lead technical discussions in English with US-based stakeholders, holding working fluency at B2 level or higher, converting business needs into agentic architecture

Nice to have

  • Understanding of MCP gateways, LLM gateways, model routing approaches, policy/audit tooling, and cost/usage monitoring systems
  • Background implementing OpenTelemetry or similar observability tools to monitor agent traces, tool call behavior, latency, and failure patterns
  • Practical exposure to platforms such as Salesforce, Gong, Clari, Glean, ServiceNow, Oracle HCM, Concur, or similar HR/IT tools
  • Experience transforming internal platforms or early prototypes into reliable, enterprise-grade production solutions

Benefits

  • International projects with top brands
  • Work with global teams of highly skilled, diverse peers
  • Healthcare benefits
  • Employee financial programs
  • Paid time off and sick leave
  • Upskilling, reskilling and certification courses
  • Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning library and 22,000+ courses
  • Global career opportunities
  • Volunteer and community involvement opportunities
  • EPAM Employee Groups
  • Award-winning culture recognized by Glassdoor, Newsweek and LinkedIn

title: Inżynier Mechanik - Konstruktor, Centrum Technologii Kosmicznych
description:
Sieć Badawcza Łukasiewicz – Instytut Lotnictwa należy do najnowocześniejszych placówek badawczych w Europie, o tradycjach sięgających 1926 roku. Instytut ściśle współpracuje ze światowymi potentatami przemysłu lotniczego, takimi jak: GE Aerospace, Boeing, ST Engineering (MRAS), Airbus, Pratt & Whitney, a także energetycznego: GE Vernova oraz Baker Hughes. Współdziała również z instytucjami z branży kosmicznej, w tym z Europejską Agencją Kosmiczną. Strategicznymi obszarami badawczymi Instytutu są technologie lotnicze, kosmiczne oraz bezzałogowe. Prowadzone są tutaj badania i usługi dla przemysłu krajowego oraz zagranicznego w zakresie technologii materiałowych i kompozytowych, przyrostowych, teledetekcyjnych, energetycznych i wydobywczych.


Centrum Technologii Kosmicznych prowadzi prace badawczo-rozwojowe w zakresie technologii rakietowych ze szczególnym naciskiem na napędy rakiet i satelitów. Dołącz do grona naszych ekspertów posiadających doświadczenie w europejskich programach kosmicznych.

Sieć Badawcza Łukasiewicz – Instytut Lotnictwa poszukuje Osoby/Osób na stanowisko:

Twój zakres obowiązków:

  • Tworzenie założeń i wymagań technicznych
  • Projektowanie 3D i wykonywanie dokumentacji 2D, rozwiązań technologicznych, oprzyrządowania
  • Dobór materiałów oraz technologii wytwarzania
  • Prowadzenie wspomagających projektowanie analiz numerycznych (MES, CFD)
  • Przygotowywanie dokumentacji technicznej
  • Nawiązywanie kontaktów i współpraca z podwykonawcami (sprawowanie nadzoru nad wykonywaniem elementów, demonstratorów)
  • Planowanie i realizacja badań opracowanych konstrukcji
  • Raportowanie postępów pracy

Nasze wymagania:

  • Realizacja prac konstrukcyjnych w ramach projektów B+R związanych z budową silników rakietowych i ich komponentów
  • Praktyczna znajomość zagadnień związanych z silnikami rakietowymi na stałe materiały pędne, w tym projektowanie komór spalania, dysz oraz układów inicjujących
  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu elementów narażonych na wysokie ciśnienie i temperaturę, w tym analiza ich trwałości i bezpieczeństwa
  • Umiejętność prowadzenia analiz numerycznych dla układów z materiałami pędnymi (np. CFD spalania, analiza termiczna, analiza wytrzymałościowa)
  • Doświadczenie w pracy w środowisku projektowym związanym z technologiami rakietowymi lub obronnymi
  • Wykształcenie wyższe inżynierskie w zakresie nauk technicznych
  • Minimum dwuletnie doświadczenie na stanowisku inżyniera konstruktora
  • Doświadczenie w pracy z oprogramowaniem CAD/CAE
  • Dobra znajomość rysunku technicznego w zakresie wymiarowania i tolerancji
  • Dobra znajomość j. angielskiego
  • Samodzielność i wysokie zaangażowanie
  • Dobra organizacja pracy, zorientowanie na cel i zacięcie inżynierskie
Mile widziane:
  • Doświadczenie w pracy z materiałami pędnymi heterogenicznymi i/lub homogenicznymi, oraz znajomość ich właściwości mechanicznych i termochemicznych
  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu i testowaniu silników rakietowych na stałe materiały pędne
  • Znajomość procedur bezpieczeństwa i standardów pracy z materiałami wybuchowymi i pędnymi (np. ATEX, MIL-STD, ECSS-E-ST-33)
  • Doświadczenie w integracji układów napędowych z systemami rakietowymi lub satelitarnymi
  • Udział w kampaniach testowych silników rakietowych, w tym przygotowanie stanowisk badawczych i analiza wyników testów
  • Znajomość procesów produkcji i obróbki materiałów kompozytowych stosowanych w silnikach rakietowych
  • Znajomość oprogramowania Siemens NX
  • Doświadczenie w pracach warsztatowych, szczególnie obróbka precyzyjna

Pracując z nami

otrzymujesz

  • Prywatna opieka medyczna
  • 100% wynagrodzenia chorobowego
  • Grupowe ubezpieczenie na życie
  • Bezpłatne ładowanie samochodów elektrycznych
  • Dofinansowanie do wypoczynku
  • Świadczenie świąteczne
  • Dofinansowanie do zakupu okularów
  • Pożyczki mieszkaniowe i zapomogi
  • Dopłata do III filaru
  • Nagrody za polecenia pracowników
  • Nagroda za staż pracy
  • Karta sportowa
  • Elastyczne godziny rozpoczęcia pracy
  • Kultura wspierająca różnorodność
  • Możliwość pracy hybrydowej
  • Owocowe środy

description:

title: Senior Data Quality Lead (Clinical / Pharma Data Experience)
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Manager (DM)
Location: Welwyn (hybrid)
Hourly Rate: £50.00 - £56.00 Per Hour Umbrella

Our client, a leading organisation in the healthcare sector, is seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Data Manager with relevant industry experience to join their innovative team. This role plays a pivotal part in ensuring the quality, integrity, and availability of clinical trial data, driving key decisions in drug development.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Independently manage end-to-end data management activities for one or more studies, from CRF and database design to final study closure.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners (Biostatistics, Data Science, Clinical) to define data specifications, ensuring alignment with study needs.
  • Oversee vendor performance and resolve complex data issues using industry best practises and risk-based monitoring.
  • Evaluate and refine study-level data processes, fostering an environment of continuous improvement in efficiency and data quality.
  • Share technical expertise with colleagues, enhancing team practises and documentation.

Your Experience Will Include:

  • Bring strong experience in clinical data management or a related function.
  • Have hands-on experience managing data for clinical trials, including CRF design and query resolution.
  • Possess a solid understanding of EDC systems and data standards (e.g., CDISC).
  • Demonstrate strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively coordinate with cross-functional teams.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Programming literacy in SAS, R, or Python for data review or visualisation.
  • Familiarity with early-phase data types or adaptive study designs.
  • Understanding of data flow across the clinical systems landscape (e.g., EDC to SDTM).

If you are passionate about leveraging your expertise in data management to contribute to groundbreaking healthcare solutions, this is the opportunity for you! Embrace the chance to make a difference and drive innovation in clinical trials.

Apply today and take the next step in your career!

title: Customer Fulfilment Specialist
description:
Customer Fulfilment Specialist

Location: Belfast

Salary: £26,500 (Negotiable)

Inclusion IQ are recruiting on behalf of a well established, fast-growing telecommunications provider operating across the UK and Ireland. They deliver business-critical connectivity, cloud communications to thousands of commercial clients. They deliver exceptional service and reliability. Due to continued growth, they are hiring a highly organised Customer Fulfilment Specialist to join their team in Belfast.

Role

As the Customer Fulfilment Specialist, you will be the central point of contact for taking customer solutions from signed contract through to full technical delivery. You'll sit at the heart of their operations coordinating between customers, internal teams, hardware vendors, networks, and engineering crews to deliver a seamless on boarding experience.

Responsibilities

  • Order Life cycle Management: Track and process customer orders from initial sale to completion, ensuring milestones are met accurately and on schedule.

  • Supplier & Network Coordination: Work directly with portal partners, network providers, and platform vendor tools to process orders, connections, and system upgrades.

  • Database & CRM Governance: Accurately update case notes, order statuses, and records within Salesforce and our internal line-of-business systems.

  • Engineering Dispatch: Schedule customer installation dates into engineering rotas, managing resource availability and field team communications.

  • Customer Journey Ownership: Keep clients informed at every stage of their deployment.

  • Cross-Department Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Accounts, and Support teams to maintain steady workflow and ensure accurate billing hand offs.

  • Issue Escalation: Identify potential delays early, escalating queries to vendor account managers or internal leadership as needed.

Criteria

  • At least 1 year of hands-on administrative, order-processing, or operational support experience.

  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: A high standard for accuracy when validating paperwork, handling data, and logging system notes.

  • Strong Communication Skills: Clear, professional telephone manner and written correspondence skills for both client and supplier interactions.

  • Time Management & Prioritisation: Ability to balance competing priorities, follow up on pending actions, and hit target turnarounds in an active environment.

  • Technical Aptitude: Confident using Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and comfortable picking up new CRM databases and software platforms quickly.

  • Educational Foundation: Minimum of 5 GCSEs (or equivalent) including English and Mathematics.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation:

  • Full Training & Development: Structured on boarding covering our technology stack, partner networks, and internal workflows.

  • Career Growth- Opportunities to build specialised skills in cloud communications and IT connectivity within an expanding business.

  • Collaborative team environment with direct access to management support.

title: Junior CRM Specialist
description:
We are looking for a motivated Junior CRM Specialist to join our team in Malta. This role is suited to someone at the beginning of their CRM career who wants to learn, develop and take on more responsibility over time. Some experience in CRM, digital marketing or the iGaming industry would be helpful, but it is not essential. We place greater value on a proactive attitude, attention to detail and a genuine willingness to progress. You will support customer communications across email, SMS, push notifications and pop-ups. Working with the wider CRM and marketing teams, you will help deliver relevant campaigns that improve customer engagement, retention and activity across products.

Responsibilities

  • Create, schedule and deliver CRM campaigns across email, SMS, push notifications and pop-ups.
  • Write and adapt clear customer communications in line with the company tone of voice.
  • Create and maintain CRM templates, procedures and campaign documentation.
  • Coordinate campaigns with all relevant stakeholders and keep deadlines, requirements and approvals on track.
  • Prepare campaign briefs and coordinate content, creative assets, offers and translations with the relevant teams.
  • Complete detailed quality checks before launch, including content, links, audience targeting, tracking and scheduling.
  • Request and analyse customer data to identify key segments and opportunities to improve targeting and personalisation.
  • Recommend practical improvements to campaign processes, customer journeys and CRM performance.
  • Support the development of a CRM program covering retail shops, online betting and cross-product activity.
  • Help develop engaging competitions, promotions and retention initiatives.
  • Monitor campaign results, prepare performance reports and contribute to post-campaign reviews.
  • Support A/B testing and other campaign optimisation activities.
  • Work closely with the Content, Design, Fraud and Data Warehouse teams to deliver accurate and compliant campaigns on time.
  • Maintain accurate campaign records and follow internal CRM and responsible gaming procedures.

Requirements

  • A genuine interest in CRM, customer engagement and digital marketing.
  • A proactive attitude and a strong desire to learn and progress.
  • Excellent attention to detail and good organisational skills.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Confidence working with data and basic performance metrics.

title: Cliëntbegeleider II | Kwadijkerpark 60 | Purmerend | 28 tot 32 uur
description:
Cliëntbegeleider II | Kwadijkerpark 60 | Purmerend| 28 tot 32 uur

Ben jij die Cliëntbegeleider met liefde voor ouderen en de gehandicaptenzorg? Met gevoel voor een warme leefomgeving? Sta je stevig in je schoenen en kun je veiligheid, duidelijkheid en structuur bieden? Beschik je over een creatieve werkhouding en een dosis humor? Dan is deze vacature iets voor jou!

Bij Prinsenstichting maak je deel uit van een organisatie met lef! Hier pakken we een uitdaging met beide handen aan!

Wat ga je doen?

Op Kwadijkerpark 60 wonen 9 cliënten; 4 mannen en 5 vrouwen. Deze cliënten zijn allemaal ouder dan 50 jaar en hebben een matige tot ernstige verstandelijke beperking. Naast de uitdagingen die het ouder worden met zich meebrengen, hebben alle cliënten in meer of minder mate gedragsproblemen en een lage sociaal-emotionele ontwikkelingsleeftijd.

Elke dag bewegen wij als begeleiders mee met de draagkracht van de cliënten, om zo goed mogelijk aan te sluiten bij hun behoeften en initiatieven. Waardoor de kans op over-/ondervraging en probleemgedrag afneemt. Wij bieden alle cliënten de mate van nabijheid die zij nodig hebben: ‘Ik ben er voor je als me nodig hebt.’

De cliënten van Kwadijkerpark 60 hebben allen een individueel dagprogramma. Een deel heeft dagbesteding buiten de deur, maar een steeds groter deel van de cliënten begint aan zijn/haar pensioen en heeft tegenwoordig deels ook dagbesteding op de woning. Hierdoor ben je als Cliëntbegeleider zowel verantwoordelijk voor wonen als dagbesteding. Jij zorgt voor de balans tussen inspanning/ontspanning, activiteit/rust en creëert een rustige sfeer.

Op dit moment zijn er op Kwadijkerpark 60 2 cliënten met een intensieve begeleidingsvraag. Zij worden begeleid vanuit Meerzorg.

Op de woning kan verbale en/of fysieke agressie voorkomen richting begeleiding of andere cliënten. Op deze momenten ben jij de belangrijkste factor om veiligheid en harmonie te bieden en blijf jij warme zorg verlenen.


Hoe pas je in het team?


Als Cliëntbegeleider ben je samen met het team verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse organisatie op de woning en voor de zorg en begeleiding van de cliënten. Daarbij weet je uitvoering en invulling te geven aan de individuele cliëntplannen. De meeste cliënten hebben een grote behoefte aan zekerheid en duidelijkheid. Jij als begeleider bent daarbij de belangrijkste factor. Je ondersteunt de cliënten daar waar nodig, ook ten aanzien van hun persoonlijke verzorging. Je hebt een passie voor het werken met onze doelgroep en de problematiek die het ouder worden met zich mee brengt. Je bent positief ingesteld, toont lef en maakt er elke dag het beste van!

Daarnaast is het belangrijk dat jij;

· Een afgeronde verwante opleiding hebt op mbo-niveau 3-4;

· Beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel professioneel als binnen de driehoek van zorg;

· In staat bent continuïteit en kwaliteit van zorg te waarborgen en te bewaken;

· Kan omgaan met agressie en adequaat kan handelen in moeilijke situaties;

· In staat bent om mee te draaien in een onregelmatig dienstpatroon met 6, 7 en 8 uurs diensten.

Wat bieden wij?
We zijn een lerende organisatie en geloven in de kracht van samenwerking. We hebben een veelzijdig aanbod aan vacatures en geven jou als professional de ruimte om je (nog) verder te ontwikkelen. Een loopbaan lang. Bovendien is er volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling (o.a. door scholing en toegang tot een breed aanbod aan veelzijdige e-learnings).

  • De arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn conform de CAO-Gehandicaptenzorg.

  • De functie is ingedeeld in FWG 40 (maximaal € 3.902,00 bruto per maand bij een fulltime arbeidsduur).

  • Een CAO-verhoging van 2% in de maand november;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling, vakantiegeld 8%, collectieve verzekeringen en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%;

  • 144 vakantie-uren en 57 uur balansverlof per kalenderjaar op basis van 36 uur;

  • Een onboardingsweek om je dienstverband goed van start te laten gaan.

Enthousiast?

Voor inlichtingen over deze functie neem je contact op met Sonia van Oostveen of Suzanne Wilmer tel: 0299 459 256 of per mail: S.van.Oostveen@prinsenstichting.nl.of s.wilmer@prinsenstichting.nl. Zij vertellen jou graag meer!

Ben jij op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging in de zorg?

Wil je graag bij Prinsenstichting werken, solliciteer dan via de onderstaande solliciteren knop.

title: Finance Coordinator - Arbutus Medical
description:
Arbutus Medical is a rapidly growing medical device venture developing a portfolio of procedure kits to streamline surgery “outside the OR”, starting with orthopaedic trauma procedures in the ER.

Our team is growing, and we're looking for a detail-oriented Finance Coordinator to keep our day-to-day financial operations accurate and on time. You'll own core transactional accounting, including accounts payable, vendor payments, employee expenses, and customer payments. Your work will help us close each month on time and stay audit-ready as the company scales.

Reporting to the Director of Finance, you'll be the main contact for vendors and internal departments on invoices, approvals, and payments. You'll work closely with teams across the company to make sure spending is coded correctly, approved, and paid on time. This role suits someone early in their accounting career who wants hands-on experience, likes getting the details right, and wants to grow with a scaling company.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (budgeted base salary of $55,000 - $65,000)
  • An exciting opportunity to get in at the ground floor of a growing venture
  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work arrangements
  • Extended health benefits
  • Professional development funding
  • A purpose-driven workplace with passionate teammates who want to help patients and make a positive difference in the world

Key responsibilities:

Accounts Payable

  • Code and review AP invoices so each one has the right GL account, department, and tax treatment
  • Confirm that invoices and expenses are approved by the right department leader before payment
  • Follow up with departments on uncoded or unapproved invoices so AP is complete and accurate at month-end
  • Prepare and run the AP payment run twice a month
  • Set up and maintain vendor payments in our third-party payment platform
  • Investigate and resolve outstanding or disputed AP invoices with vendors and internal teams
  • Ensure invoices from Dext and other intake tools are recorded accurately and on time
  • Answer vendor inquiries and reconcile vendor statements to the AP sub-ledger
  • Prepare AP aging reports and flag overdue or unusual balances

Vendor Management

  • Maintain the vendor master file, including setting up new vendors and keeping vendor records current
  • Verify vendor banking details before adding or changing them, to prevent payment fraud
  • Collect and keep W-9 and W-8 forms from US vendors

Employee Expenses

  • Review expense reports in Expensify for correct coding, tax amounts (GST/PST/HST), receipts, and completeness
  • Upload approved US expense reports to our third-party platform for payment

Cash & Accounts Receivable

  • Post customer payments and deposits accurately and on time
  • Clear and reconcile the Suspense GL account regularly and investigate unidentified items

Month-End, Year-End & Audit Support

  • Help the Senior Accountant complete the month-end close on time by completing AP, expense, and cash tasks by set deadlines
  • Help prepare year-end working papers and supporting schedules
  • File and organize supporting documents so records are always ready for audit
  • Find recurring issues or manual steps and suggest ways to improve them

Requirements

  • Degree or diploma in Accounting or a related field (preferred)
  • 1–2 years of accounting experience, ideally in AP or full-cycle bookkeeping
  • Working knowledge of Canadian sales taxes (GST/PST/HST)
  • Experience with Xero, Expensify, Dext, or similar tools (an asset)
  • Intermediate Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, INDEX Match, pivot tables)
  • Enrolled in or interested in pursuing the CPA program (an asset)

Desired Capabilities and Traits

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
  • High ownership mindset; works well independently and as part of a team
  • Spots issues early and resolves them proactively
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Meets deadlines reliably, especially during month-end and payment runs
  • Communicates clearly and professionally with vendors and internal departments



Why this role, and why now?

Arbutus Medical is reinventing how surgery is done Outside the OR™, starting within the ER, where surgeons struggle with 1M+ bedside procedures a year due to outdated workflows. We’re building the market’s first portfolio of procedure kit “grab bags” to streamline these procedures, and have launched two FDA-cleared products to date, TrakPak® (to streamline bedside skeletal traction) and SwiftKit™ (to streamline treatment of fingertip trauma). These are two truly differentiated products that solve practical workflow problems, saving up to 45 min/patient, helping hospitals win back resources and keep staff happy, while improving quality of patient care. We are already in 75+ U.S. hospitals (including more than 20% of all Level 1 Trauma Centers), have a high double-digit growth rate, and are backed by a deep roster of Canadian healthtech investors. Entering 2026, we are ready to accelerate product development and scale up US sales and medical education to set a new standard of care in our target procedures.

Competitive Salary

Our salary budgets are designed using comprehensive market data and to reflect the range of skills and experience we need for the position and allow room for growth. For experienced individuals we typical hire at the mid-point of the band. The top portion is reserved for employees who demonstrate sustained high performance and impact at Arbutus. Those who are new to the role may join below the mid-point and develop their skills overtime. The final offer amount for this role will depend on applicable skill set of the candidate.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Arbutus Medical is committed to making diversity, equity, and inclusion part of everything we do, from how we build our products to how we build our workforce. If this resonates with you, please apply – even if you don’t feel like you “check all the boxes.” Also, let us know if we can provide any specific accessibility considerations throughout the interview and candidate screening process.

About Arbutus Medical Inc.

Arbutus Medical Inc. is a privately held ISO13485 medical device company headquartered in Vancouver, Canada. Arbutus Medical is a medical device innovation engine that streamlines surgical inefficiencies for the good of patient care. The company is currently focused on improving the standard of care for simple orthopaedic trauma procedures commonly performed in hospital Emergency Rooms (ERs). Its two leading products are TrakPak®, a procedure kit that streamlines bedside skeletal traction, and Digit Revision SwiftKit™, a procedure kit that streamlines revision amputations of fingers and toes. In addition, the company has made one of its patented platforms, (DrillCover Technology™, which adapts DEWALT® drills for surgery) available at accessible price points around the globe. The company’s products have regulatory clearances from the U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA) and Health Canada, and have been used by customers in 40 countries, enabling an estimated 130,000 surgeries to date. For more information about Arbutus Medical, visit arbutusmedical.com and follow the company on LinkedIn.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Degree or diploma in Accounting or a related field (preferred)

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
At NaviLens, we are redefining accessibility through cutting-edge technology that enables millions of people with visual impairments to interact with their environment independently. Our unique code system is deployed across public transport networks, museums, consumer products, and smart cities in more than 40 countries. We are a technology company with a clear mission: to make the world more accessible and inclusive.

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to join our technology team and take on a key role in the evolution of our platform: the content management tools our clients work with every day, the APIs that power our app, and the data and automation ecosystem that supports our operations at international scale.

This is a role with real technical depth and direct ownership of product in production, in a company where every engineering decision has a measurable impact on people's lives.

THE ROLE

Build and evolve the software behind the NaviLens ecosystem: design scalable backend services and APIs, develop accessible web applications for our clients and internal teams, and bring engineering judgement to the architecture decisions and practices of a growing technical team, always with accessibility and reliability as first-class criteria.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Full Stack Development

  • Develop and evolve full stack web applications (frontend and backend) across the NaviLens ecosystem.
  • Design and implement scalable APIs and backend services on cloud infrastructure.
  • Own features end to end, from technical design to production and follow-up.

Accessibility by Design

  • Build interfaces that comply with WCAG 2.2, treating accessibility as a quality criterion rather than a final add-on.
  • Contribute to accessible patterns and components that the whole team can reuse.

Architecture & Engineering Practices

  • Take part in architecture decisions, code reviews, and the definition of the team's best practices.
  • Help keep the codebase maintainable, tested, and understandable as the product grows.

AI in Product and in How We Work

  • Integrate AI capabilities into the product and into our internal development workflows.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools with judgement, knowing when to delegate to an agent and when not to.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with the product, deployment, and project teams to turn client needs into technical solutions.
  • Support deployments and international projects with the technical criteria they require.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Solid experience in frontend and backend development with JavaScript and TypeScript; hands-on experience with Angular and React is especially valued.
  • Backend experience with Node.js and frameworks such as Fastify or NestJS.
  • Strong command of the web ecosystem: HTML5, CSS3, REST APIs, and version control with Git.
  • Regular, confident use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar), with the judgement to know when to delegate to the agent and when not to.
  • Working knowledge of relational (SQL) and non-relational (MongoDB) databases.
  • Ability to work autonomously and as part of a team, with good communication and a results-oriented mindset.
  • Availability to work on‑site in Murcia, Spain.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience building features on top of language models: LLM API integration, RAG, MCP, agent orchestration, or AI-driven process automation.
  • Knowledge of PHP and associated frameworks (Symfony, etc.).
  • Experience or familiarity with cloud services, particularly Amazon Web Services ("AWS").
  • Understanding of cybersecurity and secure development practices (OWASP, access control, input validation, etc.).
  • Experience with continuous integration, automated deployment, or containers (Docker).
  • Knowledge of machine and server configuration, basic systems administration, and bash scripting.
  • Interest or previous experience in digital accessibility and inclusive design.
  • A level of English that allows you to work with technical documentation and with international teams and clients.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • A mission-driven company with real social impact
  • A flexible and innovative work environment
  • Real technical ownership over product running in production
  • International exposure and growth opportunities
  • The opportunity to work with a team passionate about improving millions of lives through technology

title: Senior BI Engineer - Power BI Subject Matter Expert
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Power BI Subject Matter Expert who knows Power BI inside out. You will be the go-to technical authority on data modeling, DAX, performance, and governance, while still building solutions yourself. You will solve the hardest Power BI problems across enterprise engagements and guide developers on best practices. Experience with Microsoft Fabric is a strong advantage as clients increasingly adopt it.

Design & Development

  • Develop high-quality reports with strong UX, drill-through, bookmarks, tooltips, and custom visuals where needed.
  • Write Power Query (M) and SQL for data preparation and transformation.
  • Choose the right storage mode (Import, DirectQuery, Composite) based on scale, latency, and cost.

Performance & Optimization

  • Diagnose and tune slow models and reports using DAX Studio, Tabular Editor, VertiPaq Analyzer, and Performance Analyzer.
  • Optimize refresh strategies, including incremental refresh, partitioning, and aggregations.

Governance, Security & Administration

  • Implement RLS/OLS, workspace strategy, and access controls.
  • Manage Power BI Service: gateways, scheduled refresh, apps, sensitivity labels, endorsement, and lineage.
  • Set up deployment pipelines and version control for Power BI artifacts (PBIP, TMDL).

Leadership & Enablement

  • Act as the escalation point for complex Power BI issues across projects.
  • Conduct model and report reviews, and contribute to development standards and best practices.
  • Mentor developers and advise clients on Power BI adoption and roadmap, including Copilot in Power BI.
  • Support clients adopting Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Direct Lake, OneLake) where applicable.

Education:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Certifications: PL-300, DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer).

Required Skills:

  • 5+ years of deep, hands-on Power BI experience in enterprise BI/analytics.
  • Expert DAX, data modeling (star schema), and Power Query (M).
  • Strong SQL.
  • Solid understanding of storage modes, incremental refresh, and performance tuning.
  • Hands-on with Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, and XMLA endpoints.
  • Experience with RLS/OLS, deployment pipelines, and Power BI Service administration.

description:

About the Role

The Lead Analyst will play a critical role in enhancing FP&A, analytics, reporting automation, and decision support capabilities for the Gas & Petrochemical BU Vertical. The position will lead the development and implementation of data-driven reporting solutions, including global backlog sales reporting, forecasting tools, and automated financial dashboards using Power BI and centralized data platforms. Training & Capability Building

  • Provide training, documentation, and user support to finance and business teams, promoting adoption of Power BI dashboards and fostering self-service reporting and analytics capabilities across the Gas & Petrochemical Vertical.

Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify and implement opportunities for process automation, reporting standardization, and business intelligence enhancements that improve operational efficiency, data visibility, and decision-making across the G&P vertical.

Required Skills

  • Proven experience developing in Power BI including Power Query, DaX and report publishing

title: SQL Server DBA

De databasebeheerder (DBA) is verantwoordelijk voor het bieden van technische ondersteuning voor de databaseomgeving, waaronder het toezicht op de ontwikkeling en organisatie van de databases, de beoordeling en implementatie van nieuwe technologieën, en het bieden van een langetermijnperspectief aan de IT-afdeling over de relatie tussen databasetechnologie en de zakelijke kansen waarmee het bedrijf wordt geconfronteerd. title: Certifiering och IT-säkerhetsarkitektur inom Cybersäkerhet
description:
Vill du vara med och forma framtidens europeiska cybersäkerhetscertifiering? Combitech söker nu en certifierare inom cybersäkerhet till Stockholm eller Växjö. I rollen arbetar du med säkerhetsutvärdering, säkerhetsarkitektur och oberoende granskning av produkter och system. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i framkant av utvecklingen inom European Union Common Criteria Certification (EUCC) och bidra till att skapa säkra och tillförlitliga produkter för försvarssektorn, myndigheter och samhällsviktig verksamhet.

Din roll som konsult inom certifiering och IT-säkerhetsarkitekt

Som certifieringsspecialist arbetar du med oberoende granskning och bedömning av produkter och system ur ett cybersäkerhetsperspektiv. Du stödjer kunder genom hela certifieringsprocessen, från tidiga kravanalyser och förberedelser till granskning och bedömning av säkerhetsutvärderingar.



I rollen bidrar du även till utvecklingen av Combitechs erbjudande inom EUCC och Common Criteria. Du granskar och bedömer utvärderingsrapporter från Combitechs evalueringslaboratorier, säkerställer att certifieringsunderlag uppfyller krav enligt EUCC och Common Criteria samt fattar eller förbereder underlag för certifieringsbeslut. Arbetet innebär också att tolka och tillämpa nationella och europeiska cybersäkerhetskrav samt delta i tekniska möten med kunder, laboratorier och myndigheter.



Du kommer även att bidra till utvecklingen av processer, metoder och styrande dokument, bevaka utvecklingen inom EU:s cybersäkerhetscertifiering och relaterade standarder samt medverka vid revisioner, ackrediteringar och kvalitetsgranskningar. Rollen omfattar dessutom oberoende granskning mot ramverk och system såsom KSF, ISA, ISK och NIST 800-53. Arbetet kan kombineras med arbete med IT-säkerhetsarkitektur.



Våra kunder finns inom försvarsindustrin, myndigheter, samhällsviktig verksamhet och privat näringsliv där kraven på certifierade och cybersäkra produkter ökar snabbt. Genom ditt arbete bidrar du till ett säkrare och mer motståndskraftigt samhälle.

Vem är du?

Vi tror att du har ett stort intresse för cybersäkerhet, produktsäkerhet och säkerhetsutvärdering. Du uppskattar att kombinera teknisk förståelse med metodiskt gransknings- och analysarbete och trivs i en roll där kvalitet, objektivitet och säkerhet står i fokus.



För att lyckas i rollen har du en teknisk bakgrund och förståelse för områden som t.ex. kryptografi, nätverk, identitets- och behörighetshantering samt molntjänster. Erfarenhet av kravhantering, granskning eller revision är också värdefull, liksom förmågan att analysera komplexa tekniska lösningar ur ett säkerhetsperspektiv.



Du uttrycker dig obehindrat på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift. Har du tidigare erfarenhet av eller kunskap om EUCC, Common Criteria eller andra certifieringsramverk ser vi det som meriterande.



Då tjänsten innebär arbete som omfattas av försvarssekretess krävs det att du genomför och godkänns i en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll.



Urval sker löpande. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Kom & gör skillnad

Vi tror att man gör ett bättre jobb om man kan fokusera på rätt saker, därför gör vi det lätt att kombinera jobbet med vardagen. Vi satsar på våra medarbetare, de utgör kärnan, hjärnan och hjärtat i vår verksamhet. Dessutom står vi på en stadig grund av högteknologi, forskning och anställningstrygghet med försvars- och säkerhetskoncernen Saab som ägare.



Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss? Kolla in våra karriärsidor!

title: Office Administrator
description:
Company and Vision

PlanetArt’s vision is to be the leading seller of personalized and make-on-demand products worldwide. We provide consumers with unmatched tools and content and an unparalleled end-to-end customer experience that result in high-quality, meaningful finished products and memorable celebrations of live events.

The company’s brands include the popular FreePrints and FreePrints Photobooks apps and the industry leading SimplytoImpress card and stationery site, as well as Personal Creations, CafePress and ISeeMe! Visit www.planetart.com to learn more about our brands.

We have more than 500 team members across multiple offices, primarily in Calabasas CA, San Diego CA, Woodridge IL, Minneapolis, MN and Pleasanton, CA. We also have team members in two company-owned offices in China, as well as in Europe.

Job Overview

PlanetArt is seeking a reliable, professional, and service-oriented Office Administrator to support our Woodridge facility. This position serves as the first point of contact for employees, visitors, candidates, vendors, and guests entering the facility.

This is a hands-on role in a warehouse and office environment. The Office Administrator will interact regularly with warehouse and office employees, particularly as employees arrive for work each morning. This person will answer routine questions, provide direction and assistance, and escalate employee, facility, safety, or other concerns when appropriate.

The Office Administrator will also provide general administrative support and assist Human Resources with employee communications, events, recognition activities, and other facility-related needs.

This is an on-site, Monday through Friday position.

What You’ll Do
Key Responsibilities

  • Greet and assist employees, visitors, candidates, vendors, and guests in a professional and courteous manner.
  • Serve as a front-line resource for employees, particularly warehouse employees arriving at the facility each morning.
  • Answer incoming phone calls and emails and direct questions to the appropriate person or department.
  • Respond to routine facility and administrative questions and appropriately escalate issues when necessary.
  • Perform general clerical and administrative duties, including data entry, filing, scanning, copying, and document preparation.
  • Maintain accurate information in company systems, spreadsheets, and databases.
  • Manage incoming and outgoing mail, packages, and deliveries, including coordinating pickups.
  • Perform daily opening and closing duties for the office as assigned.
  • Submit and follow up on routine facility or maintenance requests.
  • Assist Human Resources with employee events, meetings, training, celebrations, and recognition activities.
  • Prepare materials, communications, sign-in sheets, and other items for employee activities.
  • Support new-hire welcome activities and employee milestone recognition.
  • Help maintain a professional and welcoming environment for employees and visitors.
  • Assist with local errands and other administrative tasks as needed.
  • Follow company policies, procedures, and safety requirements.
  • Track and maintain office supplies and submit requests for replenishments when necessary.

Requirements

What You Should Have
Skills, Qualifications, and Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree preferred.
  • 2+ years of experience in an administrative, clerical, receptionist, front desk, or customer service role preferred.
  • Experience in a warehouse, manufacturing, distribution, or similar environment is a plus.
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
  • Professional and effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Basic to intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word and Excel.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work independently and know when to escalate an issue.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise good judgment.
  • Ability to remain calm and professional when handling difficult situations.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.
  • Must be able to work on-site five days per week, Monday through Friday.

What You Can Expect
Working Conditions

  • Work is performed in an office environment with low to moderate noise levels.
  • Occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds.
  • Position requires regular, continuous use of computer.
  • Position requires regular sitting and standing.
  • Position requires regular interaction with team members through the following methods: in-person, phone, Zoom, Slack, or email.
  • May require occasional exposure to the warehouse as needed.
  • This is an onsite role; thus the ideal candidate is expected to be in the office five days per week (Monday through Friday) with the option of working additional hours during Peak (November – December)

Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $24 - $26 per hour.

PlanetArt offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • 401(k) with matching
  • Pet Insurance
  • Mental Health Benefits
  • Comprehensive Time Off Program, including Vacation, Sick Days, Paid Holidays, and Floating Holidays
  • Employee Product Discounts

Je bent de de technische brug in het voortraject en de opstart van infrastructuurprojecten. Je vertrekt vanuit de noden van de klant en vertaalt deze naar schaalbare en haalbare IT-oplossingen.

This is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on how enterprise systems evolve and connect.

  • Coordinate closely with product owners and stakeholders across IT, Sales, Finance, and HR, aligning working hours to support real-time collaboration

  • Strong command of TypeScript/JavaScript paired with a modern frontend framework such as React or similar
  • Solid backend development experience using Node.js or Python, along with strong API and integration design skills
  • Demonstrated experience delivering AI/LLM-powered solutions, covering tool calling, RAG, agents, MCP, prompt workflows, or comparable production work
  • Background translating stakeholder workshop discussions into concrete architecture and an actionable, buildable backlog
  • Practical AWS delivery experience, including Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, IAM, and CloudWatch, along with enterprise authentication methods such as SSO/Okta and RBAC

title: FUNCTIONAL CONSULTANT | Microsoft Business central
description:
Wij zoeken een Functional Consultant die bedrijfsprocessen begrijpt, klanten goed kan adviseren en energie krijgt van het verbeteren van hoe bedrijven werken.

Bij Bizzapps werk je met Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central als basis. Vanuit die ERP-oplossing kijken we verder: hoe kunnen we processen slimmer organiseren, automatiseren en waar relevant versterken met AI?

Je hoeft dus geen developer of AI-specialist te zijn. Een sterke functionele basis, inzicht in bedrijfsprocessen en de drive om technologie slim in te zetten zijn voor ons belangrijker.

Krijg jij energie van bedrijfsprocessen, Business Central en klanten begeleiden in verandering? Let's chat!

Jouw rol

Als Functional Consultant ben je de schakel tussen de klant en onze technologie. Je begrijpt hoe een bedrijf werkt, brengt noden en processen in kaart en vertaalt die naar een werkbare oplossing in Business Central.

Je begeleidt klanten van analyse en advies tot configuratie, testing en implementatie.

Concreet:

  • Je analyseert bedrijfsprocessen en brengt verbeterpunten en noden in kaart.
  • Je begeleidt klanten bij de implementatie en optimalisatie van Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
  • Je vertaalt business requirements naar functionele oplossingen.
  • Je configureert en test oplossingen binnen Business Central.
  • Je begeleidt workshops en denkt actief mee met key users en management.
  • Je ondersteunt klanten bij de ingebruikname en verdere optimalisatie van hun ERP.
  • Je identificeert opportuniteiten voor automatisering, integraties en AI.
  • Je werkt samen met onze technische consultants en developers wanneer een oplossing technisch verder uitgewerkt moet worden.

Wie ben jij?

✔️ Je hebt ervaring met Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, bij voorkeur als functional consultant.

✔️ Je begrijpt hoe bedrijfsprocessen werken en denkt end-to-end, niet vanuit afzonderlijke softwaremodules.

✔️ Je kunt luisteren naar een klant, de juiste vragen stellen en een businessvraag vertalen naar een concrete oplossing.

✔️ Je voelt je comfortabel in gesprekken met zowel business users als technische collega's.

✔️ Je bent analytisch sterk en communiceert helder.

✔️ Je neemt ownership en durft initiatief te nemen.

✔️ Je bent nieuwsgierig naar AI, automatisering en nieuwe technologie. Je hoeft hierin nog geen expert te zijn.

✔️ Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands. Engels is een plus.

Grote troeven

⭐ Ervaring met Business Central-implementaties en functionele analyse.

⭐ Ervaring binnen batchproductie, productieomgevingen en/of project engineering.

⭐ Kennis van Power Platform, Copilot, automatisering en AI.

⭐ Ervaring met integraties, API's en datamigraties.

We verwachten niet dat je tegelijk functioneel consultant, developer, integratiespecialist én AI-expert bent. Je hoeft vooral sterk te zijn in functionele analyse, processen en klantcontact. Vanuit daar krijg je bij Bizzapps de ruimte om je kennis verder uit te bouwen in automatisatie, AI, Power Platform en andere technologie.

This is an exciting time to join SYMCA. As an Established Mayoral Strategic Authority, we are taking on greater powers and responsibilities through devolution, including the implementation of Integrated Settlement arrangements that will allow us to align investment more closely with the priorities of South Yorkshire's communities, businesses and places.

We are expanding our analytical capability and putting evidence at the heart of decision-making. As Lead Performance Analyst, you will play a key role in helping the organisation understand its performance, track progress against strategic priorities and ensure leaders have the information they need to make informed decisions.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced analyst who is passionate about performance reporting, data visualisation and using insight to drive organisational improvement. You will lead a small team and help shape how performance is measured and reported across the organisation.

If you think you'd be a great fit for this role but you’re not sure you meet every requirement equally, we'd still welcome your application.

We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking to work part time (4 days a week or more) or as part of a job share.

Applications must be accompanied by a cover letter to detail how you meet the criteria set out below. Please note, all applications should be made directly via our careers portal.

Please set out clearly in your cover letter how you meet the following criteria from the role profile:
  • Significant experience of developing performance indicators and outcomes-focused performance frameworks, with a strong understanding of how they contribute to organisational decision-making
  • Significant experience of using Power BI to design and build reports and visualisations in a business environment
  • Experience of developing and managing mechanisms for reporting to external authorities on progress towards achieving outputs and outcomes
As Lead Performance Analyst, you will lead the development, delivery and continuous improvement of SYMCA's corporate performance reporting framework.

Working closely with the Principal: Corporate Planning and Performance, you will oversee the production of high-quality performance reports for senior audiences including the Executive Leadership Board, MCA Board and Government. You will help develop reporting that demonstrates progress against corporate priorities, organisational objectives and long-term outcomes.

A key aspect of the role will be developing robust reporting frameworks, indicators and performance measures that track both short and long-term outcomes. You will use modern reporting and visualisation tools to improve efficiency, accessibility and insight.

You will work collaboratively with colleagues across the organisation to improve data quality, governance and reporting processes, helping to strengthen the links between performance, finance and strategic planning. The role also includes leading and developing a small team, promoting high standards of analytical practice and supporting capability development across the organisation.
You are an experienced performance or analytical professional with a strong track record of developing performance frameworks, reporting tools and data-driven insight that supports decision-making.

You will bring:
  • Experience developing performance indicators, reporting frameworks and outcomes-focused measures.
  • Strong expertise in Power BI and data visualisation tools.
  • Experience using analytical techniques and data to generate meaningful insight.
  • Experience of leading, developing and supporting teams.
  • Knowledge of data governance, quality assurance and reporting processes.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build effective relationships across an organisation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex analysis to senior audiences.
  • Experience of working with a range of data sources and turning information into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
You will be a strategic thinker with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and driving continuous improvement. Most importantly, you will be passionate about using data and evidence to improve organisational performance and support the delivery of South Yorkshire's long-term ambitions.
All colleagues have access to a Local Government Pension Scheme and the chance to be part of an organisation where you can really make a difference. Located in Sheffield City Centre, we are well-placed for transport links and encourage employees to take advantage of the active travel facilities. Work/life balance is extremely important to us here at SYMCA with our recognised family/friendly policies, genuine work flexibility, recognition, and shared success.

Under the scheme employees can accrue a defined amount of credit or debit of working hours, and to take time-off in the form of Flexi-Leave or banked Annual Leave.

Rewarding You - Reducing everyday expenses through discounts, benefits, financial advice, wellbeing solutions and more with Reward Gateway and Cycle-to-Work schemes.

Professional Membership Fees – Where membership to Professional bodies is applicable to your role, SYMCA will reimburse your membership fees where applicable and following approval by Line Management.

Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:

  • Find a better way
  • Do the right thing
  • Say it straight
  • Win together
  • Own the outcome

If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.

As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed.

Some of our perks and benefits are:

We understand that diverse candidates have diverse needs. We welcome you to inform us of any additional needs related to completing your job application or participating in the interview process, via talentsupport@xplortechnologies.com.

Before you apply

To be considered for employment, you must be legally authorised to work in the United Kingdom. This applies to remote roles too, as we can only employ people who reside within the UK. Xplor does not sponsor visas, either at the time of hire or at any later time. We're also not able to offer contractor arrangements or Employer of Record engagements for this position at this stage.

Please apply through our careers portal or external job boards only. We're unable to upload emailed applications, as our process requires you to answer screening questions directly.

We also invite you to check out our Candidate FAQs for more information about our recruitment process .

As part of our hiring process, successful candidates will be asked to complete background and identity verification checks. Many of our roles are remote, and to protect both candidates and our business from recruitment fraud, we may record video interviews via Microsoft Teams during the process. We keep any recordings and related data only for as long as the hiring process is active and do not retain them afterwards.

We believe in transparent hiring. We use an applicant tracking system with artificial intelligence-enabled features to support our recruitment process, but our recruitment team makes all hiring decisions after human review. We do not rely on artificial intelligence to make final hiring decisions. Find our Candidate AI Usage guidelines here.

Xplor is dedicated to attracting, retaining and developing our people regardless of gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability and age. We encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

We're seeking a Senior AI Engineer to architect and ship LLM-powered applications and agentic systems that address genuine challenges for our users and teams. Your work will span the entire applied-AI stack — from retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and prompt design to multi-step agents that reason, leverage tools, and automate end-to-end workflows.

This position is for a senior builder. You'll drive complex use cases from ambiguous problems through to production: selecting appropriate models, implementing agentic architectures, connecting retrieval and tooling, establishing quality evaluation methods, and delivering dependable applications at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and deliver production LLM applications — chat, copilots, assistants, and autonomous workflows — from idea to scale
  • Construct and implement RAG pipelines: chunking, embeddings, vector search, reranking, and grounding to minimize hallucination and boost relevance
  • Create agentic architectures: multi-step reasoning, tool/function calling, planning, memory, and multi-agent orchestration
  • Support the automation of business and engineering workflows through agentic AI and workflow automation
  • Establish prompt and context strategies; construct evaluation harnesses and maintain quality, latency, and cost standards
  • Connect LLMs with internal data, APIs, and tools through connectors, function calling, and structured outputs
  • Deploy guardrails, safety, and observability for AI systems (tracing, evals, monitoring for quality and drift)
  • Partner with product, data, and platform teams to transform ambiguous problems into shipped AI features
  • Exchange knowledge with fellow engineers and take part in design reviews

Requirements

  • 3+ years in software or ML engineering, including recent, hands-on experience building and shipping applications with LLMs
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering applied-AI systems end to end
  • Proficiency in Python at an advanced level
  • Background in building RAG systems — embeddings, retrieval, and reranking with vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, or pgvector)
  • Expertise in LLM APIs and orchestration frameworks (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, or LlamaIndex)

Nice to have

Governance (approx. 10%)

At Envalior, your growth matters. We encourage and invest in your professional and personal development. We support our employees in their growth and personal development through ongoing investment in their knowledge and skills via training, coaching, and mentoring.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Prime
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Prime team's mission is to build Bitstamp's prime brokerage for institutional clients — the platform that lets hedge funds, market makers, and professional trading firms onboard, fund, trade, borrow against, and settle positions at scale. We build the systems that move real institutional money: cross-venue settlement, credit against collateral, matched-book lending, and the bridge that brings tokenized securities to our order book — together with the client- and ops-facing surfaces that make them usable, from institutional onboarding and account configuration to reporting and the backoffice tooling our operations run on every day. These are correctness-critical systems where a wrong answer can't be cheaply undone — getting them right is the whole job.

As a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will own the design and end-to-end delivery of features across that whole surface — from the Prime backend services down to the frontend and backoffice screens that expose them. You'll lead other engineers through problems of high ambiguity, set the technical bar for how we build for failure and not just the happy path, and follow a problem across the full institutional lifecycle rather than stopping at a boundary. Flexibility is the job: some weeks that's a settlement edge case in the backend, others a client onboarding flow or an ops dashboard, and you're happy owning whichever the work needs.

This role is based in our London office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

Requires participation in an on-call rotation to support business needs.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the design and end-to-end delivery of features across the stack — from Prime backend services (settlement, on-exchange credit, lending, tokenized securities) through to the frontend and backoffice screens clients and ops teams rely on.

  • Own the client- and ops-facing journeys across the institutional lifecycle — onboarding, account configuration, reporting, and the tooling that lets operations run the business safely.

  • Author detailed designs and break work into reviewable steps, making failure states, invariants, and recovery explicit before you ship — on flows where a wrong answer moves real money.

  • Uplevel the team through design-focused code review and mentorship, and move fluidly between backend and frontend as the work demands rather than handing off at a boundary.

What you bring

  • A track record of independently delivering complex, high-ambiguity projects with long-term impact, operating them in production and owning every line you ship.

  • Strong full-stack range in production — a modern backend (we work primarily in Python/Django and Go) and a component-based frontend (we use Vue) — with the judgment to know where a given problem is best solved and a genuine willingness to own whatever the feature needs, wherever it lives in the stack.

  • Hands-on experience building financial systems — user balances, ledgers, risk engines, settlement, onboarding/KYC, or payments — where correctness is non-negotiable and mistakes are expensive.

  • Strong design judgment: you enumerate the failure paths, name your invariants, and can point at the constraint, test, or alert that enforces each one.

  • Excellent communication: you drive alignment across teams and stakeholders, give substantive design-level review feedback, and mentor engineers to raise the bar around you.

🎁 What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career and shape the future of global institutional finance

  • Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership

  • Top-tier health benefits to fuel your work, including 100% employer-paid private medical insurance for you and comprehensive coverage for dependents, alongside mental health and wellbeing support programs

  • Aviva Pension Scheme with highly competitive company matching to secure your future

  • Lifestyle Wallet: A highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account to offset expenses like wellness, learning, childcare, and more

  • Access to the best AI tools on the market with continuous AI skill-building opportunities for all employees

  • Time to recharge: Generous paid time off, company holidays, sick time, parental leave, and paid volunteer time off

  • Exceptional office experience: Catered meals, fully stocked snacks, team social events, and modern workspaces in our London location

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

title: Head of Technical Architecture - AI
description:
Head of Technical Architecture - AI

Contract | Inside IR35 | 6 Months


Contract Length: 6 Months
IR35 Status: Inside IR35
Location: London, Bristol or Manchester (predominantly remote)
Clearance: BPSS Required

Daily rate - £750 - £850

We are seeking an experienced Head of Technical Architecture - AI to lead the technical architecture function for a major, high-profile AI transformation programme within the UK public sector.

This is an exciting opportunity to shape the architecture, strategy, and governance behind innovative AI-powered digital products that are transforming how users interact with public services.

Location

Flexible across London, Bristol, or Manchester, with a predominantly remote working model. Occasional travel to London is required for team meetings (approximately once every two months).

Clearance
  • BPSS required
  • Existing SC clearance is advantageous but not essential
  • Candidates currently holding SC may transfer their clearance during onboarding
The Role

As the Head of Technical Architecture, you will provide technical leadership across a large AI programme, driving architectural excellence and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with strategic objectives.

You will lead a team of architects, define technical standards and governance, and work closely with senior stakeholders to influence decision-making across complex technology landscapes.

title: Reisų planuotojas (-a)
description:
Mes turime ilgametę patirtį logistikos srityje. Vadovaujamės vakarietiškos kokybės standartais savo klientų pristatymams, kartu su beveik 6000 patyrusių specialistų komanda. Patirtis, patikimumas, ekspertiškumas, inovacijos, pripažinimas, pasitikėjimas - šios pagrindinės vertybės plėtojamos visuose mūsų procesuose. Organizacijoje tikime, kad žmonės yra mūsų didžiausia stiprybė. Čia puoselėjame draugišką, atvirumu, įsitraukimu ir pasitikėjimu grįstą įmonės kultūrą. Jeigu mūsų vertybės atliepia tavąsias – kviečiame prisijungti prie Everwest” komandos. Siekime karjeros aukštumų drauge.

Šiuo metu ieškome: Reisų planuotojo (-os)

Atsakomybės ir tikslai šioje pozicijoje:

  • Tarptautinių reisų planavimas ir maršrutų optimizavimas;
  • Efektyvus transporto priemonių bei vairuotojų darbo planavimas;
  • Reisų eigos stebėjimas, kontrolė ir operatyvus nestandartinių situacijų sprendimas;
  • Efektyvaus turimų resursų panaudojimo užtikrinimas;
  • Glaudus bendradarbiavimas su vairuotojais ir kitais įmonės padaliniais.

Sėkmingam darbui Tau reikės:

  • Darbo patirties transporto, logistikos ar reisų planavimo srityje;
  • Gebėjimo savarankiškai planuoti, analizuoti ir greitai priimti sprendimus;
  • Atsakingumo, organizuotumo ir orientacijos į rezultatą;
  • Gebėjimo efektyviai dirbti dinamiškoje aplinkoje;
  • Gerų komunikacijos ir bendradarbiavimo įgūdžių;
  • Anglų ir rusų kalbų žinių.

Mes siūlome:

Mėnesinis atlyginimas (bruto): Nuo 1930€ iki 2420€. Konkretus darbo užmokestis siūlomas atsižvelgiant į darbo patirtį, kompetenciją bei atitikimą kitiems pareigybės reikalavimams. Be to, kiekvienas „Everwest“ kompanijos darbuotojas gauna papildomų naudų paketą, į kurį įeina:

  • Augimo galimybės: profesionali ir palaikanti komanda, vadovų ugdymo programos. Galimybė tobulėti dalyvaujant tiek vidiniuose, tiek išoriniuose mokymuose.
  • Modernus biuras: ergonomiškai įrengtas biuras su poilsio zonomis, lauko terasomis ir sporto sale. Restoranas, kuriame, taikomos išskirtinės kainos darbuotojams.
  • Pripažinimas ir apdovanojimai: laisva diena gimimo dienos mėnesį, bei dovanos per šventes ar darbo įmonėje sukakties proga. Įvairūs įmonės renginiai, geriausių įmonės darbuotojų rinkimai, bei darbuotojų iniciatyva veikiantys bendraminčių klubai.

We are looking for a Senior AWS Python Developer or AWS Operations Expert with 6+ years of experience to join our team. If you are a senior-level engineer who enjoys working independently with minimal supervision, making sound technical decisions, and guiding architectural direction on complex distributed systems, this is the perfect role for you. You are comfortable writing clean application code in Python and managing infrastructure as code in TypeScript, with a deep, operational understanding of DynamoDB.

This project focuses on a highly scalable, event-driven core platform built using AWS serverless technologies. Our team is fully responsible for the end-to-end architecture, infrastructure, and automated testing strategy. Instead of starting from scratch, you will be expected to dive into an established, mature codebase, quickly adopt our engineering conventions, and work effectively to expand, secure, and scale platform capabilities.

  • Own and develop infrastructure as code (IaC) to ensure deployment reliability and consistency
  • Actively contribute to architectural decisions, evaluate alternative design approaches, and document technical trade-offs
  • Focus on operational excellence, ensuring services are secure, highly available, scalable, and easy to monitor
