title: Technical Program Manager
description:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually.

Our consumer and business propositions – YouTrip and YouBiz – empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific.

Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions.

Job Description: Technical Program Manager

As a Technical Program Manager at YouTrip, you'll help our engineering organization deliver complex, cross-team programs that power payments for millions of customers and businesses across Asia Pacific. You'll bring structure to large initiatives that span mobile, backend, infrastructure, risk, and compliance. You'll turn ambiguous goals into clear roadmaps, keep teams across India and the region aligned, and make sure critical launches ship on time, safely, and at the quality our customers expect from a financial product.


You'll also help raise the bar for how engineering works at YouTrip by driving shared standards, better delivery processes, and the tools and practices that help teams move faster with confidence. This role needs a strong mix of technical understanding and people skills, so you can earn the trust of engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders alike.

Technical Program Management at YouTrip sits within our engineering organization and plays a key role in helping teams across India and the region deliver as one. TPMs are experienced technologists who create clarity, make sure we focus on the right priorities, drive execution, and manage risk on programs that depend on strong cross-team collaboration. You'll be joining a growing India team at an important stage, with real influence over how we build and scale.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of multiple complex, technical programs at once, such as new market launches, card and payment network integrations, platform migrations, and regulatory or security initiatives.
  • Work with engineering, product, design, QA, risk, compliance, and operations teams to define scope, requirements, milestones, and ownership.
  • Build roadmaps that balance near-term deliverables with the longer-term technical direction of each program.
  • Track progress, surface blockers early, and resolve cross-team dependencies across India and regional teams in Singapore and other markets.
  • Anticipate risks across teams and systems, and put mitigation and contingency plans in place before they affect customers or deadlines.
  • Use metrics throughout the program lifecycle (delivery health, quality, reliability, and business outcomes) so decisions are grounded in data.
  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, from engineering teams to senior leadership, through status updates, reviews, and presentations.
  • Coordinate release planning for mobile (Android and iOS) and backend services, including launch readiness, rollouts, and post-launch reviews.
  • Drive improvements to engineering processes, such as planning cadences, incident follow-ups, documentation standards, and delivery tooling.
  • Help teams work well together by building a collaborative, accountable, and enjoyable program culture.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in technology, including at least 4 years as a Technical Program Manager, engineering manager, or in a similar delivery leadership role.
  • A background as a software engineer or in a closely related technical role, with the ability to follow system design discussions and spot edge cases and risks in technical specs.
  • Working knowledge of several technology areas, such as mobile development, backend and distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, data, or security, and the ability to pick up new ones quickly.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or other regulated environments is a strong plus.
  • Proven success delivering large programs across multiple teams, time zones, and locations.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a habit of creating clarity: you make sure goals, owners, dependencies, and risks are understood by everyone involved.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics simply to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong relationship-building skills: you know how to align people with different priorities, make sure every voice is heard, and gain commitment to a shared plan.
  • A focus on outcomes over activity: you prioritize by impact, think strategically, and are still willing to dig into details to help the team deliver.
  • Familiarity with Agile and Scrum practices, OKRs, and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g. PMP, CSM, SAFe) are a plus but not required.


To Apply

If you're interested in this role, click Apply Now and send us your CV. Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Chief Development Officer (CDO)
description:
Position Summary

The Chief Development Officer will design and lead a comprehensive development function that strengthens MEI's long-term financial sustainability. Working closely with the Board of Governors and senior leadership, the Chief Development Officer will establish an organization-wide fundraising strategy, diversify revenue sources, expand relationships with donors and institutional partners, and build a high-performing development team.

This role requires an experienced strategist and hands-on builder who can strengthen existing relationships while engaging new audiences and sources of support. The Chief Development Officer will also promote a culture of stewardship and shared accountability for fundraising throughout the Institute.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive development strategy aligned with MEI's mission, priorities, and long-term financial needs.
  • Partner with the Board of Governors and senior leadership to establish fundraising priorities, strengthen board engagement, and institutionalize development practices across the organization.
  • Create and execute plans to diversify funding sources and develop sustainable revenue models.
  • Lead organization-wide fundraising efforts and coordinate staff, board members, experts, and other stakeholders in support of established fundraising goals.
  • Build, lead, and develop the development team, including setting priorities, clarifying responsibilities, and establishing standards for performance and accountability.
  • Design and lead major-gift campaigns, with particular attention to individuals, corporations, foundations, and organizations whose interests align with MEI's mission and programs.
  • Cultivate, solicit, and steward major donors and institutional partners in the United States and the Middle East.
  • Expand MEI's donor base by identifying and engaging new audiences, prospective funders, and strategic partners.
  • Develop fundraising communications and case materials that clearly explain MEI's mission, programs, impact, and funding priorities.
  • Oversee the identification and pursuit of relevant government and foundation grant opportunities, including grant preparation and submission.
  • Establish annual and long-term fundraising plans, goals, performance measures, and reporting practices that allow leadership and the board to evaluate progress.
  • Embed consistent donor stewardship practices throughout the Institute and strengthen coordination among development, program, communications, and leadership teams.
  • Represent MEI in meetings with donors, prospects, foundations, corporations, government representatives, and other external stakeholders.
  • Travel as needed, including internationally, to cultivate and steward relationships with current and prospective supporters.


Required Qualifications

  • Must have at least ten (10) years of major gifts fundraising experience.
  • Senior-level development or advancement experience, including responsibility for fundraising strategy, donor cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
  • Demonstrated success designing and leading major-gift campaigns or comparable fundraising initiatives.
  • Experience building, leading, and developing a comprehensive development function and team.
  • Experience partnering with boards and senior leaders to advance fundraising goals and engage significant direct and indirect contributors.
  • Proven ability to cultivate and secure support from corporations, foundations, prominent individuals, and mission-aligned organizations.
  • Experience developing sophisticated fundraising communications and cases for support.
  • Working knowledge of grant development and application processes for government and foundation opportunities.
  • Ability to establish measurable goals, monitor performance, and communicate progress to executive and board-level stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of the Middle East and willingness to travel and engage with potential donors and funders in the region.
  • Strong written, verbal, relationship-building, and presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of a foreign language that is relevant to MEI's work.
  • Professional, academic, travel, or living experience in the Middle East.
  • Fundraising experience within a policy, education, cultural, international affairs, or other mission-driven organization.


Leadership Competencies

  • Builder's mindset with the initiative to create systems, strengthen capabilities, and move strategy into action.
  • Strategic judgment and intellectual curiosity.
  • Diplomacy, discretion, and the ability to build trust with varied internal and external stakeholders.
  • Confidence balanced with humility and a willingness to listen, learn, and collaborate.
  • Resourceful, solutions-oriented approach and a strong bias for action.
  • Commitment to MEI's mission and to the responsible stewardship of donor relationships and institutional resources.


Benefits Package Includes:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life and disability insurance
  • 403(b) retirement plan
  • Paid holidays, plus vacation and sick leave

title: Full Stack Software Engineer (Senior)
description:

About Xe


Xe is a cross-border payments platform. We help SMEs and consumers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand collect, convert, hold, and send money across markets. Each year, over 300 million people use Xe for currency information and over 350,000 use us to send money overseas.


Today, we’re rebuilding the platform layer behind cross-border payments for corporate and consumer clients. We’re small enough that your code ships fast and your decisions matter, and Euronet Worldwide (Nasdaq: EEFT) backs us so the problems stay real-scale.


About This Role


We’re hiring a senior full-stack engineer who owns real problems end-to-end and shapes how the team builds, from API design and frontend experience through to backend services, production reliability, and launch. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.


You’ll write code that moves money in production, design and modernize the platform across the stack, and lead delivery of customer-facing features as Xe rebuilds its platform layer. title: Data Engineer (Forward Deployed)
description:
About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Data Engineer to help design, build, and operate the data foundations that underpin Nscale’s platform, internal operations, and customer-facing capabilities.

This is a high-impact, early-stage role. You’ll work closely with Operations, Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, Product, and Commercial teams to turn raw operational signals — from GPUs, clusters, customers, and internal systems — into reliable, scalable data products that ensure delivery at a previously unseen pace. You’ll help define how data is collected, modelled, served, and trusted across the company, and have the opportunity to build on Palantir Foundry, as well as other products.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building data systems from first principles, thrives in ambiguous environments, and wants to see their work directly influence product decisions, platform reliability, and customer outcomes.

What you'll be doing

Data Platform & Architecture

  • Design and build scalable, reliable data pipelines that ingest data from infrastructure, platform services, and business systems.
  • Define data models and schemas that support operational workflows and use cases across the business, monitoring, and analytics.
  • Clean, transform and structure the data to create a digital twin of Nscale.
  • Implement permissioning and manage access and security of the Foundry implementation.

Data Products & Enablement

  • Create trusted datasets and metrics that power workflows and processes, internal tools, and customer-facing insights.
  • Enable self-serve analytics by establishing clear data contracts, documentation, and semantic layers.
  • Build use cases including but not limited to capacity planning, cost optimisation, reliability analysis, and customer reporting to drive our business forward.
  • Collaborate with Product and Commercial teams to translate real-world questions into robust data solutions.

Reliability, Quality & Governance

  • Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and alerting to ensure data correctness and availability.
  • Codify data lineage, freshness, and consistency across systems.
  • Establish best practices around data versioning, access control, and governance appropriate for a fast-scaling company.
  • Continuously improve system resilience and observability.

Early-Stage Ownership & Growth

  • Take end-to-end ownership of projects, from design through to production and iteration.
  • Help define standards, tooling, and ways of working for data at Nscale.
  • Contribute to technical decision-making as the company scales its platform and customer base.
  • Act as a thought partner to engineers and operators, not just a service function.

About You

  • Deep, hands-on experience building in Palantir Foundry, including ontology modelling, pipeline development, API integration, and large-scale data platform design.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, with experience applying data engineering libraries and frameworks (e.g. Spark, PySpark, Dask, pandas) to work with large, complex datasets.
  • Familiarity with API-driven data integration, including REST, GraphQL, and Foundry Action APIs.
  • Practical experience working in Git-based development workflows, including code reviews, version control, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage environments where requirements evolve quickly.
  • Strong communication skills — able to explain data concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A bias toward ownership, pragmatism, and shipping useful solutions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and infrastructure telemetry.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems, monitoring data, or usage-based billing data.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing data products or platforms.

What we can offer you

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

  • Highly competitive package (base + equity) with reviews every 12 months. 🚀
  • Join the fastest-growing tech startup, your chance to push boundaries, collaborate with brilliant minds, and make your mark on cutting-edge AI. ✨
  • Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by trying new things, leading, challenging the status quo, and owning your impact, always with our full support.
  • Human-First Flexibility: We treat you as humans first. 🫶 Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.

Equal Opportunities Statement

We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

title: Electrical Supervisor
description:
Join Trant Engineering and help shape the delivery of complex, high-impact projects.

Trant Engineering is a leading EPC contractor with a strong reputation for delivering innovative engineering solutions across the UK and internationally. With over 1,000 employees and a £150m turnover, we’re growing—and now looking for an experienced Electrical Supervisor to play a key role in our project delivery teams.

The Role
As the Electrical Supervisor you'll be supervising and overseeing electrical teams and subcontractors on this Water project. You'll also be coordinating with mechanical and civil disciplines, ensuring compliance with UK electrical regulations, maintaining accurate documentation, and delivering electrical works safely, on time, and to specification.
1) Team Supervision & Leadership
  • Oversee electrical operatives and subcontractors on site.
  • Allocate work based on competence, project priorities, and programme requirements.
  • Monitor productivity, workmanship, and compliance with specifications.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior electrical staff.
2) Electrical Installation & Project Delivery
  • Oversee installation of electrical systems including containment, cabling, control panels, MCCs, motors, pumps, instrumentation interfaces, and power supplies.
  • Ensure electrical works comply with design drawings, schematics, and specifications.
  • Coordinate electrical activities with civil, mechanical, and process teams.
  • Support electrical testing, inspection, and commissioning activities.
3) Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)
  • Enforce site health, safety, and environmental procedures in line with UK legislation.
  • Ensure compliance with Electricity at Work Regulations 1989.
  • Conduct toolbox talks, risk assessments, and method statement briefings.
  • Ensure safe isolation, lock-off, and permit-to-work procedures are followed.
  • Investigate and report incidents, near-misses, and unsafe practices.
4) Quality Assurance & Compliance
  • Ensure electrical installations meet BS 7671 (IET Wiring Regulations) and project standards.
  • Inspect completed works and ensure defects are rectified promptly.
  • Support FAT/SAT, ITPs, and QA/QC processes.
  • Ensure compliance with client, regulatory, and water industry standards.
5) Documentation & Reporting
  • Maintain accurate records of daily activities, workforce attendance, and materials used.
  • Review and sign off electrical test results, inspection records, and commissioning documentation.
  • Assist in preparing progress reports, as-built records, and handover documentation.
  • Ensure electrical documentation is complete, accurate, and compliant.
6) Communication & Coordination
  • Liaise with Site Mangers and Client representatives.
  • Coordinate subcontractors and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of works.
  • Communicate progress, risks, and resource requirements effectively.
7) Core Values
  • Uphold and promote the Company’s Core Values – Care, Trust, Respect and Sustainability.
Essential
  • NVQ Level 3 or 4 in Electrical Installation or Electrical Engineering
  • 18th Edition Wiring Regulations (BS 7671)
  • Electrical installation on industrial or infrastructure projects (5-7years)
  • Experience in a supervisory role (2-3years)

title: Senior Spa Therapist
description:
Who we are

At LUSH cosmetics, we believe in making effective products from fresh, organic fruit and vegetables, the finest essential oils and safe synthetics. We aim to leave the world Lusher than we found it; and at the LUSH SPA, we’re passionate about improving your sense of well-being, so you can feel your best self. We believe our spa treatments are more than skin deep; they’re a vital self-care ingredient.

Our warm inviting spas are an oasis of calm, allowing time and space away from a busy world to relax and rejuvenate. Each Lush Spa treatment is an immersive experience, inviting you to enjoy the unexpected. Using a multi-sensory holistic approach, including soothing touch, visual displays, beautiful fragrances, and bespoke, crafted music made by Lush Fresh Handmade Sound, each treatment has a transformative effect, bringing you back into a state of peace and balance.

Who are we looking for?

Are you passionate about Lush products and delivering exceptional spa experiences? Are you a confident leader with strong operational and team management skills?

As a Senior Spa Therapist, you will support the Store & Spa Manager in delivering the vision and daily operations of the spa. You will lead by example, ensuring every client receives a 5-star experience while driving occupancy, sales, and team development.

You will be responsible for supervising therapists and receptionists, ensuring all Lush treatments are consistently available, and coordinating training to meet business demands. You will act as a brand ambassador, embodying Lush’s ethical values and commitment to outstanding customer experience.

Location: You will supervise the Covent Garden Spa, which will be your usual place of work. From time to time, you may be required to work in other stores, or to travel to training sessions, cover treatments in other spas, meetings or events - which may require an overnight stay. Working from home isn’t permitted.
Key Responsibilities

Sales

Maximise spa occupancy through effective scheduling.
Train and motivate shop floor teams to promote and sell spa vouchers.
Support and deliver internal and external spa events.
Perform treatments in line with business needs (minimum 80-90% of contracted hours).
Ensure all treatments are bookable daily and availability is clearly displayed.
Maintain spa menus, vouchers, and signage to a high standard.
Collaborate with local non-spa stores to drive voucher and product sales.
Responsible for Spa Ambassador training locally

Team Leadership

Lead from the front, delivering exceptional spa and shop floor experiences.
Lead therapists to perform outstanding experiences and increase spa product sales.
Create strong communication systems across spa and store teams.
Support new therapists, Hybrid therapists and spa apprentices’ onboarding, development plan, and their transition from training into the working spa
Support receptionist training.
Provide top-up training and injury prevention guidance.
Provide Book A Bath and Spa Party training.
Support recruitment of therapists and receptionists.
Promote wellbeing and foster a respectful, supportive team culture.
Ensure high standards are maintained and all staff adhere to them.
Attend and contribute to regular performance reviews with the Store & Spa Manager.

Operations

Support day-to-day spa operations including rota management, booking adjustments, and absence management including therapists with injuries.
Support the Store & Spa Manager with recruitment
Complete product, laundry, stock, and equipment orders accurately and on time.
Maintain high standards across treatment rooms, reception, shop floor, and back-of-house areas
Assist both clients and therapists when navigating complex medical conditions to ensure we deliver an exceptional customer experience.
Lead therapists to perform outstanding experiences and increase spa product sales.
Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and data privacy requirements.
Keep up to date with spa and business communications.
Assist with training schedules and treatment development plans.

Development

Take ownership of your professional growth and career goals, actively seek feedback and development opportunities, identify skill gaps and pursue learning opportunities, and use coaching, meetings, and reviews as tools for continuous improvement and development.


Skills & experience:
  • NVQ Level 3 qualification in Beauty Therapy or equivalent in Holistic Therapy, which includes full-body massage.
  • +1 year of practical work experience within a similar role and location performing body massages and facials.
  • Passionate about delivering excellent customer service and treatments.
  • Passionate about representing the LUSH brand, ethics and products both on the shop floor and in the spa.
  • Management Expereince
What’s in it for you?

We believe in investing in our Spa Therapists. Bespoke in-house 6 week training will be provided and supported by your Spa Manager and our UK Spa Trainers, where you’ll learn and receive certification of Lush’s accredited treatments. Becoming a LUSH Spa Therapist provides you with the opportunity to create a magical career whilst being trained to the highest level, allowing you to further develop core massage skills through our innovative treatments.

At Lush we understand the therapist's time and dedication to their client is a vital part of the role, therefore we support an average of 5 hours of body massage per day, equivalent to 5 treatments (this number can increase when performing short treatments), allowing you time to enjoy and perform at your best.

Employee Benefits
  • Fantastic in-house learning and development opportunities including all Lush Spa treatments, products and brand training (paid at your hourly rate)
  • Generous staff discount (50% on products and spa treatments, 10% on HairLab & Book a Bath experiences)
  • Enjoy 2 complimentary products of your choice per month
  • Available free handcare and mouthcare products during shifts for Spa Therapists
  • Team bonus scheme based on the overall sales of the store and spa
  • Pension scheme
  • Birthday Day Off
  • 28 day holiday allowance (calculated on a pro-rata basis)
  • Supportive parental leave scheme - 6 months of full pay (primary caregiver)
  • Financial childcare support on return to work (depending on contracted hours)
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Free Spa Therapist tunic
  • Employee assistance programme provided by Health Assured
  • Access to an online learning community
  • Therapist wellbeing initiatives (inc. Injury Prevention training, Alexander Technique workshops, rooms designed considering the Health & Safety of our Therapists, electric couches for therapist comfort)
  • Enjoy 4 complimentary spa treatments of your choice per year (to book every quarter)
  • Flexible rolling rotas - Shift patterns will vary from morning and afternoon/evening shifts (including weekends and bank holidays) based on the client demand of a Central London spa.
  • Productivity based bonus scheme.

title: Research Data Analyst (6-Month Fixed-Term Contract)
description:
About the role:

This is a 6-month Fixed-Term Contractual role.

Aurora Energy Research is a global energy analytics firm. Our India research team supports clients across the power and renewables sector with data and analysis. This role supports that work by keeping our transmission infrastructure records up to date, and by collecting and organising power network data for ongoing research projects.

This is a research and data role. You'll be doing both secondary research and primary market validation to track infrastructure developments, checking information against reliable sources, and keeping shared records current. You'll also be collecting and organizing technical network data for specific states as directed. Accuracy matters along with speed — everything you log should be checked and easy to trace back to its source.
1. Infrastructure tracking
  • Keep our transmission infrastructure records up to date as our research coverage expands to new states.
  • Research infrastructure projects online — status, timelines, route, capacity, developer — and log them accurately.
  • Collect market intelligence and on-the-ground information to help validate network developments and infrastructure plans.
  • Support the research team with data pulls and quick checks when needed.
2. Network data collection
  • Collect and organise power network data (substations, lines, voltage levels, capacity, interconnections) for states assigned to you.
  • Keep a clear record of where each piece of data came from and when it was collected.
  • Work to the priorities and timelines set by the team lead.
We will provide you with the base sources and formats to use for both workstreams but expect you to take up the initiative and explore other options.
Required attributes:
  • A degree in electrical engineering, power systems, energy engineering, transmission planning, or a related quantitative field.
  • Strong research skills, — including the ability to independently gather information from public sources, technical documents and industry stakeholders
  • High attention to detail and comfort with structured data entry (Excel at minimum).
  • Some understanding of India's power sector or grid infrastructure is helpful — we'll train you on the specifics.
Some of the benefits we include are:
  • Accidental, term life and medical insurance
  • Hybrid Work model
  • Employee’s Provident Fund Scheme
  • Maternity leave
  • A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture
  • Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects
The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavorable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity.

title: Junior Welfare Dean
description:
The Junior Welfare Deans support the Head of Wellbeing in the welfare role. This is a responsible position, in which the Junior Welfare Deans are frequently in the ‘front line’ of welfare support in the college, particularly in the evenings and at weekends - between week 0 and week 9, week days between 5.30pm and 8.30am and during the weekend, as well as during the Easter vacation.

They are expected to provide a timely and appropriate response to students with health or welfare issues, and to assist in maintaining agreed college regulations. They carry authority delegated by the Head of Wellbeing and should always act professionally, and in a manner which commands respect from undergraduate and graduate students. In particular, when on duty they need to be and remain able to carry out their duties promptly, properly and conscientiously at all times.

Relationships
Responsible to: The Head of Wellbeing
Liaison with: College Nurse, Lodge staff and the Dean
  • To deal with minor emergencies such as illness, urgent student welfare issues, and calls concerning College safety, outside normal working hours, and to help with crises.
  • To play an important role in supporting student welfare outside the tutorial relationship by providing ‘crisis support’ for students on a wide range of welfare issues, outside of office hours. The College will require (and pay for) the appointees – unless already recently undertaken – to go on relevant welfare training of 24 hours, and other relevant training.
  • To provide a handover to the Head of Wellbeing and Nurse regarding welfare support for students, and to meet weekly on Wednesday mornings (weeks 0-9) from 9.00-9.45am.
  • To meet regularly with the Head of Wellbeing and to attend any meetings set up in connection with welfare matters.
  • To attend Wellbeing Forum.
  • To work with the Lodge staff to deal with any problems of disruptive behaviour within college outside normal working hours1; to ensure that parties and other events end at the appointed time and in good order.
  • The Junior Welfare Dean on duty will support students that need to go to hospital in an ambulance for a serious condition. They will either go themselves and stay with the student until they are discharged into the care of a doctor, or they will ensure that another responsible member of College will accompany the student to hospital and stay with them until they have seen a doctor.
  • To respond to any examination emergencies that may arise outside office hours, where necessary, liaise with the relevant officers in college and university, and undergo the training required by the Proctors to be eligible to act as Invigilator in such cases.
  • To share information related to student welfare as appropriate with some/all of: the Dean (for matters of discipline), Head of Wellbeing and Nurse, (for matters of welfare), the appropriate College Officer, the College’s Peer Supporters, at the earliest convenience to ensure appropriate information-sharing and co-ordinated follow-up.
  • To help organise dissemination of information regarding welfare and community life to members of the College, in conjunction with the Head of Wellbeing and Nurse including briefing for new students in Freshers’ week.
  • To act as one of the College’s qualified First Aid team. The College will require (and pay for) the appointees – unless already recently qualified in first-aid – to go on a first aid course prior to appointment.
  • In exceptional circumstances an off-duty Junior Welfare Dean may be asked to assist with an ongoing incident.
  • The Junior Welfare Dean on duty will be contactable and may only leave the College provided that s/he is able to return quickly (within 10 minutes) if required.
  • To provide emergency cover if the night porter suffers an accident/illness until the on call porter arrives.
  • To support the other Junior Welfare Deans with difficult cases, giving advice and offering support.
  • Other duties as may from time to time be assigned.
1 Note that the Lodge Porters are the first port of call for issues such as maintenance problems, complaints about noise, vandals, trespassing, fire alarms, and violations of College Regulations. The role of the Junior Deans is to act as back-up in difficult cases.
Essential
  1. Enrolled on a full-time graduate research or graduate medical course at the University of Oxford (at any college) for the entirety of the appointment.
  2. An appreciation of the welfare and disciplinary issues relevant within a student community.
  3. Excellent communication skills; able to form positive relationships and obtain the confidence of all sections of the College, in particular the Junior Members. Liaison with the JCR and MCR welfare representatives will be an important and valuable part of the role, as well as with Peer Supporters.
  4. Experience of working with confidentiality, discretion, tact and diplomacy.
  5. Evidence of committed, enthusiastic and resilient nature.
  6. Evidence of mature and good judgement.
  7. Able to respond and act appropriately on own initiative and with a high degree of flexibility in response to a wide range of unpredictable situations, if necessary, unguided.
  8. Valid First Aid at Work Certificate or willingness to train to become a qualified first aider.
  9. Willing and able to take a flexible approach to duties, working unsociable hours including evenings and weekends.
  10. Available (with forward planning) for some meetings and other commitments on weekdays.
Desirable
  1. Experience of relevant voluntary or welfare work.
  2. Experience of working with the public and/or in a customer service environment.
  3. Experience of dealing with emergencies e.g. accidents, thefts, fire evacuations etc.
  4. We strongly encourage graduate students from LMH to apply and will give preference to internal applicants.
The salary will be £5,820.96 per annum (at current rates). The anticipated start date will be ASAP after interview and the contract will run until the 20th August 2027 unless extending a further year.
The jobholder will be required to work in a rota with the other Junior Welfare Deans to ensure consistent coverage of Welfare Support during term time and across the Easter vacation. They will be expected to attend the weekly briefing through the whole term even when not on call.
Junior Welfare Deans are expected to provide consent for their line manager (Head of Wellbeing) to undertake an annual check with their academic supervisor to ensure they are able to fulfil their academic commitments alongside this role.

Benefits of working for the College include single student accommodation in College, the option to join a University pension scheme.

Other benefits include up to 3 meals per day when the kitchens are open (currently the kitchens are closed on a Sunday). These meals are for your own personal use and are non-transferrable.

Applicants must be eligible to work in the UK. Applications particularly welcomed from current LMH graduate students.

To apply for this position, please press the 'Apply Now' button and submit a covering letter explaining why you are suitable for this role and your CV.

Deadline for applications: midnight Sunday 11th October 2026.

Interviews are expected to take place on Wednesday 21st October 2026.

title: Administratief Medewerker Employee Benefits Volmacht
description:
In deze functie start je op de administratie op de afdeling Employee Benefits Volmacht. Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat werknemers van onze relaties goed verzekerd zijn op het gebied van ongevallen, overlijdensrisico en WIA-verzuimverzekeringen. Dankzij jouw inzet kunnen we de juiste ondersteuning bieden aan onze relaties, waardoor zij met een gerust hart het gesprek kunnen aangaan met hun werknemers in geval van arbeidsongeschiktheid. Wil je meer weten over deze uitdagende rol? Lees dan verder!

Wat ga je doen?

De afdeling Employee Benefits behandelt alle verzekeringen die met het personeel van onze zakelijke relaties te maken hebben. Hierbij kun je denken aan pensioen, inkomen (ziekte /arbeidsongeschiktheid) en zorg. Op de afdeling Employee Benefits vinden diverse werkzaamheden plaats. We adviseren relaties over hun risico’s, we bemiddelen richting een verzekeringsoplossing en we bieden uitgebreide administratieve ondersteuning.

Jouw functie
Je komt te werken in ons Volmacht Employee Benefits team dat namens verzekeraars offertes mag uitbrengen, risico’s mag accepteren en schades mag afhandelen. Als administratief medewerker heb je een uitdagende functie waarin je samen met jouw collega’s verantwoordelijk bent voor een correcte polis administratie. Je beantwoordt vragen over bijvoorbeeld nota’s en verwerkt mutaties.

Wat breng je mee?

Je bent servicegericht en je gaat zeer nauwkeurig te werk. Je hebt een hands-on mentaliteit, bent accuraat en een zelfstarter. Je staat open voor ontwikkeling, bent leergierig en stressbestendig. Verder neem je graag initiatief in bijvoorbeeld verbeter voorstellen en ben je communicatief en sociaal sterk.

Jouw toekomst

We vinden het belangrijk dat jij je snel thuis voelt bij Meijers.

Voor een goede start volg je samen met andere nieuwe medewerkers een uitgebreide onboarding. Hier leer je de verschillende afdelingen en collega’s kennen. Bij Meijers vinden we het belangrijk dat jij in je kracht staat en denken wij graag met je mee met jouw ambities. Jouw ontwikkeling staat centraal, we moedigen doorgroeimogelijkheden aan.

Enthousiast geworden?

Solliciteer via onderstaand online formulier met jouw cv en korte motivatie. Heb je nog vragen? Stel ze gerust! Neem contact op Romy van Schaik (Corporate Recruiter), via 06 185 812 00.

Sollicitanten die wij uitnodigen voor een arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek, worden na dit gesprek gescreend. Deze screening is een onderdeel van het sollicitatieproces.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze advertentie wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

Wat verwachten we van je?

• In het bezit of de bereidheid om de Wft basis en Wft Inkomen te behalen
• Goede beheersing van MS Office
• Je bent bekend met draaitabellen, grafieken en/of verticaal zoeken in Excel pré
• Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift

Wat kun je van ons verwachten?

• Een salaris tussen € 2.800,- en € 3.400,- o.b.v. 40 uur afhankelijk van ervaring en opleiding en reiskostenvergoeding
• Een 13e maand
• Een uitstekende pensioenregeling met slechts 3% eigen bijdrage en korting op diverse verzekeringen
• 29 vakantiedagen en 1 bedrijfsvrijekeuzedag (o.b.v. 40 uur)
• Hybride werken waarvan 60% op kantoor
• Geen parkeerplek, wel bieden wij een aantrekkelijke e-bike leaseregeling aan met een bijdrage van Meijers, of een NS Business Card voor comfortabel reizen met het OV

title: Lead Database Engineer
description:
We're currently looking to bring a Lead Database Engineer onto our team. This position gives you the opportunity to engage with intricate data infrastructure that powers essential operations across the organization at scale. You'll join colleagues who place high value on technical rigor, creative problem-solving, and a forward-thinking mindset toward sustaining resilient systems. This role suits professionals who thrive on solving demanding database architecture puzzles and who want to leave a lasting mark on system dependability.

Responsibilities

  • Map out Cassandra cluster rollouts by calculating expected data volumes and pinpointing hardware needs tied to anticipated data growth and transaction throughput
  • Handle the complete setup, installation, and configuration process for brand-new Cassandra clusters
  • Utilize monitoring solutions to keep tabs on cluster uptime and general performance levels
  • Convert and export stored information into different file formats to support various downstream applications
  • Leverage primary and secondary indexing strategies correctly to ensure queries run efficiently against stored data
  • Perform data backup and recovery operations to safeguard systems in case of unexpected failures
  • Adjust performance parameters governing the Java Virtual Machine, caching layers, and compaction routines
  • Execute stress testing on Cassandra clusters and analyze the performance data that results

Requirements

  • A minimum of five years of practical, applicable work experience in the field
  • At least one year spent leading and directing development teams
  • Extensive expertise designing and constructing Cassandra or comparable NoSQL database platforms
  • Some level of exposure to Astra or AWS Keyspaces technologies
  • Hands-on ability with Cassandra data modeling, NoSQL architectural design, and management of keyspaces, tables, indexes, user provisioning, and permission settings
  • Thorough understanding of Cassandra's internal operations, covering the gossip protocol, hinted handoff mechanisms, read repair functionality, and Merkle tree structures
  • Practical familiarity with Linux environments and Java configuration settings
  • Working knowledge of MongoDB
  • Awareness of how tombstones function along with garbage collection and purging practices
  • Experience managing, maintaining, and supporting clusters through tools like Opscenter, Devcenter, Linux, and Spark
  • Competency writing CQL queries that facilitate integration with Cassandra cluster environments
  • Foundational experience setting up CI/CD pipeline configurations
  • Strong communication ability paired with B2-level English proficiency or higher, supporting accurate interpretation of business needs and their conversion into agentic architecture designs

Nice to have

  • Hands-on background with DataStax Enterprise (DSE)
  • Working exposure to AWS services, covering at least EC2, S3, and IAM
  • Experience connecting systems using Solr and Spark integrations
  • Familiarity with CI/CD and automation platforms such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or TeamCity
  • Understanding of infrastructure tools like Terraform and CloudFormation, along with Python programming

Benefits

title: Sr. Analyst (Research)
description:
A — Research Conceptualisation & Design

  • Problem formulation: framing research questions; constructing testable hypotheses/propositions; literature synthesis and gap identification; developing conceptual/theoretical frameworks
  • Understanding of skill ecosystem: Prior work or academic experience of skill ecosystem
  • Methodological design: selecting research paradigm (quantitative / qualitative / mixed); choosing design (survey, experiment, case study, ethnography, longitudinal); operationalising constructs into measurable variables
  • Sampling design: probability vs. non-probability strategies; sample-size and power estimation; weighting and representativeness; frame construction
  • Instrument development: questionnaire and item writing; interview/FGD protocol design; scale development, piloting and validation
  • Research governance: ethics and informed consent; securing IRB/ethical clearance and administrative approvals; data-protection and privacy compliance

  • Field operations: enumerator recruitment, training and supervision; fieldwork logistics and scheduling; real-time monitoring

  • Quantitative analysis: descriptive statistics; inferential testing and regression; advanced methods (multivariate, psychometrics/IRT, equating, causal inference); tool fluency (R, Python, SPSS, Stata)
  • Qualitative analysis: thematic and content analysis; grounded-theory coding; QDA software (NVivo, etc.)
  • Interpretation & synthesis: pattern and trend identification; triangulation across sources; data visualisation for insight

D— Communication, Report writing

  • Dissemination: presentation and public speaking; data storytelling; conference/workshop facilitation
  • Stakeholder engagement & policy translation: policy-brief writing; audience-tailored messaging; advisory and consultative engagement with policymakers, practitioners and the public

E- Transversal / Foundational skills

  • Research ethics and integrity; project and time management; digital and data literacy; critical thinking and problem-solving; collaboration and teamwork; multilingual/field-language competence; adaptability under field conditions.

· Masters or above in Economics, Statistics, Data Science

· Engineers with Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Analytics

1Experience:

1. 3-8 years of working experience in the relevant field depending on the requirement of the level.

3. Prior experience of working in skill ecosystem

4. Deployed ML techniques in analysis

6. Ability to write analytical reports

title: Microsoft Developer
description:
Zin in niet zomaar een job maar wel om 'echt' zinvol werk aan te gaan met mensen? Dat kan… bij DELA! Hoe wij dat doen? Wel, … op onze manier, de DELA-manier. Al meer dan 80 jaar luisteren wij, zorgen we voor raad en daad & geven wij die warme professionele houvast.

Of het nu gaat over een verzekering, een repatriëring, nabestaandenzorg of de uitvaart zelf, mensen ontzorgen in één van de moeilijkste momenten van hun leven. Dat is wat onze job zinvol maakt en ons de energie geeft om er altijd te staan als één team.

Als MS Dynamics 365 Functioneel CRM Specialist/Developer word jij één van de belangrijkste interne aanspreekpunten voor ons Dynamics 365 CRM-platform. Je vormt de brug tussen gebruikers, businessprocessen en technologie. Daarbij analyseer je behoeften vanuit de business, vertaal je deze naar slimme oplossingen binnen Dynamics 365 CRM en zorg je ervoor dat gebruikers elke dag kunnen rekenen op een performant en stabiel platform. Deze rol biedt een unieke kans om mee interne expertise op te bouwen en een directe impact te maken op de verdere ontwikkeling van een strategische CRM-omgeving die dagelijks wordt gebruikt binnen DELA.

Wat je doet als Microsoft Dynamics 365 Functioneel CRM Specialist/Developer bij DELA
Elke werkdag bij DELA draait om betekenisvol contact. In deze rol komt het erop aan om:

  • Businessnoden te vertalen naar efficiënte en toekomstgerichte oplossingen binnen Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM
  • Dynamics 365 CRM te configureren, optimaliseren en verder uit te bouwen in functie van de noden van gebruikers
  • Oplossingen te realiseren met het Microsoft Power Platform, waaronder Power Apps en Power Automate
  • Incidenten en gebruikersvragen te analyseren, op te lossen en structurele verbeteringen voor te stellen
  • Intensief samen te werken met Customer Care, Sales, Product Owners, leveranciers en andere stakeholders om processen verder te digitaliseren
  • Mee te werken aan releases, testen, upgrades en de verdere evolutie van het CRM-platform.

Wie jij bent (en wat jij meebrengt)
Volgende troeven zoeken we in jou:

  • Minstens 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring met Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM (Customer Engagement), waardoor je snel mee kan bouwen aan onze Dynamics-omgeving
  • Zeer goede kennis van het Nederlands en het Engels
  • Ervaring met configuratie, implementatie of optimalisatie van Dynamics 365-oplossingen
  • Ervaring met Agile/scrum
  • Kennis van het Microsoft Power Platform, waaronder Power Apps en Power Automate, vormt een sterke meerwaarde
  • Kennis van een gereguleerde omgeving (bank- en verzekeringswereld) is een plus
  • Het vermogen om businessnoden te vertalen naar gebruiksvriendelijke en duurzame CRM-oplossingen
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en een natuurlijke vlotheid in de samenwerking met gebruikers, stakeholders en IT-collega's
  • Ownership, verantwoordelijkheidszin en de motivatie om uit te groeien tot hét interne aanspreekpunt voor Dynamics 365 CRM
  • Een klantgerichte en oplossingsgerichte mindset, gecombineerd met de drive om processen continu te verbeteren.

title: Senior Gameplay Animator (contract)
description:

title: Data Analist KBC Verzekeringen
description:
Als Data-analist ben je de brug tussen de business en IT. Je vertaalt databehoeften binnen KBC Verzekeringen naar praktische en schaalbare oplossingen die medewerkers helpen om efficiënter te werken en betere beslissingen te nemen.


Je werkt daarvoor nauw samen met verschillende businessafdelingen en IT. Je denkt mee over de juiste aanpak, helpt tools, rapportages en dashboards ontwikkelen en zorgt ervoor dat eindgebruikers toegang hebben tot betrouwbare en veilige data.

title: Editor – International Boat Industry (IBI)
description:
IBI is seeking an experienced, forward-thinking Editor to lead its editorial strategy and content output across all platforms. This is a high-profile, ambassadorial role responsible for maintaining the brand’s market-leading position while driving editorial innovation.

The Editor will oversee a small in-house editorial team – including a Digital Editor and Deputy Editor – and manage a broad network of international contributors. The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable shaping long-term editorial vision, producing high-quality content, and representing the brand on the global stage.

This role is based in our 240 Blackfriars Road office

Key Responsibilities

Editorial Leadership & Strategy

  • Define and execute IBI’s editorial strategy across print, digital, and event platforms.
  • Ensure the highest journalistic standards and uphold IBI’s reputation for authoritative, insightful content.
  • Oversee the planning, commissioning, editing, and production of all editorial outputs.
  • Identify opportunities to evolve IBI’s digital presence, including new formats and audience engagement strategies.

Team & Contributor Management

Industry Engagement & Brand Ambassadorship

  • Serve as a visible spokesperson for the brand, maintaining IBI’s trusted status within the marine industry.

Events and Conferences

  • Working closely with key stakeholders to lead the editorial input and content delivery across IBI’s portfolio of conferences and awards.
  • First hand media experience of leisure marine sector essential. Minimum 5 years’ experience required.
  • Proven experience in an editorial leadership role, specifically within B2B or specialist media.
  • Strong understanding of multi-platform content strategies (print, digital, video, events).
  • Exceptional editing, writing, and commissioning skills.
  • Confident public speaker, comfortable hosting events and moderating panels.
  • Experience managing journalists and working with international contributors.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with senior executives and industry stakeholders.

Personal Attributes

  • Professional, credible, and confident in front of audiences.

This role offers the chance to contribute to an industry-leading publication with a global reputation for excellence. You’ll work with a talented team in a collaborative and forward-thinking environment, shaping the narrative of one of the world’s most prestigious sectors.

If you’re ready to take your editorial career to new heights and create content that resonates with an elite and discerning audience, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and become a part of the BOAT International legacy.

Boat International is an Informa Group Company. We work hard to make sure Life at Informa is rewarding, supportive and enjoyable for everyone. But don’t just take our word for it – see what our colleagues have to say at LifeAt.Informa.com

title: QA Engineer
description:

This role is intended for an experienced QA automation engineer who combines strong QA skills with automation experience in C#/.NET, Azure, cloud architecture, and hands-on experience using AI coding agents, AI-assisted development platforms, and agentic development workflows in production software engineering.

We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to work in our market leading On Demand Migration SaaS offering. title: Senior Security Engineer,Detection & Incident Response
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure is seeking a hands-on Senior Security Engineer to drive security operations from our Prague, Czech Republic location. In this role, you will contribute to operational excellence across incident response, threat hunting, threat intelligence integration, detection engineering, and security automation, bringing real-time visibility and rapid response to our 24/7 global security operations environment.

This is a technical delivery and execution role, not a traditional monitoring position. You will work closely with detection engineers, threat intelligence analysts, incident response leadership, and our global Security Operations teams to build and refine detections, improve signal quality, execute threat hunts, automate workflows, and respond to complex security incidents with speed and precision.

Success in this role is measured not by alert volume, but by signal quality, real threat detection, incident containment speed, automation maturity, and the effectiveness of response workflows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Detection Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain detections in Splunk and related security platforms. Develop detection-as-code content using formats such as YAML/JSON, incorporate unit and regression testing, map coverage to MITRE ATT&CK, and contribute to Sigma/YARA-L coverage expansion.
  • Incident Response & Triage: Investigate suspicious activity and participate in incident triage, scoping, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident reviews. Use lessons from investigations to continuously improve detection and response processes.
  • Threat Hunting: Execute hypothesis-driven threat hunts using MITRE ATT&CK, the Diamond Model, kill chains, threat intelligence, behavioral baselines, and anomaly detection. Correlate signals across endpoint, cloud, identity, SaaS, network, and other security telemetry to identify real threats and operational blind spots.
  • Detection Quality: Continuously tune detections to improve true-positive rates and reduce alert fatigue. Identify which signals provide meaningful security value and refine detection logic based on investigation outcomes and changes in the threat landscape.
  • Threat Intelligence Integration: Operationalize cyber threat intelligence (CTI) by mapping adversary tools, techniques, TTPs, and indicators to the Everpure environment and translating relevant intelligence into detection and hunting strategies.
  • Automation & Orchestration: Build Python scripts, API integrations, enrichment workflows, and SOAR automation using platforms such as Tines, XSOAR, or equivalent. Develop workflows that reduce manual effort and accelerate investigation and containment while maintaining appropriate guardrails and logging.
  • Cloud & Container Security Monitoring: Monitor and investigate security signals across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including CloudTrail, GuardDuty, and cloud audit logs. Identify container and Kubernetes runtime anomalies and contribute to monitoring cloud-native attack surfaces.
  • Agentic & AI-Assisted Workflows: Evaluate and implement AI-assisted security workflows, including LLM-based investigation and autonomous triage capabilities. Assess AI-generated detection logic while maintaining appropriate human oversight and guardrails.
  • Playbooks & Documentation: Develop and refine detection playbooks, investigation procedures, automated security playbooks, and operational runbooks to improve consistency, investigation rigor, and response effectiveness.
  • Security Operations Development: Help build detection content addressing threats such as credential abuse, privilege escalation, lateral movement, cloud misuse, insider risk, sensitive data movement, and unauthorized access.
  • Detection-as-Code & Automation Infrastructure: Contribute to Git-backed detection repositories, CI/CD processes, testing frameworks, enrichment pipelines, remediation workflows, and response automation designed to reduce analyst toil and improve response times.
  • Global Collaboration: Partner with global Security Operations teams and contribute to a SOC culture focused on operational excellence, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
  • We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Prague, Czech Republic office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity, incident response, detection engineering, security operations, or a related security discipline.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience executing threat hunts, complex incident investigations, or detection engineering within a SOC or SIEM environment.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Splunk, including search, dashboards, alerts, correlation searches, saved searches, deployment server, and forwarder management.
  • Strong understanding of the complete incident response lifecycle, including triage, scoping, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident learning.
  • Strong knowledge of networking, operating systems, cloud environments, and security architecture across identity, endpoint, network, and cloud.
  • Experience developing Python scripts for data processing, API integrations, security tooling, and automation.
  • Strong understanding of threat intelligence and attacker frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK, the Diamond Model, kill chains, and TTPs.
  • Hands-on experience with threat hunting methodologies, including hypothesis-driven hunting, behavioral baselines, and anomaly detection.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Strongly Preferred:

  • Detection-as-code experience, including Sigma, ECMA/JSON detection formats, Git-backed detection repositories, unit testing, MITRE ATT&CK coverage mapping, Splunk Security Content, or similar detection frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with security automation and SOAR platforms such as Tines, XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, or equivalent, including API-driven enrichment and response workflows.
  • Cloud security operations experience across AWS, GCP, and/or Azure, including CloudTrail, GuardDuty, cloud audit logs, and cloud-native attack surfaces.
  • Container and Kubernetes security experience, including Falco, container runtime monitoring, image scanning, vulnerability management, or software supply chain security.
  • Experience evaluating or implementing agentic or AI-assisted security workflows, including LLM-assisted investigations, autonomous triage, or AI-generated detections, with an understanding of appropriate guardrails and human oversight.
  • Experience operationalizing threat intelligence, including PIRs, CTI-to-detection pipelines, and intelligence-driven threat hunting.
  • Experience with Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages and exposure to infrastructure-as-code technologies such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Experience working within follow-the-sun security operations models and with security operations metrics such as MTTD, MTTA, and MTTC.
  • Experience with Attack Surface Management, including secret hygiene, identity attack surface, and Shadow AI.
  • Relevant certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, AWS Security Specialty, CKS, or equivalent.

#LI-ONSITE

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out for more information.

title: Analytics Lead
description:
At Zinc, we're rapidly technologising how we serve candidates, recruiters, and customers, without eroding what makes our service genuinely good. Core Ops is the team making sure the business runs on real, trustworthy data, and this role is the technical core of that: turning raw data into a clean, reliable foundation the rest of the business builds on.

You'll report directly to the Head of Operations, and work closely with the Commercial Ops Lead, Customer Lead, and Tech's data engineering team. This starts as an individual contributor role today, with a clear path to people management as the data team is growing in the first half of 2027.

This team is data, analytics, and modelling focused. You'll take the data Zinc already has and truly optimise it: making it fit for purpose, statistically sound, and genuinely trustworthy. The rest of the Ops team (Commercial Ops Lead, Customer Lead, and their analysts) handle business operations and general analysis, but this role is the deep specialist behind that.

We're open to diverse backgrounds that bring transferable skills to this role, but expect the ideal candidate to come from one of the following:
  • Analytics Engineer / Data and Analytics Lead
  • Data Engineer with strong analytics/BI experience
  • Senior Data Analyst ready to move into data modelling ownership
  • Partner with business leads across the company to turn a stated problem into a clear, defined, reproducible metric.
  • Own the data modelling and transformation layer, build and maintain the BI/reporting layer the business relies on as its single source of truth.
  • Write SQL and build data models hands-on, working closely with Tech's data engineering team on the underlying warehouse.
  • Keep data quality high, catch and prevent the kind of data issues that undermine trust in reporting.
  • Define the marker points (the thresholds for what counts as a real trend or anomaly on core metrics) and proactively flag business leads when something crosses them, so decisions come from historical-trend evidence, not gut feel.
  • Grow into managing a small team as the function scales.
  • Strong SQL and data modelling experience, ideally in a BI/data warehouse context
  • Comfortable owning a BI tool (we use Sigma) as the organisation's single source of truth
  • Track record turning ambiguous business questions into clean, reproducible data answers
  • Applied statistics: confident telling signal from noise. That means trend and anomaly detection, cohort and retention analysis, and regression to understand what's really driving a metric (for example, which account signals predict churn, or what moves turnaround times). Experience with forecasting or survival analysis is a plus. You know when a simple method is the right answer, and when the data can't support a stronger claim.
  • People management potential: Ready and excited to grow their own small team of analysts over the next year
  • Platform-minded: builds durable, reusable models rather than one-off pulls for whoever asks loudest
  • Comfortable being a shared resource: prioritises competing asks from multiple stakeholders fairly, without a single dedicated backlog
  • Growth-oriented: genuinely motivated by the path toward leading a data function, not just executing tickets
  • 24 days holiday + Bank Holidays + your birthday off 🎉
  • £1200 annual benefits allowance (ThanksBen, from month 2)
  • Early finish Fridays (16:00)
  • Yearly company retreat abroad ✈️
  • 30 days to Work from anywhere 🌍
  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, and Adoption Leave (13 weeks full pay, 17 weeks half pay, then SMP for maternity, 1 month full pay for paternity/adoption) 🐣
  • Statutory pension with NEST (3% employer, 5% employee)

  • Company socials, quarterly team socials Free Monday lunches
  • Nursery workplace benefit scheme (Yellownest)
  • Option to lease an electric car through Electric Car Scheme
  • Celebrated Zinc anniversaries 🥳

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Overview

This role requires deep expertise in legacy .NET Framework UI development (C#, WinForms, DevExpress) and modern ReactJS-based web applications.   • Establish frontend engineering standards, best practices, and design patterns
  • Deliver scalable, accessible, maintainable and performant UI solutions aligned with US healthcare compliance needs
  • Mentor frontend engineers and provide technical leadership in the team

description:
Encoded Therapeutics Inc. is a biotechnology company advancing precision medicines for a broad range of genetic disorders. Our mission is to unlock new opportunities for viral gene therapy through genomics-driven discovery. We focus on delivering life-changing advances for individuals with genetic disorders not addressable with current approaches. For more information, please visit .

Position details

We are seeking a highly motivated medical writer to join our medical writing team as an Associate Director or Senior Manager.

Reporting into the Head of Medical Writing, the Associate Director/Senior Manager of Medical Writing (Clinical and Regulatory) serves as a scientific and strategic lead responsible for researching, authoring, editing, and managing high-quality clinical and regulatory documents in support of Encoded’s programs.

Working in partnership with colleagues across Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Biometrics, Medical Affairs, Commercial, CMC, Nonclinical Development, and executive leadership, this individual will help interpret data, formulate key messaging, and drive the development of regulatory and clinical documents. These documents include clinical study protocols and clinical protocol amendments, Investigator Brochures, responses to regulatory authority questions, clinical study reports, patient narratives, clinical development plans, IND submissions, integrated summary reports, and components of Modules 1 and 2 of BLA/MAA submissions.

The role will also support the continued development of medical writing infrastructure and processes, including best practices and resources for document management and timelines, template and shell creation, lexicon and document QC, publishing, and editing standards.

Responsibilities

  • Own and manage assigned clinical, regulatory, and preclinical deliverables in support of Encoded’s programs. Documents may include clinical study protocols; Investigator Brochures; clinical study reports; components of Modules 1, 2, and 5 of BLAs; INDs/CTDs and amendments; analysis and development plans; safety updates and annual reports; narratives and summaries; briefing books; and other key program documents.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to analyze and interpret clinical data, including internal and external data sources, and translate findings into clear, scientifically accurate content, conclusions, and key messaging; perform literature and scientific database searches as needed to support analyses and background summaries.
  • Contribute medical writing expertise on cross-functional teams, helping shape document strategy, organization, and messaging while supporting consistency, efficiency, and clarity across assigned deliverables.
  • Support the development and implementation of scalable medical and scientific writing infrastructure, including templates, shells, processes, standards, style guides, workflows, operating procedures, document QC practices, publishing readiness, and editing standards.
  • Develop realistic timelines for assigned deliverables in collaboration with cross-functional teams, manage multiple writing projects in parallel, communicate risks or resource needs, and coordinate workload with the Head of Medical Writing to meet program goals.
  • Collaborate with internal and external authors, vendors, service providers, and clinical investigators to support document development, align on expectations, and track milestones and deliverables.
  • Coordinate review cycles and incorporate or adjudicate comments from internal and external stakeholders, producing final deliverables that are high quality, scientifically accurate, compliant, and aligned to agreed key messages.
  • Ensure document content, format, and style adhere to applicable company standards, style guides, and regulatory requirements, including ICH, FDA, EMA, and other appropriate guidelines.
  • Review Statistical Analysis Plans and Tables, Figures, and Listings to support appropriate data presentation for clinical study reports and other regulatory documents; provide feedback to project teams as needed.
  • Develop and maintain scientific, medical, regulatory, and technical knowledge relevant to Encoded’s pipeline, gene therapy platform, clinical studies, and disease areas.

Requirements

  • Advanced scientific degree (PhD, PharmD, MD, or equivalent) preferred with a minimum of 5+ years of biopharmaceutical or scientific, medical or regulatory experience, or a Master’s degree with 8+ years, or a Bachelor’s degree in molecular biology, genetics, or a related scientific discipline with 12+ years of relevant experience.
  • Prior work experience at a biotech or pharmaceutical company is preferred; experience in a smaller company or rare disease environment is ideal.
  • Writers with multiple contributions to BLA/NDA submissions are preferred.
  • A strong background and track record of producing high-quality scientific and medical documents for internal and external distribution is required.
  • Ability to work, communicate, and collaborate with colleagues and external stakeholders as a team player with transparency in a data-driven, fast-paced, and exciting environment.
  • Capability and comfort with prioritizing multiple projects, deliverables, and timelines, exercising thoughtful judgment, and applying strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Ability to think ahead and identify opportunities for change and improvement, with an emphasis on operations and efficiency.
  • Exceptional computer skills and familiarity with key software and cloud-based programs for document creation (e.g., Microsoft Office, Adobe, etc.) and sharing/editing (e.g., SharePoint, GraphPad, etc.).
