IT Infrastructure Project Manager - £70,000 - Kingston, Surrey - Hybrid

Prince 2 - Project Manager - Service Delivery - Agile

A well established, tech business based in Kingston, Surrey are looking for a proactive, organised and delivery-focused IT Project Manager & Service Delivery Manager to join their Technology Team.

This is a broad and highly visible role, responsible for bringing structure, governance and accountability to the delivery of IT and infrastructure projects, while also supporting effective technology service operations.

You will work across technical teams, business stakeholders, finance and third-party suppliers to ensure projects and operational activity are delivered in line with agreed scope, priorities, budgets, service requirements and business outcomes.


A key part of the role will be providing clear visibility of delivery health, operational risk, incidents, dependencies, supplier performance and financial position. You will be comfortable bringing structure to ambiguity, coordinating multiple workstreams and ensuring actions are owned and followed through to completion.


We are particularly interested in people who have a strong track record of managing complex IT projects and service operations within a structured or regulated environment, and who can build exceptional collaboration across organisational and technical boundaries.


Key Responsibilities


Project Delivery & Governance

  • Manage the structured delivery of IT and infrastructure projects, translating business and technology priorities into clear, achievable project plans.
  • Define and maintain milestones, risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies and key decisions throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Establish effective delivery cadence across assigned projects and workstreams, including governance meetings, status reviews and stakeholder updates.
  • Maintain robust project documentation, change control and audit-ready governance artefacts.
  • Identify delivery risks and blockers early, driving appropriate actions and escalation to keep projects on track.


Reporting & Stakeholder Management

  • Own regular project and service reporting, providing clear and concise updates on progress, delivery confidence, RAID status, supplier activity, financial position, key decisions and required escalations.
  • Maintain RAID logs and action trackers, ensuring risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies are clearly documented, owned, reviewed and actively managed.
  • Develop clear “path to green” plans where delivery is off track or at risk.
  • Work effectively with technical specialists, operational teams, business stakeholders, Finance and external suppliers to maintain alignment and resolve blockers.
  • Facilitate meetings and discussions in a way that drives clear decisions, ownership and follow-through.


Financial & Supplier Management

  • Support financial management across IT projects and technology services.
  • Track budgets, forecast costs, monitor purchase orders, review invoices and provide visibility of supplier spend and variances.
  • Coordinate internal and third-party delivery workstreams, ensuring supplier activity and technical dependencies remain aligned with agreed scope and commitments.
  • Promote strong supplier accountability and ensure commercial and operational obligations are understood and managed.


Service & Incident Management

  • Support technology service management activities and contribute to maintaining effective operational performance.
  • Coordinate live incidents when required, ensuring clear communication, stakeholder updates and appropriate escalation.
  • Support post-incident reviews, root cause follow-up and remediation tracking through to completion.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of the technology service catalogue and associated service management processes.
  • Help strengthen operational resilience, transparency, accountability and predictability across the Technology function.


Continuous Improvement

  • Identify and implement improvements to project delivery and service management ways of working.
  • Help establish consistent, efficient and transparent delivery processes across the Technology Team.
  • Embrace technology and AI-enabled tools to improve productivity, reporting, documentation and service management.


You will be an experienced technology delivery professional who combines strong project management and governance skills with a practical understanding of IT service.



The salary on offer for this role is up to £70,000 plus bonus and benefits.

title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
description:
Overview

Walker Morris is a law firm with a clear strategy, strong momentum and the confidence to keep moving forward. We've built a reputation for delivering exceptional client service while remaining agile, entrepreneurial and future-focused. As we continue to grow, we're investing in the technology, innovation and digital capabilities that will help shape the next chapter of our success.

This is a rare opportunity to join our leadership team as Chief Technology Officer and play a central role in that journey. Reporting directly to the Managing Partner and working closely with the Board and partners, you'll help define how technology, data and AI support our strategic ambitions, strengthen our competitive position and enhance the experience we deliver to clients and our people.

For technology leaders, this is a rare opportunity to combine genuine visibility, influence and pace. As a single-site firm, decisions can be made quickly, relationships are built face-to-face and initiatives can move from idea to implementation without the complexity often found in larger multi-office organisations. You'll have the opportunity to see the direct impact of your work across the firm and help shape decisions at the highest level.

If you're looking for a role where you can move beyond operational leadership and play an active part in the future direction of a successful and ambitious law firm, we'd love to hear from you.

As the Chief Technology Officer, you will be responsible for:

  • Defining and delivering a technology, digital, data and AI strategy that enables the firm's ambitions.
  • Championing innovation and the adoption of new technologies that improve client service and business performance.
  • Leading business-critical technology and transformation programmes from strategy through to delivery.
  • Ensuring the firm's technology, cyber security and data capabilities are robust, secure and future-focused.
  • Building high-performing teams and strong partnerships across the business.
  • Providing strategic leadership as a member of the Executive Board, contributing to the wider success of Walker Morris.

What we are looking for:

  • A proven technology leader with experience shaping and delivering enterprise technology strategy within a complex organisation.
  • A track record of leading large-scale technology and business transformation, turning strategy into measurable outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of data, digital and AI, with experience using technology to drive innovation, efficiency and commercial value.
  • Experience overseeing technology operations, cyber security, risk management and business resilience.
  • Commercially astute, with experience managing significant technology investment, supplier relationships and strategic partnerships.
  • Credibility and confidence operating at Executive or Board level, influencing senior stakeholders and supporting organisational decision-making.
  • An inspiring leader who can build high-performing teams, develop capability and create a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

It would be advantageous if you had:

  • Experience within a law firm, professional services business or other knowledge-led organisation.
  • Experience leading legal technology, client-facing technology or innovation initiatives.
  • Experience with Microsoft technologies, including Microsoft 365, Azure and Copilot.
  • Relevant professional qualifications or certifications.

Some of our benefits include:

  • A competitive salary based on your experience.
  • An annual bonus scheme with the opportunity to earn up to 10% of your salary.
  • Free onsite parking.
  • At least 28 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing to 31 days with service, with the option to buy up to five additional days' leave each year.
  • A workplace pension scheme with a minimum firm contribution of 6%.
  • Income protection cover.
  • Access to Bupa health insurance and health assessments.
  • Life assurance of four times your annual salary.
  • Hybrid and flexible working commensurate with the demands of the role.

Find out more about working at Walker Morris here.

Walker Morris is committed to being an inclusive employer. Our aim is to ensure our workforce represents our diverse society. We recognise that everyone brings their own unique capabilities and experiences to their work. We welcome applications regardless of sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, neuro diversity or disability status, family or parental status, race, religion or ethnicity.

We take great pride in being a Disability Confident Employer. If you need any reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process, please don’t hesitate to ask.

title: Senior Game Designer
description:
• Own and evolve scalable game systems (core gameplay, meta-progression, economy) so they support fast, low-risk iteration across a live GaaS title's full lifecycle.
  • Design systems, content frameworks, and configuration tools that are modular and data-driven, reducing the time and engineering dependency needed to set up new content, balancing passes, or feature variants.
  • Act as the technical bridge between Game Direction and Engineering: translate intent into technically grounded system designs, and surface feasibility, performance, and technical constraints early.
  • Audit existing systems, tools, and design-to-implementation workflows to identify inefficiencies or technical debt, and drive concrete, measurable improvements.
  • Own end-to-end design and delivery of major features/systems and be directly accountable for their efficiency, output quality, and post-launch iteration speed against KPIs.
  • Partner with engineering to define data structures, visual scripting frameworks, and tooling (Anvil Engine) that let designers configure and tune systems without recurring engineering support.
  • Confirm the impact of your work through live player data, KPIs, and analytics.
  • Produce precise, implementation-ready design documentation (system specs, data schemas, edge cases) that engineering can build directly from.
  • Provide technical design guidance to peer designers on system-specific questions (knowledge-sharing, not people management).
  • Align design direction across disciplines (programming, art, animation, UX) and communicate vision, decisions, and constraints clearly to stakeholders.
  • Iterate on design taking in consideration playtests, player feedback, and data insights.
  • Ensure timely delivery aligned with project goals, scope, and quality expectations.
  • Develop and maintain clear and actionable design documentation.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in game design with specialization in systems/technical design, including experience on at least one shipped AAA or AA title.
  • Track record owning a major system or feature end-to-end, from concept through live iteration.
  • Direct experience partnering with engineering on system architecture, tooling, or pipeline decisions.
  • Familiarity with GaaS live production environments and iterative, metrics-driven development.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Technical fluency: comfortable reading/writing code or scripting logic and discussing engineering trade-offs directly with programmers.
  • Proficiency with Anvil Engine (or equivalent proprietary engine) toolset, including visual scripting and data-driven design approaches.
  • Deep understanding of scalable systems architecture - designing systems that support rapid content iteration, live-ops cadence, and long-term extensibility.
  • Strong analytical mindset; able to define and track efficiency metrics for design/production workflows (time-to-build, iteration cycle time, power scaling, reward scaling…).
  • Ability to independently audit existing systems, tools, and processes and propose concrete efficiency improvements.
  • Excellent technical documentation skills - specs precise enough for direct engineering handoff.
  • Proficiency with game development tools (e.g., Jira, Hansoft, Perforce).
  • Solid understanding of production pipelines and development methodologies.

Nice to Have

  • Experience contributing to multiple projects or different phases of production.
  • Familiarity with large-scale game systems and content pipelines.
  • Experience improving team workflows, tools, or production efficiency.
  • Light scripting/programming experience (e.g., Python, C#, or engine-specific scripting).
  • Active interest in progression & game economy.

Personal Attributes

  • Systems thinker with an efficiency-first mindset; pragmatic about trade-offs between speed and polish.
  • Comfortable operating at the intersection of design intent and technical constraint.
  • Self-directed; owns outcomes and drives major features without requiring management oversight.
  • Strong written and verbal communication for cross-discipline technical alignment.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Collaborative, empathetic, and team-oriented mindset.

Since 2020, we’ve been uniting the best creative and engineering minds from Vietnam and beyond, with a shared goal of introducing Ubisoft’s iconic worlds to new audiences. We collaborate with highly talented teams on exciting and challenging projects displayed at an international level, whether it's fun and easy-to-pick mobile games or titles for consoles and PCs.

We believe in empowering our team members by fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and innovative environment. Our office, awarded Best Office Design in Vietnam by VMark 2021, reflects our commitment to creating a space that inspires creativity and promotes well-being.

title: Internship - Open Application (f/m/d)
description:
If you’re insanely good at something, tell us your story.

About Nox

Nox is aiming to become the best alternative to short-haul flights by soon offering premium overnight trains across Europe. With a radically redesigned interior and onboard experience, people travel in style, saving time being asleep. We now search for the most passionate and talented people out there to bring the first of many more Nox trains on the tracks.

We believe in strong teams through diversity, fresh thinking, and a shared commitment to build something meaningful. Apart from that, three things matter to us:

  1. Stay real. From intern to CEO, everyone will work at least two cabin crew shifts a year.
  2. Own it. Take responsibility from day one to shape Nox with your personal touch.
  3. Challenge. Question legacy thinking and push ideas that really excite our customers.

We care about strong, data-informed thinking and clear communication, but just as much about building a team with diverse perspectives and experiences. We especially encourage individuals who are usually underrepresented in traditional industries and business contexts, creating a more inclusive and balanced environment for the whole team.

The role

We are not writing this one for a specific job description. We are writing it for the person.

From now on, every single day at Nox will be the most exciting in our history so far. The foundations we lay now will define what Nox becomes for the next decade. While everyone oversees their specialised fields, from one day to another you can become an industrial designer, logistics expert a brand hero and so on. Not because we planned it, but because it was required.

Therefore: This internship is an open application. Tell us what you want to build, where you want to leave your mark, and we will shape a six-month project around it together.

Tasks

Where you could leave your mark

Pick one, blend two, or pitch us something we haven't thought of yet. Examples of what previous and current team members spend their days on:

  • Brand and launch moments: owning logistics, invitations and on-site choreography for our biggest moments of the year.
  • Hospitality and onboard experience: defining what it actually feels like to travel with Nox, from arrival to morning coffee.
  • Operations and crew: building the playbooks and tools that keep the train and the people on it running.
  • B2B and commercial: opening doors with the partners and decision-makers who bring travellers to Nox.
  • Growth and marketing: building the engine that turns a first train into a household name.
  • Product and tech: working alongside our PMs to shape the digital Nox experience from a customer-first angle.
  • Anything else: if there is a topic in night-train travel that genuinely excites you and we haven't listed it, pitch it.

You will report into one of our Co-Founders or our Chief of Staff, and you will sit close to whichever team your project lives in.

Requirements

Your experience

We care less about your degree, but more about how you think, how you ship, and what you have already built before joining us.

  • You are currently studying, on a gap semester, or have recently graduated. Background can be anything from business and design to engineering, hospitality or social sciences. What matters is the way you reason, write and execute.
  • You have first hands-on experience from internships, student ventures, your own side projects, association leadership, or any environment where you owned something end-to-end.
  • You are an exceptionally strong communicator, comfortable writing outreach to senior partners as much as briefing the founders on what is going on.
  • You combine structured thinking with hustler energy: you spot what is missing, take ownership, and ship before being asked.
  • You are AI-native and use modern tools to move faster, whether that is HubSpot, Notion, Figma, AI research and writing tools, or whatever else gets the job done.
  • Fluent English is a must. German is a very strong plus, every other language is a bonus.
  • You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate for the duration of the internship.

If you have never had a "real" job but you have built, organised, sold, designed or shipped something you are proud of, please still apply.

Benefits

What you can expect from us

  • A small, young and powerful team with diverse backgrounds, visions and skills.
  • A culture built on flat hierarchies, zero corporate politics and plenty of room for you to grow.
  • A chance to help build one of the most influential products in European mobility and hospitality at a defining moment.
  • Direct mentorship and exposure to founders and the wider C-level on a daily basis.
  • A competitive internship compensation.
  • A lot of new things. If you love the unknown and can adapt quickly, you will have tons of fun with us.
  • A free contingent of Nox rides in the future + a bunch of Benefits for Mobility and Sports

How to apply

If you see yourself here, we would love to hear from you. Please do not let imposter syndrome hold you back; we value your passion and potential more than a perfect match with every requirement.

Along with your CV and earliest possible start date, please send us two things:

  1. A short written answer (max. 3–4 sentences): Why does Nox need to exist, and where would you want to leave your mark in the next six months?
  2. A short video (max. 90 seconds, horizontal, raw and honest): Tell us who you are, what drives you, and one thing you have built or organised that you are proud of. We are not looking for a polished pitch. We are looking for you.

title: Civils Chargehand
description:

You will assist the Foreperson with organising the team, coordinating activities on site, and ensuring everyone works in line with company procedures and safe systems of work.

The role involves working outdoors, travelling to different sites and working a range of shifts, including night work where required.
  • Support the Civils Foreperson with the day-to-day running and coordination of the Civils squad
  • Act as a key point of contact for the operatives, providing guidance and support on site
  • Assist with organising the squad and allocating tasks to ensure work progresses efficiently
  • Support the safe and effective operation of plant, tools, and equipment
  • Help ensure the correct materials, plant, equipment, and PPE are available for the work being undertaken
  • Support site preparation and general activities before, during, and after works
  • Assist the Foreperson with site briefings, toolbox talks, and communicating site requirements to the squad

title: EMT/AEMT (Part-Time)
description:
The Salem Fire-EMS Department is seeking dedicated and skilled Part-Time EMT to serve within our dynamic 911 system. Operating in a high-volume emergency response system, you will provide quality pre-hospital care and transportation to the citizens and visitors of Salem.

Our system benefits from short transport times to region-leading Level I and Level II trauma-capable hospitals, as well as a strong operational backbone featuring dedicated EMS supervision and ALS-equipped engine crews available to assist on critical calls.

Key Responsibilities

  • Attendant-in-Charge (AIC): Participate in patient care delivery on an advanced life support capable ambualnces, asssiting in patient assessment, treatment, and transport decision-making.

  • System Collaboration: Coordinate effectively with on-scene fire crews, ALS engine personnel, EMS supervisors, and receiving hospital personnel.

  • Documentation: Complete thorough, accurate, and timely Electronic Patient Care Reports (ePCR) adhering to state, regional, and department standards.

  • Operational Readiness: Ensure response vehicles and medical equipment are fully stocked, operational, and clean at the start and end of every shift.

Shift & Schedule Requirements

  • Hours: 12 to 24 hours per week.

  • Availability: Shifts are scheduled across a 24/7/365 operational model, including days, nights, weekends, and holidays. Flexibility is required to meet department operational needs.

Qualification Requirements

A valid driver's license from the Commonwealth of Virginia. Certification as a EMT or AEMT, or have the ability to gain reciprocity as a EMT or AEMT in Virginia.

Special Requirements

Must meet and maintain all department, State and National training requirements for position.

Education & Experience

High school diploma or equivalent; Virginia EMT or AEMT certification, or have the ability to gain reciprocity in Virginia. Valid Emergency Vehicle Operator Course (EVOC) Level II certification.

Preferred applicants have certifications in BLS.

Prefer applicants have three (3) or more years of experience in a busy 911 pre-hospital system.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Thorough knowledge of the principles, practices, methods, techniques and equipment required for performing emergency medical treatment; general knowledge of the street system and physical layout of the City; ability to understand and follow oral and written instructions; ability to communicate orally and in writing through the electronic patient care reporting system; ability to understand and maintain effective working relationships with fellow associates and the general public; possession of physical endurance and agility.

Physical Requirements

Much of the work is performed under emergency conditions and frequently involves considerable personal hazard. Requires the exertion of 50 pounds of force occasionally, up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects, and some heavy work requiring the exertion of 100 pounds of force occasionally, up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and up to 20 pounds of force constantly to move objects; work requires climbing, balancing, kneeling, crouching, crawling, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, grasping, feeling, and repetitive motions; vocal communication is required for conveying detailed or important instructions to others accurately, loudly, or quickly; hearing is required to receive detailed information through oral communications and/or to make fine distinctions in sound; visual acuity is required for depth perception, night vision, peripheral vision, preparing and analyzing written or computer data, operation of machines, operation of motor vehicles or equipment, determining the accuracy and thoroughness of work, and observing general surroundings and activities; the worker is subject to extreme heat, noise, vibration, hazards, atmospheric conditions and oils. The worker may be exposed to bloodborne pathogens and may be required to wear specialized personal protective equipment.

title: Specimen Collector II - 1875

title: Applied AI Researcher
description:
Fuse is an AI-first energy company on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers, we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

Energy is a rare place to apply AI across the full stack: from helping customers and building software to operating physical infrastructure and trading power. Our ambition is to make energy cheaper and more abundant with AI, while building the energy and compute infrastructure that the next generation of AI will need.


Responsibilities

  • Design experiments to find the best model and approach for each workload, balancing accuracy, latency and cost.
  • Own our evaluation framework: build high-quality datasets and golden answers, combine human and LLM judgments and measure how much confidence to place in each evaluator.
  • Explore post-training methods, including supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.
  • Build agent harnesses that make long-running tasks reliable: tool use, deterministic checks, state tracking, retries, resource allocation and appropriate human approvals.
  • Set evaluation and escalation thresholds according to the consequences of failure.
  • Work with teams across Fuse to turn research results into production systems and bring new methods and hard-won lessons from the frontier of applied AI into the company.

Requirements

  • Strong experience applying modern AI models to real-world tasks with a track record of improving measured outcomes through experimentation.
  • Deep understanding of evaluations, dataset quality and failure analysis. You know how to distinguish a genuine improvement from an unreliable benchmark result.
  • Hands-on experience with several of model selection and routing, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, agent systems or computer use.
  • Strong software engineering skills, including Python and the ability to build reliable experimental and production tooling.
  • Good judgment about cost, latency, reliability and risk, especially when deciding where deterministic checks or human review are needed.
  • Ability to move between research and implementation: formulate a hypothesis, run a rigorous test, inspect failures and ship what works.
  • Experience at a frontier AI lab or a team operating at a similar level of experimentation would be especially valuable.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and eligibility for equity
  • Biannual bonus scheme
  • Fully expensed tech to match your needs
  • Private health insurance
  • Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees


As we hire globally, benefits may vary by location.

title: Data Architect - Supply Chain
description:
This role is for one of Weekday’s clients


Min Experience: 8+ years
Location: India
JobType: full-time

We are looking for an experienced Data Architect – Supply Chain to design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performance data architecture solutions supporting supply chain operations and analytics. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Data Architecture, Azure, and Databricks, along with a solid understanding of enterprise data platforms and modern cloud technologies.

In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, enterprise architects, and supply chain teams to translate business requirements into robust data solutions. You will play a key role in defining data models, architecture standards, integration patterns, governance frameworks, and technology strategies that enable data-driven decision-making across the supply chain.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable data architectures for supply chain data platforms, analytics, reporting, and downstream applications.
  • Define enterprise data models, logical and physical data structures, data domains, and data integration patterns.
  • Architect cloud-based data solutions using Microsoft Azure services and ensure scalability, reliability, security, and performance.
  • Design and optimize data processing and analytics solutions using Databricks, including data lakehouse architecture and distributed data processing.
  • Collaborate with data engineering teams to establish best practices for data ingestion, transformation, storage, orchestration, and consumption.
  • Analyze complex business and technical requirements and translate them into effective architecture and solution designs.
  • Establish standards for data quality, metadata management, lineage, security, access control, and governance.
  • Work with cross-functional stakeholders to understand supply chain processes and identify opportunities for data modernization and optimization.
  • Review existing data platforms and recommend improvements to architecture, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to data engineers and development teams.
  • Create architecture diagrams, technical documentation, data models, and solution design specifications.
  • Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, cloud security, compliance, and data governance standards.

Must-Have Skills

  • 8–12 years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or related technology roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Data Architecture and designing enterprise-scale data platforms.
  • Strong expertise in Microsoft Azure and cloud-based data architecture.
  • Extensive experience with Databricks, including lakehouse architecture, data processing, and analytics workloads.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, data lakes, ETL/ELT, and data integration concepts.
  • Experience designing scalable and high-performance data solutions for complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, security, quality, lineage, and metadata management.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across business and technical teams.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience working with SAP S/4HANA and SAP-related enterprise data.
  • Hands-on knowledge of Azure Data Factory (ADF) for data integration and orchestration.
  • Prior experience working with Supply Chain data, processes, and systems.
  • Exposure to ERP, procurement, inventory, logistics, manufacturing, demand planning, or order management data.
  • Knowledge of modern data engineering and cloud-native architecture patterns.

title: Functioneel Analist Technische Applicaties (Brussel)
description:
Over DE WATERGROEP

De Watergroep is het grootste drinkwaterbedrijf in Vlaanderen. Wij maken water op maat. Vandaag, voor de generatie van morgen.

Via een netwerk van meer dan 34.000 kilometer waterleidingen leveren we op een duurzame manier drinkwater aan 167 gemeenten gespreid over West- en Oost-Vlaanderen, Vlaams-Brabant en Limburg. Zo bedienen we ruim 3,3 miljoen klanten en honderden bedrijven.

Bouw mee aan de digitale motor achter de grootste watermaatschappij van Vlaanderen

Elke dag vertrouwen miljoenen Vlamingen op betrouwbaar drinkwater van De Watergroep. Achter die dienstverlening schuilt een uitgebreid landschap van technische applicaties die onze infrastructuur, assets en voertuigen ondersteunen.

Wil jij mee bepalen hoe die digitale oplossingen eruitzien? Krijg je energie van het analyseren van complexe uitdagingen en het vertalen ervan naar slimme, gebruiksvriendelijke oplossingen? Dan is deze functie iets voor jou.

Binnen het team Innovatie & Digitalisering krijg je de kans om een sleutelrol op te nemen in de verdere digitalisering van onze technische processen. Je werkt samen met experten uit de business, ICT-collega's en externe partners om applicaties zoals IBM Maximo en andere technische platformen toekomstgericht uit te bouwen.

Wat maakt deze functie zo boeiend?

Als Functioneel Analist ben jij de brug tussen de gebruikers en de technologie. Je ontdekt waar noden en opportuniteiten liggen en vertaalt die naar oplossingen met zichtbare impact op onze dagelijkse werking.

Je krijgt daarbij veel afwisseling:

  • Je analyseert bedrijfsprocessen en gebruikersbehoeften en vertaalt die naar concrete digitale oplossingen.
  • Je werkt mee aan de verdere uitbouw van applicaties voor asset management en vlootbeheer.
  • Je begeleidt workshops en werkgroepen waarin je samen met stakeholders processen optimaliseert.
  • Je werkt functionele analyses, datamodellen en businesscases uit.
  • Je bent betrokken van idee tot implementatie en testing.
  • Je helpt gebruikers vooruit met jouw expertise en zorgt ervoor dat oplossingen effectief gebruikt worden.
  • Je werkt mee aan dashboards, rapportering en KPI's die de organisatie helpen om beter geïnformeerde beslissingen te nemen.
  • Je draagt actief bij aan innovatie en continue verbetering binnen een organisatie met maatschappelijke impact.

Wij zoeken vooral iemand die graag de diepte induikt, verbanden ziet en energie haalt uit samenwerking.

Je bent analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en weet complexe vraagstukken om te zetten in duidelijke en haalbare oplossingen. Je schakelt vlot tussen business, gebruikers en technische experten.

Daarnaast beschik je idealiter -geen must- over:

  • ervaring met business- en functionele analyse;
  • kennis van datamodellering;
  • affiniteit met Enterprise Asset Management (IBM Maximo) of vlootbeheertoepassingen;
  • een sterk probleemoplossend vermogen;
  • de flexibiliteit om te werken in een omgeving die voortdurend evolueert.

title: Trainee Cyber Security
description:
Cyber Security Placement Programme - No Experience Required Are you looking to benefit from a new career in IT and Cybersecurity? Skills shortages in the IT sector are driving the need for qualified, entry-level career seekers and career changers.

We help place graduates from this programme in top UK companies and organisations needing to employ entry-level IT and Cybersecurity staff that can hit the ground running with up-to-date skills gained from this programme.

The best part is you will not need any previous experience as fully accredited training, which includes tutor support and mentoring, provides you with the skills, practical knowledge and qualifications for you to secure a professional job and career in IT. You will also have the reassurance of a job guarantee (18K-£35K) upon completion.

Whether you are working full time, part time or are unemployed, this package has the flexibility to be completed at a pace that suits you and can be completed in a few weeks or a few months (step 1 to 4 below). Your job and career goals are completed in 4 easy steps.

Step 1 - Accredited Online Training

The first step is completing a selection of professional, accredited and industry recognised courses from CompTIA which is the global leader in IT Technician, Networking and Cybersecurity training. The training is delivered via multimedia rich video tutorials, practice labs, presentations and quizzes through a portal that you study from home. You will also be assigned an expert tutor and a support mentor to help you throughout your training.

Step 2 - Practical Training

You will gain practical experience by using practice labs which enable you to practice and master what you have learned. Gaining practical hands-on experience gives you confidence to be proficient in your first IT role. This combination of theoretical and practical skills is what line managers need you to have to be effective and confident in your role.

Step 3 - Official exams

You will then go on to sit the CompTIA A+ and the CompTIA Network+ exams to give you the official certifications which will be recognised not only in the UK, but worldwide. The CompTIA A+ is the most asked for certificate for entry-level IT roles

and the certification most IT Managers start their own careers with. All PCs in a professional environment are networked to servers, cloud based or otherwise and the Network+ gives you a needed foundation level of knowledge in networking.

Step 4 - IT Technician placement (£18-£25K)

We work with you to secure your first role as an IT Technician, with a starting salary of anywhere between £18K-25K. Ideally you will need to gain two years’ experience in this role before you can progress into a cyber security role. While working as an IT Technician, we will release your second batch of training which is specifically designed to qualify you to move into the cybersecurity field. This official, accredited training consists of online training, practical training and an official exam (CompTIA Security+). Further we can tailor the package to include courses like the Certified Ethical Hacker and Certified Network Defender depending on your requirements and future direction.

Cybersecurity Role

Once you have completed all the mandatory training in step four and have gained two plus years experience in the IT industry, you will be ready to move into higher paying Cybersecurity roles. Our recruitment support team specialises in the IT and Cybersecurity space and roles at this level have an average starting salary of £35K.

We have been helping career changers and new career seekers gain new careers since 2009 and we are a CompTIA Gold Partner, accredited by the BCS (Chartered Institute of IT/ British Computer Society) and the EC-Council to ensure we provide the highest levels of training.

In addition, we are also ELCAS approved to help members of the Armed Forces, Service Leavers and Veterans gain rewarding careers in IT and Cybersecurity.

Job Guarantee

Due to the success of this programme and the skills shortage of entry-level IT staff, we can guarantee you will secure a job upon completion of your study programme or we will refund you 100% of your course fees back. This is subject to our terms of learning/ terms of business.

Passionate about starting a career in IT? Apply now and one of our friendly advisors will be in touch.

Keywords: IT Technician, IT Helpdesk, IT Security, IT Field Engineer, Cyber Security, IT Support, 1st Line Support, 2nd Line Support, IT Training Course, Cyber Training Course, Cyber Security Course, First Line Support, Second Line Support, IT Security Engineer, IT Engineer, CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, Ethical Hacker

title: Partnership Analyst
description:
First Circle is the leading and fastest growing, technology-led financial service business for SMEs in the Philippines. We've already transformed access to credit for thousands of businesses, and now we're building a full service digital-first small business bank offering multi-currency bank accounts, payments, FX, corporate credit cards, and payroll. As we enter this next phase of growth, we're hiring exceptional talent with a track record of excellence to join us in shaping the next chapter.

First Circle works with chambers, associations, business organizations, and industry partners across the Philippines to reach more SME owners and build stronger business communities. As our partnership activities continue to grow, we are looking for a Partnership Analyst to support the execution of events, partnership initiatives, and business development activities under the Acquisition team.

This is a hands-on role. You will work closely with the Partnership Manager, Account Managers, internal teams, event organizers, partners, and suppliers to make sure our events and partnership activities run smoothly from planning and preparation through actual execution and post-event reporting.

The role is ideal for someone who enjoys being on the ground, meeting people, organizing moving parts, and seeing a project through from start to finish.

What’s different about Partnerships at First Circle?

  • Diverse industry exposure. You get exposure to different industries and business communities through chambers, associations, conferences, expos, and other SME-focused events.
  • End-to-end business event operations. You will work both behind the scenes and on the ground. One day may involve coordinating with suppliers and preparing event requirements, while another may involve setting up a booth, meeting business owners, and supporting an event onsite.
  • Cross-functional collaboration. You will work directly with different teams and external stakeholders, including Acquisition, Finance, Marketing, event organizers, business associations, suppliers, and partners.
  • Nationwide travel. You will have opportunities to travel as First Circle participates in events and partnership activities across the Philippines.
  • Career growth beyond coordination. You will build experience across events, partnerships, sales operations, and business development, giving you exposure beyond a traditional administrative or coordinator role.

What you’ll be doing

  • End-to-End Event Operations & Logistics: Oversee complete event execution - from initial planning, coordinating operational requirements and permits, and supplier coordination to ingress and booth setup, onsite logistics, and egress. Work with suppliers such as booth contractors, printers, logistics providers, and other event vendors. Prepare and monitor event materials, flyers, collaterals, equipment, and other requirements before deployment. Support booth setup and dismantling and assist with event logistics when needed. Document events through photos, videos, attendance records, and post-event reporting.
  • Onsite Engagement & Representation: Serve as a representative for First Circle at events by engaging attendees, handing out collaterals, and delivering foundational product information.
  • Lead & Data Management: Track, verify, and organize event-generated leads, ensuring accurate tagging, duplicate checks, and proper team assignments.
  • Performance Tracking & Reporting: Document event activities through multimedia and attendance logs while measuring key performance metrics to evaluate overall success.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration & Market Research: Partner with internal teams (Acquisition, Finance, and Marketing) and external stakeholders while researching prospective events, sponsorship packages, and industry partnerships. Gather information such as sponsorship packages, audience profiles, event costs, schedules, and participation requirements to support future partnership decisions.

Requirements

  • Relevant background. Experience in events, partnerships, business development, sales, marketing, account coordination, or a related field is an advantage, but we are open to candidates with strong potential.
  • Technical proficiency (MS Office, Google Workspace). Comfortable using Microsoft Office and Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets and basic formulas.
  • Strong coordination and organizational skills. Comfortable handling several moving requirements at the same time.
  • Stakeholder communication. Confident in communicating with business owners, partners, organizers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Event engagement. Comfortable engaging people and explaining First Circle’s products and services during events.
  • Adaptability. Resourceful and able to respond quickly when plans or event requirements change.
  • Flexible execution. Comfortable doing both desk-based coordination and hands-on event work.
  • Logistics readiness. Willing and physically able to assist with event materials, booth setup, and other reasonable logistical requirements.
  • Flexible working schedule. Willing to work flexible hours depending on event schedules, including early mornings, evenings, and occasional weekends.
  • Flexible working location. Willing to travel outside Metro Manila when required.
  • Driving capability. Ability to drive and a valid driver’s license are an advantage.

The nature of the role may require early morning ingress, evening egress, weekend activities, provincial travel, or overnight stays. Working schedules may be adjusted or offset depending on approved event requirements.

Benefits

  • HMO coverage from week one, life and accidental insurance, free catered lunches, monthly fitness, and more.
  • Hybrid work set-up with flexibility depending on event schedules and field requirements.
  • Approved transportation expenses for official events, including corporate Grab or car rental when applicable.
  • Meals and accommodation for approved events and business travel.
  • Opportunities to attend conferences, expos, business events, and partnership activities across the Philippines.
  • Exposure to different industries, business organizations, and SME communities.
  • Join a collaborative Acquisition team where you will work closely with sales, partnerships, finance, marketing, and other teams across First Circle.

title: Senior Cyber Security Engineer
description:
🔐 SENIOR CYBERSECURITY ENGINEER

Protect what matters. Challenge what’s possible. Build what’s next.

📍 Bryanston | 🛡️ Tangent Solutions | 💻 Information Technology

Are you a cybersecurity professional who can move beyond simply monitoring alerts?

Someone who can investigate a threat, understand the bigger picture, find the weakness, fix it and strengthen the environment for what comes next?

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who wants to combine deep technical expertise, security engineering, incident response and strategic thinking.

🚨 THIS IS NOT JUST ANOTHER CYBERSECURITY ROLE

You will sit at the intersection of technology, risk and security, helping to identify threats, respond to incidents, strengthen controls and build a more resilient digital environment.

You will have exposure across:

🛡️ EDR / XDR
Detect, investigate, contain and respond to endpoint threats.

🔎 SIEM / SOC
Monitor security events, analyse logs, investigate incidents and drive remediation.

🔐 Identity & Access Management
MFA, SSO, privileged access, identity lifecycle and access governance.

📊 Data Security
Microsoft Purview, DLP, information classification, labelling and data protection.

🌐 Web & API Security
WAF, OWASP threats, API authentication, authorisation, rate limiting and gateway controls.

🚨 Incident Response
Lead investigations, containment, remediation, root cause analysis and post incident reviews.

⚠️ Vulnerability Management
Identify, prioritise and drive remediation of cybersecurity vulnerabilities.

☁️ Cloud & Network Security
Assess and strengthen security controls across cloud, network and internet facing environments.

🔧 DevSecOps & Application Security
Secure SDLC, SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets management, CI/CD security and secure code review.

📦 Container & Cloud Native Security
Container image scanning, Kubernetes security, CSPM and CNAPP.

📧 Email Security
Anti phishing, SPF, DKIM, DMARC and business email compromise investigations.

🔑 Cryptography & PKI
Encryption standards, certificate lifecycle management, key management and TLS.

🧠 Threat Intelligence
Interpret emerging threats and attacker techniques, then translate intelligence into practical defensive action.

🎯 WHAT WILL YOU BE RESPONSIBLE FOR?

You will:

• Lead and support cybersecurity incident response activities

• Investigate security incidents and perform root cause analysis

• Operate and oversee core cybersecurity capabilities across endpoint, SIEM, identity, data, email and web security

• Identify and remediate vulnerabilities within the cybersecurity domain

• Develop, implement and enforce security standards

• Establish and maintain API security standards aligned with the OWASP API Security Top 10

• Develop and enforce secure development standards across the organisation

• Assess technical designs and identify security weaknesses

• Recommend practical security controls based on risk

• Interpret threat intelligence and emerging attack techniques

• Support vulnerability management and penetration testing remediation

• Work closely with technical teams, senior stakeholders and external cybersecurity providers

• Contribute to security governance, risk and compliance activities

• Mentor junior cybersecurity team members and contribute to technical workstreams

🧩 THE TECHNOLOGY YOU'LL WORK WITH

We are looking for someone who enjoys getting into the technology.

Experience with technologies such as:

CrowdStrike or similar EDR / XDR platforms

Arctic Wolf or similar SIEM / SOC technologies

Microsoft Entra ID, PIM, Defender for Cloud Apps and Intune

Microsoft Purview and DLP

KnowBe4 or similar security awareness platforms

Cloudflare or similar WAF technologies

Tenable or similar vulnerability management platforms

will be highly advantageous.

Experience with Python, PowerShell, KQL or other scripting technologies will also be advantageous.

🏆 WHAT YOU BRING

Experience

✔ 7+ years of progressive cybersecurity or information security experience

✔ Strong hands on technical cybersecurity experience

✔ Security operations, incident response and threat detection experience

✔ Experience operating or overseeing SOC and SIEM capabilities

✔ Enterprise EDR / XDR experience

✔ Identity and access management experience

✔ Microsoft Purview and DLP experience

✔ Web application and API security knowledge

✔ Vulnerability management and penetration testing remediation experience

✔ Experience engaging with technical teams, senior stakeholders and external security providers

Qualifications

🎓 Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in:

Cybersecurity | Information Security | Computer Science | Information Technology | Related discipline

A relevant postgraduate qualification will be advantageous.

🎓 CERTIFICATIONS THAT WILL SET YOU APART

One or more recognised cybersecurity certifications will be highly advantageous:

CISSP | CISM | CEH | GIAC

along with relevant:

Microsoft Security | EDR / XDR | Security Operations | Web Security | Application Security

certifications.

🧠 WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO...

Thinks like an attacker, but builds like a defender.

You are analytical, curious and naturally investigative.

You don't stop when you've found the immediate problem. You want to know why it happened and how to prevent it happening again.

You can remain calm during high pressure security incidents.

You can take complex cybersecurity concepts and explain them clearly to people who aren't security specialists.

You have the confidence to challenge technical decisions when security risk demands it.

You influence without relying on hierarchy.

And most importantly, you keep learning.

Because the threat landscape doesn't stand still, and neither should your expertise.

🚀 WHY TANGENT SOLUTIONS?

Tangent Solutions is a technology business focused on helping organisations build for a dynamic and digital future, with capabilities spanning cloud, software development, intelligent automation, cybersecurity and software defined networking. Tangent Solutions

That means you won't operate in a technology silo.

You'll work in an environment where cybersecurity intersects with cloud, networking, software, automation and digital transformation.

You will have the opportunity to work alongside technology specialists, engage with complex environments and continuously expand your technical perspective.

This is a place for people who want to build, solve, learn and make an impact.

🔥 READY FOR YOUR NEXT CYBERSECURITY CHALLENGE?

If you're ready to take your cybersecurity expertise beyond monitoring and into engineering, investigation, architecture, response and transformation, we want to meet you.

Protect what matters. Solve what others can't. Build what comes next.

Your expertise could be the difference between reacting to the next threat and being ready for it.

Apply now and let's start the conversation.

title: (Junior) Schadebehandelaar Inkomen.
description:
Heb jij oog voor detail, weet je het overzicht te bewaren én wil je een betekenisvolle rol spelen in het afhandelen van werkgeversschades binnen de collectieve inkomensverzekeringen? Dan is dit jouw kans om onderdeel te worden van het Employee Benefits Volmacht team van Meijers.

Wat ga je doen?

Binnen Employee Benefits helpen wij organisaties hun medewerkers goed te verzekeren. Denk aan belangrijke onderwerpen zoals pensioen, arbeidsongeschiktheid en verzuim. Als Schadebehandelaar ben je verantwoordelijk voor de juiste verwerking van schademeldingen binnen inkomensverzekeringen zoals verzuim, WIA en Ziektewet. Je analyseert polisvoorwaarden, onderhoudt contact met werkgevers en verzekeraars, en zorgt ervoor dat uitkeringen correct en tijdig worden uitgekeerd. Geen dag is hetzelfde – het ene moment duik je diep in een dossier, het andere moment beantwoord je een vraag van een werkgever.

Meijers heeft volmachten van meerdere verzekeraars en met Meijers Vitaal een arbodienst waarmee veel wordt samengewerkt. Daarnaast heeft Meijers een digitaal portal voor zijn klanten waarmee informatie eenvoudig en veilig kan worden uitgewisseld.

Jouw kwaliteiten

Jij bent scherp, gestructureerd en houdt van puzzelen. Je leest polisvoorwaarden alsof het een logica-puzzel is. Tegelijkertijd ben je sociaal en weet je professioneel te schakelen met klanten en collega’s. Je blijft rustig onder druk, neemt initiatief en haalt energie uit het helpen van anderen – altijd met een oplossingsgerichte instelling. En: je past in een team dat houdt van samenwerken, lachen en kwaliteit leveren. Geen zorgen als je nog niet alles weet, daar helpen wij je bij. We zoeken vooral iemand met de juiste mindset. Wanneer je nog geen ervaring hebt, leiden wij je graag op!

Jouw toekomst

Je komt te werken in een energiek team met 13 collega’s waar een goede sfeer heerst en waarin veel ruimte is voor ontwikkeling. Je werkt nauw samen met andere Schadebehandelaars, Administratief Specialisten en de Manager. Daarnaast krijg je toegang tot ons eigen leer- en ontwikkelplatform met trainingen op maat.

Binnen Meijers zijn er volop doorgroeimogelijkheden, bijvoorbeeld richting Medior / Senior Schadebehandelaar, of Specialist. Wij denken graag mee in jouw werkgeluk!

Je werkt vanuit ons moderne kantoor in Amstelveen, met mogelijkheden voor thuiswerken. Het kantoor is uitstekend bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer, op slechts vijf minuten lopen van de halte van tram 5 en tram 25. Wij stimuleren duurzaam woon-werkverkeer, zoals reizen met het OV of de e-bike. Minder uitstoot, meer beweging en zo bouwen we samen aan een groenere werkdag en een duurzamere toekomst.

Enthousiast geworden?

Ben jij de (Junior) Schadebehandelaar Inkomen die wij zoeken? Solliciteer via onderstaand online formulier met jouw cv en korte motivatie. Heb je nog vragen? Stel ze gerust! Neem contact op Romy van Schaik (Senior Corporate Recruiter), via 06 185 812 00.

Sollicitanten die wij uitnodigen voor een arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek, worden na dit gesprek gescreend. Deze screening is een onderdeel van het sollicitatieproces._ _Een referentiecheck en/of assessment kan onderdeel zijn van de selectieprocedure.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze advertentie wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

• Minimaal mbo werk- en denkniveau; bij voorkeur minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring
• In bezit van Wft Basis en Wft Inkomen of de bereidheid deze via Meijers te behalen
• Kennis van CCS Level 7 of Verzuimsignaal is een pré en kunnen wij je ook leren
• Goede beheersing van MS Office
• Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift

Wat bieden wij?
• Een goed salaris tussen € 2.800 en € 4000,- o.b.v. 40 uur afhankelijk van ervaring en opleiding en reiskostenvergoeding
• Een 13e maand
• Een uitstekende pensioenregeling met slechts 3% eigen bijdrage en korting op diverse verzekeringen
• 29 vakantiedagen en 1 bedrijfsvrijekeuzedag (o.b.v. 40 uur)
• Hybride werken (waarvan 60% op kantoor)
• Je profiteert van een aantrekkelijke e-bike leaseregeling met een bijdrage van Meijers, of een NS Business Card voor comfortabel reizen met het OV
• Gezonde lunches, vrijdagmiddagborrels, Young Meijers en een actieve personeelsvereniging

title: Senior Scientist - Immunology
description:
Your new company
You'll be joining a global biopharmaceutical company advancing innovative therapies for immune-mediated diseases. You'll become part of a highly collaborative translational research team supporting programmes from late discovery through early clinical development, helping to generate the human biology insights needed to inform key development decisions across multiple immunology drugs.

Your new role
As a Senior Scientist, you will use human-derived systems and translational models to support the progression of multiple clinical-stage therapeutic programmes in immunology and immune-mediated disease.
This is initially a 12 month contract that is very likely to extend and is mainly lab-based with some work from home flexibility.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing and running complex in-vitro and ex-vivo human cell and tissue models to investigate disease biology and therapeutic mechanisms of action
  • Establishing translational assays using primary human cells, tissue-resident cell systems, co-cultures, and advanced functional models
  • Generating and interpreting preclinical data to support patient population selection, proof-of-concept strategies, and clinical programme decision-making
  • Producing and analysing experimental readouts including flow cytometry, protein analysis, gene expression, RNA-based assays, and related immunology techniques
  • Integrating biological findings with larger datasets to develop mechanistic understanding and support translational insights
  • Collaborating closely with multidisciplinary teams across research, translational medicine, and clinical development to deliver project milestones



What you'll need to succeed
A successful candidate will bring strong laboratory-based immunology expertise together with experience working in translational research environments as well as:

  • A PhD (or equivalent experience) in Immunology, Cell Biology, Translational Biology, or a related discipline
  • Strong hands-on experience establishing and running functional in vitro (and/or ex vivo) assays using human cells and tissues
  • Deep understanding of immunology and/or stromal biology, ideally within immune-mediated or tissue-remodelling diseases
  • Experience generating and interpreting complex biological datasets and translating findings into actionable conclusions
  • Proven ability to work independently and deliver high-quality experimental data in a fast-paced research environment
  • Experience with RNAseq, single-cell, spatial transcriptomics, proteomics, CRO management, or drug discovery programmes would be advantageous, as would any experience with transcriptomic or genomic data analysis
  • The right to work in the UK until at least November 2027 (preferably beyond this) as no sponsorship is available for this role



What you'll get in return
The chance to make a real impact on several of the company's clinical-stage programmes and influence key development decisions, as well as a good pay rate and some home working flexibility.

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.

Keywords: R&D, Immunology, Scientist, Senior, Research, Pharmaceutical, Translational, Biology, Inflammation, Immune, Stromal, Cell, Culture, Tissue, Drug, Human, Assay, Ex-vivo, In-vitro, Cytometry, Flow, RNAseq, Transcriptomics, Proteomics, Biomarkers, Therapeutics, Development, Immunofluorescence, Gene, Expression, Clinical, Discovery, Mechanism

title: Senior C Developer
description:
As a Senior C Developer at Endava, you will be a hands-on engineer on a large-scale datacenter migration, moving a long-lived payments platform from UNIX/AIX to Linux (RedHat) with applications refactored for the cloud (AWS). You will own the analysis, refactoring, and consolidation of C applications, relying on strong systems fundamentals to reason about behaviour and deliver with autonomy. Beyond the migration, you will have the opportunity to grow into long-term BAU, project, and client-integration work on the same platform.

Responsibilities:

- Designs, estimates, and implements technical solutions for medium/high complexity applications.

- Participates actively in all phases of application development lifecycle.

- Collaborates with various project stakeholders to provide support for clarifying requirements, processes, architecture, and priorities.

- Recommends and promotes IT industry standards, tools, practices (DevOps, etc.) to achieve well-engineered software products.

- Proposes improvements and escalates risks/issues related to development activities.

- Participates in the review of the work done by development team members.

- Learns and applies new technologies, practices, and tools as appropriate to the project.

- Shares experience and knowledge gained from projects.

- Has responsibility for the work of others and for allocating resources.

- Influences the team, customers, and suppliers.

- Makes decisions which influence the success of projects and team objectives.

- Can propose and design solutions autonomously.

- Can articulate solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Required:

- 5+ years of hands-on software development experience, with strong, demonstrable expertise in plain C.

- Strong UNIX experience across AIX and Linux (RedHat), with proven ability to port and refactor applications from AIX to Linux RedHat.

- Shell scripting (Korn/ksh, Bash) for build, run, and deployment tasks across UNIX environments.

- Solid command of the C build and debug toolchain — Make/Makefiles, gcc, gdb, and core-dump analysis.

- Experience refactoring and consolidating applications, including redesign work as part of a migration.

- A self-directed developer mindset, comfortable delivering with autonomy and taking ownership end to end.

- Good communication skills, able to articulate solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have:

- SQL and relational databases (DB2, Oracle), including embedded SQL (Pro*C / ESQL/C) as used in C applications.

- Sockets, TCP/IP, and inter-process communication (IPC) for application integrations and messaging.

- Cross-platform porting awareness — endianness, data-type sizes, and compiler differences between AIX (POWER) and Linux (x86).

- Payments / financial transaction processing domain knowledge (e.g. ISO 8583, card and transaction switching, PCI DSS).

- Git/GitHub — the project is migrating source control from SCCS to GitHub.

- Exposure to Harness or a comparable enterprise CI/CD tool (similar in role to Jenkins).

- Familiarity with AWS, as the migrated applications will run in the cloud (databases hosted in a payments datacenter).

- Exposure to Linux administration, Docker/containerisation, or Terraform/IaC on the cloud target.

- Experience integrating with external clients and third-party systems.

title: Senior Graphic Designer (Digital & Social)
description:
Milani Cosmetics is built on a simple belief: beauty should feel exceptional, every day. For more than 20 years, that principle has guided the brand's mission to raise the standard of mass beauty. Working with trusted suppliers in Italy, South Korea, the US and beyond, Milani creates formulas with premium ingredients, rich pigments and meticulous detail; products designed to exceed expectations.

Today, Milani has built a cult following as the #7 U.S. mass color cosmetics brand, the third fastest-growing brand and the only independent brand in the top 10. Milani is known for its best-selling Baked Blush, crafted through a unique baking process on Italian terracotta tiles, along with Make It Last Setting Spray Original, the #1 ranked mass setting spray. The brand’s products feature premium skin-loving ingredients and technologies such as guava fruit extract, blue algae, chamomile, glycerin and niacinamide, and all products are proudly cruelty-free. For Milani, what’s inside matters, which is why every product is made with ingredients worthy of the consumers who wear them.

What's Inside is Everything!

Milani Cosmetics is seeking a Senior Graphic Designer (Digital & Social) to help define how the brand lives, moves, and connects with consumers across the digital ecosystem.

This role is ideal for a conceptually strong, digitally native brand designer who can take a marketing brief from objective to idea to execution. You understand how to build a compelling visual world around a product or campaign—and how it should flex across Instagram, TikTok, MilaniCosmetics.com, Amazon, retailer PDPs, email, paid media, and emerging platforms while remaining unmistakably Milani.

You combine exceptional taste with strong execution, moving comfortably between campaign concepts, social-first ideas, conversion-minded ecommerce, and scalable digital systems. You understand beauty and culture, have a strong point of view on what feels current, and know how to balance brand-building with platform and performance needs.

Reporting to the Art Director and partnering closely with the Executive Creative Director, you will help raise Milani's digital creative standard while leading design across key initiatives—developing the creative vision, establishing clear systems and direction, and guiding supporting designers, agencies, creators, and production partners through execution.

Responsibilities

Brand Art, Concepts & Systems

• Partner with the Art Director to concept and develop campaign creative, key visuals, product launches, and digital-first brand moments

• Translate marketing briefs, product truths, and business objectives into original creative concepts and executions

• Build cohesive visual worlds across typography, imagery, color, composition, motion, and product storytelling

• Establish scalable design systems, templates, and guidelines that create consistency across channels without becoming formulaic

• Help define Milani's evolving visual identity and how it translates across the digital consumer experience

Social & Content

Digital, Ecommerce & Performance

• Develop elevated creative across MilaniCosmetics.com, Amazon, retailer PDPs, email, landing pages, paid media, and digital campaigns

• Translate product benefits, claims, ingredients, textures, shades, application, and results into compelling ecommerce storytelling

• Design for the consumer journey from discovery and consideration through education and conversion

• Balance elevated brand expression with clarity, mobile readability, shopability, and performance

• Partner with Ecommerce, Marketing, Social, and Copy to evolve creative using performance insights and consumer behavior

• Build scalable systems that flex efficiently across products, franchises, retailers, promotions, and formats

Creative Leadership & Ownership

• Take projects from marketing brief and objective through concept, creative direction, and final execution

• Lead design across key initiatives, establishing the visual direction, systems, and guidance needed for supporting designers to execute successfully

• Brief and direct supporting designers, providing clear templates, examples, feedback, and quality control while protecting the core creative idea

• Know when to lead and delegate versus execute hands-on, balancing senior-level ownership with the needs of the project

• Concept and art direct motion, video, animation, and 3D/CGI opportunities where they strengthen the idea

• Maintain a high creative bar across typography, imagery, motion, product visualization, and digital production

• Present and articulate creative thinking clearly to cross-functional partners

• Manage multiple complex and fast-turn projects without compromising quality

Requirements

• Beauty, fashion, luxury, lifestyle, entertainment, or culturally relevant consumer brand experience preferred

• Exceptional portfolio demonstrating conceptual thinking, sophisticated brand design, social-first creative, ecommerce, and high executional craft

What Success Looks Like

You will help Milani:

title: Trener Personalny / Trenerka Personalna – Well Fitness
description:
Well Fitness oferuje swoim klientom trening w przyjaznej atmosferze i wsparcie w budowaniu zdrowych nawyków. Do Well Fitness należy kilkadziesiąt nowoczesnych klubów, które mieszczą się w kilkunastu miastach w całej Polsce, między innymi we Wrocławiu, Katowicach, Poznaniu, Łodzi i Warszawie.

Sieć jest częścią grona klubów fitness znajdujących się w portfelu Medicover, dla naszych pracowników oznacza to nowe możliwości rozwoju zawodowego, dostęp do programu z zakresu wellbeing oraz platformy benefitowej Medicover. Obecnie do naszego zespołu poszukujemy osób na stanowisko:

Rozpocznij trening swojej kariery i dołącz do #TeamWellFitness, który wspiera w budowaniu zdrowych nawyków!

Lokalizacja: ul. Natalii 2, 93-317 Łódź
Forma zatrudnienia: umowa zlecenie lub kontrakt gospodarczy (przy indywidualnej działalności gospodarczej)
Wymagane doświadczenie: wykształcenie kierunkowe lub ukończony kurs instruktora ćwiczeń siłowych lub trenera personalnego - warunek konieczny
Tryb pracy: dostosowany do Twoich potrzeb

Pracuj z nami!

  • prowadź treningi personalne i zajęcia grupowe,
  • buduj relacje z Klubowiczami i pozyskuj nowych klientów,
  • dbaj o bezpieczeństwo i prawidłową technikę wykonywania ćwiczeń,
  • wspieraj promocję ofert klubu, a także w social media.

Co zyskasz?

  • sześć płatnych godzin onboardingu oraz szkoleń z ekspertami na start,
  • szkolenie „Organizacja pracy i biznes trenera” oraz dedykowany ebook: „Jak zwiększyć skuteczność w pozyskiwaniu klientów”,
  • darmowe członkostwo w sieci naszych klubów oraz preferencyjne warunki członkostwa dla trójki Twoich bliskich,
  • dostęp do bezpłatnych, wybranych szkoleń ProFi Fitness oraz stałych zniżek w szkołach partnerskich: Profi, RockFit i Rehasport,
  • atrakcyjne benefity pracownicze, w tym dofinansowanie do opieki medycznej Medicover, platforma e-learningowa, abonament Well Hydrated oraz realne możliwości rozwoju w firmie.

Co docenimy?

  • pełną dyspozycyjność do pracy,
  • doświadczenie w branży fitness,
  • samodzielność, wielozadaniowość i samodyscyplinę,
  • wiedzę z zakresu dietetyki, suplementacji lub fizjoterapii, którą chętnie podzielisz się z naszymi Klubowiczami.

Jak wygląda proces rekrutacyjny?​

  • Analiza CV
  • Kontakt telefoniczny z wybranymi kandydatami
  • Spotkanie online/stacjonarne
  • Decyzja i informacja zwrotna

Zastrzegamy możliwość wcześniejszego zakończenia rekrutacji. W przypadku zamknięcia procesu przesłane CV możemy uwzględnić w przyszłych rekrutacjach. ​

Poznaj nas lepiej! Zobacz materiał pokazujący codzienną pracę, atmosferę i ludzi,
którzy tworzą nasze kluby.

title: IT Infrastructure Manager
description:
Overview

Ready to lead a team that keeps our Associates connected, productive, and supported?

At Shure, we're looking for an experienced IT Infrastructure Manager to lead our regional support team across Europe, the UK, and India, and ensure our Associates have the tools, services, and support they need to succeed every day.

You'll empower a talented team, champion service excellence, and drive continuous improvement across our support operations. Working closely with business and IT leaders around the globe, you'll ensure outstanding user experience while helping us evolve our services, tools, and processes for the future.

If you thrive on leading people, elevating customer satisfaction, and turning challenges into opportunities, this is your chance to make a lasting impact.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a regional team of IT Support Analysts across the UK, Europe, and India, fostering a collaborative and high-performing support culture.
  • Ensure exceptional end-user support by overseeing the timely resolution of incidents and service requests while meeting established service levels and customer expectations.
  • Drive service excellence by managing support operations, ticket queues, escalations, and regional SLA performance.
  • Partner with business and IT leaders to continuously enhance the Associate experience and align support services with business needs.
  • Oversee hardware, software, and workplace technology support, ensuring reliable and efficient system operations.
  • Identify recurring issues, analyze support trends, and implement process improvements that increase service quality and operational efficiency.
  • Manage regional vendors, technology assets, software licensing, and support-related budget activities.
  • Develop and deliver user training, promote knowledge sharing, and encourage continuous learning across the support organization.
  • Lead performance management, mentoring, workforce planning, and career development initiatives for team members and contractors.
  • Champion ITIL-based service management practices and support a global follow-the-sun support model focused on continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • A degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
  • Around 7 years of experience in IT systems and services
  • Proven experience ibn a desktop support role, with a strong understanding of industry practices and company policies
  • Proven leadership and people management skills, with a motivational mindset and a passion for team development.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and sound judgment in technical decision-making.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work confidently across all levels of the business.
  • Highly organised, with great attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable setting goals, managing schedules, and ensuring teams follow processes and meet performance expectations.
  • Familiarity with ITIL service management and a drive for continuous improvement
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple requests simultaneously.
  • Strong technical judgment in selecting the right tools, methods, and approaches to resolve complex IT challenges efficiently and effectively.

PAY TRANSPARENCY

Shure offers a competitive compensation structure that is reviewed annually to attract, hire, and retain the industry’s top talent. Salaries vary based on qualifications, location, experience, and expertise in each respective discipline. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum salary for the opportunity. The salary for this position ranges from Euro 77.000 to Euro 123.000. This position may also be eligible for our incentive pay program, which varies based on individual and Company performance in the year. If your salary expectations do not align, still apply as we might be flexible on the seniority of posted positions. All positions also include a comprehensive benefits package.

WHO WE ARE

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.

Shure is headquartered in United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, distribution centers and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.

Join Shure and Amplify Your Impact. Explore our unique culture and learn the key pillars that define our legacy of excellence.

THE MIX MATTERS

Don’t check off every box in the job requirements? No problem! We recognize that every professional journey is unique and are committed to providing an equitable candidate experience for all prospective Shure Associates. If you’re excited about this role, believe you’ve got the skills to be successful, and share our passion for creating an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible work environment, then apply!

title: Monteur / medewerker fabricage
description:
Het bedrijf is een internationale speler, gespecialiseerd in productie van designer armaturen.


Jobomschrijving

Heb jij een passie voor techniek en werk je graag fijn en nauwkeurig? Zoek je een job met daguren, in een moderne KMO waar vakmanschap centraal staat? Dan is deze functie als Monteur / medewerker fabricage helemaal jouw ding!

Als monteur / medewerker fabricage sta je in voor het monteren en samenstellen van hoogwaardige lichtarmaturen, van ruwe plaat tot afgewerkt eindproduct. Je werkt volgens plan en combineert technisch inzicht met precisiewerk.

Concreet:

  • Je bedient en bewaakt de plaat- en plooimachine.
  • Je stelt het juiste programma in een freest en plooit de juiste onderdelen op maat.
  • Je soldeert onderdelen aan elkaar en werkt ze netjes af (opschuren inbegrepen).
  • Je verwerkt ook complexere stukken, zoals gebogen kappen met de rolbank.
  • Na bronzage en droogtijd stuur je het product door voor definitieve assemblage

  • Je volgde bij voorkeur een TSO-opleiding (carrosserie, houtbewerking, draaier/frezer ...) of hebt relevante ervaring
  • Je werkt graag zeer fijn en secuur
  • Je hebt ervaring met solderen
  • Je hebt technische affiniteit (opleiding of ervaring in bv. carrosserie, draaien/frezen, houtbewerking is een plus)
  • Je kan werken van maandag tot vrijdag van 8u tot 16u30
  • Je kan je zelfstandig verplaatsen naar Lokeren
  • Je werkt graag zelfstandig, maar bent ook een goede teamspeler

title: Employee Relations Case Advisor
