title: Senior Data Centre Facility Engineer
description:
Our client is a well established data centre and IT infrastructure company that focuses on providing carrier-neutral data centre services, network connectivity, managed services and related technology solutions.

They are looking for a motivated Senior Data Centre Engineer to support the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mission-critical data centre infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliable operation, maintenance, and optimisation of data centre facilities. This role provides technical leadership in managing critical M&E infrastructure, supports service delivery excellence, and ensures compliance with safety, operational, and regulatory standards.

Key Responsibilities

Data Centre Operations & Reliability

  • Oversee day-to-day operations of critical infrastructure including power, cooling, fire suppression, and monitoring systems.
  • Ensure high availability and resilience of all active and redundant systems.
  • Lead response to alarms, incidents, and emergencies, performing root cause analysis and corrective actions.

Maintenance & Engineering

  • Plan, supervise, and execute preventive and corrective maintenance activities.
  • Review maintenance procedures and implement improvements to enhance system reliability and efficiency.
  • Manage testing of backup systems (UPS, generators, switchgear, CRAC, etc.).

Technical Leadership

  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
  • Act as escalation point for complex technical issues.
  • Support audits, certifications, and compliance initiatives (e.g. ISO, SS 564, Uptime).

Customer & Stakeholder Support

  • Coordinate customer installations, move-ins, turn-ons, and infrastructure changes.
  • Ensure contracted SLAs and KPIs are met or exceeded.
  • Liaise with internal teams, vendors, and customers to support operational requirements.

Projects & Change Management

  • Support data centre projects, upgrades, and capacity expansion works.
  • Review technical designs, method statements, and risk assessments.
  • Oversee contractors and ensure works are carried out safely and in accordance with standards.

Safety, Compliance & Reporting

  • Ensure strict adherence to workplace safety, SOPs, and regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare incident reports, operational logs, and performance reports.
  • Participate in shift coverage and on-call rotation as required.

Requirements

  • Willing to work 24/7 rotating shifts
  • Willing to work at both locations
  • At least 4-5 years of relevant experience for a data centre

Work Locations: Bedok/Woodlands (Rotation of location will be required)

Working Hours

Morning Shift: 8.30am - 8.30pm

Night Shift: 8.30pm - 8.30am

(Shifts will rotate every 2 weeks)

Shift pattern: work 3 days rest 3 days, work 2 days rest 2 days

Salary

Up to $5500

Benefits

AWS, Variable Bonus, Allowances, Flexi benefits, 21 days annual leave

title: Lead Cloud Engineer (AWS)
description:
We are looking for a knowledgeable Lead Cloud Engineer with strong AWS expertise to join our team.

As an AWS Cloud Cost Optimization Engineer, you will enhance transparency around cloud expenditures by building a metrics-driven strategy for alerting, reporting, and refining cloud costs. The ideal candidate brings practical experience in DevOps or SRE, substantial background in analyzing and optimizing costs within large-scale AWS environments, a strong interest in data analysis, and the ability to work well with colleagues throughout the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Work alongside development and engineering groups to uncover optimization opportunities that boost ROI on cloud resources and enhance cost efficiency
  • Develop a deep understanding of the client's product, its cloud architecture and deployment approach, and the costs tied to each part of the environment
  • Guide architects and engineers on resource optimization, minimizing waste, managing capacity, and shaping KPIs
  • Track cloud expenditures to catch cost spikes and unusual usage patterns, digging into what's driving them
  • Monitor how cloud reservations and savings plans are being used, coordinating with teams to redirect available capacity
  • Examine data trends and irregularities to produce insights that guide both strategic and day-to-day decisions
  • Spot potential savings tied to cloud commitment options (Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, Spot Instances, Committed/Sustained Use) and keep tabs on their usage
  • Identify inefficient areas and craft practical optimization strategies
  • Construct, refresh, and sustain dashboards, reports, and automated tools for tracking cost, usage, alerts, and forecasts
  • Set up dashboards and automated reporting mechanisms to monitor adherence to cost targets
  • Help establish, refine, automate, and oversee governance for cost optimization policies and best practices
  • Communicate KPIs and propose savings opportunities to appropriate stakeholders
  • Coordinate with engineering teams to confirm that cost-saving measures are delivering results

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of professional experience with AWS cloud infrastructure, encompassing cost reporting and large-scale cost optimization
  • A minimum of one year in a leadership or team management capacity
  • Background working with AWS EKS and containerization tools
  • Skilled use of cost management and cloud platforms including AWS Cost Explorer, AWS Cost and Usage Report, AWS Budgets, CloudHealth, AWS Managed Services, Amazon EC2, and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service
  • Familiarity with GitHub, Jenkins, and Terraform for handling version control, automation, and infrastructure provisioning
  • Demonstrated experience building cost optimization dashboards, models, and reports designed for engineering teams using cloud services
  • Keen attention to detail paired with a genuine interest in converting raw data into meaningful insights
  • Capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously, both independently and as part of a team
  • Strong communication abilities, both spoken and written, suited for technical and non-technical audiences alike
  • Genuine curiosity about and openness to adopting new and emerging technologies
  • Solid written and verbal English skills at a B2 level or higher

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with AWS Lambda for creating serverless applications and automating processes related to cost management
  • Experience using Amazon CloudWatch to monitor cloud resources and track key performance indicators
  • Understanding of Amazon S3 for overseeing and evaluating storage costs and usage trends
  • Background with Datadog for monitoring, generating alerts, and visualizing cloud infrastructure data
  • Practical skills in Python for writing scripts, automating processes, and creating custom tools to aid in cost analysis and reporting

Benefits

  • International projects with top brands
  • Work with global teams of highly skilled, diverse peers
  • Healthcare benefits
  • Employee financial programs
  • Paid time off and sick leave
  • Upskilling, reskilling and certification courses
  • Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning library and 22,000+ courses
  • Global career opportunities
  • Volunteer and community involvement opportunities
  • EPAM Employee Groups
  • Award-winning culture recognized by Glassdoor, Newsweek and LinkedIn

title: SIEM Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for a SIEM Platform Engineer to design, operate, and continuously improve enterprise security logging and monitoring capabilities. The role ensures reliable, high-quality telemetry for threat detection, incident response, digital forensics, and compliance, while optimizing platform performance, scalability, and cost.

The role follows a hybrid working model, with three days per week based in the office (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday).

Responsibilities

  • Engineer, configure, maintain, and monitor the SIEM platform, collectors, connectors, and supporting infrastructure
  • Onboard security-relevant logs from identity, endpoint, network, cloud, business applications, databases, and other environments
  • Design reliable data pipelines; develop parsing, normalization, transformation, timestamp handling, and contextual enrichment
  • Monitor telemetry health and resolve missing sources, ingestion delays, volume anomalies, schema changes, and connector failures
  • Support detection engineering with required fields, correlation logic, threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, and testing
  • Optimize ingestion, storage tiers, retention, query performance, licensing, and cost without reducing required security visibility
  • Maintain architecture diagrams, log-source inventory, onboarding standards, runbooks, ownership, and configuration records
  • Support SOC investigations, threat hunting, incident response, forensic data extraction, audits, and major incident resolution
  • Coordinate logging requirements and remediation with IT, Cloud, Network, IAM, Application, OT, vendors, and service providers

Requirements

  • Practical experience in SIEM engineering, security monitoring, log management, or security platform engineering
  • Hands-on expertise with an enterprise SIEM, preferably Microsoft Sentinel; Splunk, QRadar, Elastic, or Google SecOps are also relevant

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full Stack .NET Developer, C# / .NET 8 / Blazor, Kings Hill, Kent

KEY POINTS

  • Software that keeps people alive on live worksites, rail, highways, construction, aviation and energy
  • Hybrid, 2 days a week onsite in Kings Hill, West Malling
  • C# and .NET 8, Blazor / Razor and DAPR
  • React, Angular, Vue or MVC backgrounds also considered
  • Microservices, event-driven with Kafka and Azure Event Hubs
  • Azure and AWS, Docker and Kubernetes
  • Real-time geolocation and IoT telemetry from wearable devices
  • Scope to cross-train into Go
  • Claude Code, LLMs and agentic development workflows used day to day
  • Up to £60,000 depending on experience
  • Right to work in the UK required, no sponsorship available

WHAT YOU WOULD BE BUILDING

Our client builds a SaaS platform that keeps field workers safe on dangerous sites. Workers wear a device, the platform knows where they are relative to hazard zones, and it alerts before someone walks into one. Live across rail, highways, construction, aviation, water and energy. Trackside, roadworks, airfields. The places where being in the wrong spot at the wrong moment is a fatality rather than a near miss.

The software you write stops people being hit by trains and plant machinery.

WHY THE ARCHITECTURE LOOKS LIKE IT DOES

Position data streams continuously from GNSS, cellular, Bluetooth and UWB devices worn by workers in the field, over poor connectivity, at volume, where a dropped message has a safety consequence. That is why this is microservices with DAPR, event-driven with Kafka and Event Hubs, containerised on Kubernetes across two clouds. Not architecture for its own sake. A system that cannot go down.

The other half of the business is connectivity, putting high-speed networking into places that have none, including satellite and private 4G and 5G for critical national infrastructure. That is what makes the product work on a site in the middle of nowhere.

THE ROLE

Full Stack Developer in the SaaS engineering team, working with Product Owners, UX Designers and Test Engineers. Front to back, turning requirements and designs into production functionality across APIs, microservices, event-driven systems and the wider platform architecture.

Blazor and Razor on the front end, so no framework churn. You do not need commercial Blazor experience. Strong C# and .NET with React, Angular, Vue or MVC behind you is enough, and they will teach you DAPR and the positioning side.

WHAT YOU WOULD LEARN HERE

Most .NET roles in Kent at this level are a legacy monolith with a bit of Azure bolted on. Here you would pick up DAPR and distributed application patterns, Kubernetes, event-driven architecture with Kafka and Event Hubs, dual cloud across Azure and AWS, geospatial processing and real-time IoT telemetry, scope to cross-train into Go, and Claude Code and AI-assisted development as part of how the team actually works.

Two years here changes what your CV says about you.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Strong commercial C# and modern .NET / .NET Core
  • Full stack experience with Blazor, Razor, MVC, React, Angular or Vue
  • Designing and working with APIs, and an understanding of microservices
  • Commercial cloud experience with Azure and/or AWS
  • Test-driven development, unit and automated testing
  • Agile teams, Git, and strong problem solving and debugging
  • Right to work in the UK, no sponsorship available
  • Able to work onsite in Kings Hill 2 days a week

Small engineering team, so genuine ownership and direct visibility with the CTO and MD. Three stage process, all decision makers, and they can move quickly.

TO APPLY

Apply via this advert or email

We act as an internal agency, driving development for the full spectrum of Agoda consumer marketing collateral - brand campaigns, app and product launches, social content, performance creative, and experiential/event materials. This role sits at the intersection of motion design, visual storytelling, and generative AI. Combining strong design craft with traditional and AI-powered tools, you will develop concepts and create high-quality content that shapes how Agoda shows up across customers’ feeds, screens, and everyday moments.

Collaboration & Execution

title: FDE - Data Engineer
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission‑critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI‑powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well‑being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

The Role

Your role At Kyndryl, Forward Deployed Engineers work where data, cloud, and AI become real. This is not a traditional consulting role or a back‑office engineering position. Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with customers to design, build, and deploy modern data solutions that operate in complex, regulated, production environments. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) – Data Engineering & GCP, you will own defined delivery workstreams within customer engagements, designing and building scalable data platforms, pipelines, and data products primarily on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will operate with growing independence in customer environments, combining strong hands‑on Data Engineering expertise with business context. You will translate ambiguous business and data challenges into robust, production‑ready solutions, from rapid prototypes and MVPs through industrialization and production deployment. The role sits at the intersection of Data Engineering, Cloud Architecture, AI enablement, consulting, and delivery accountability. You will work across the data lifecycle—from ingestion and transformation to orchestration, governance, observability, and data serving—creating trusted data foundations for analytics, operational workloads, Machine Learning, and Generative AI. You will use modern engineering and AI‑assisted development tools to accelerate solution design, coding, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment, while building the customer trust required to drive adoption and long‑term impact.

What you will do

  • Customer Engagement & Solution Engineering: Partner directly with customers to understand business and data challenges and translate them into high‑quality, fit‑for‑purpose technical solutions, balancing delivery speed with scalability, maintainability, security, and long‑term architectural integrity.
  • Data Engineering on GCP: Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and data platforms using technologies such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer/Airflow, and Dataform, selecting the right services and patterns for each workload.
  • Data Architecture & Modernization: Contribute to the design and implementation of modern cloud data architectures, including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouse patterns, batch and streaming processing, and migrations from legacy or on‑premises data platforms to GCP.
  • Rapid Prototyping: Build and iterate PoCs, MVPs, and production‑oriented prototypes to validate architecture decisions, integration patterns, performance, and business value quickly with real customer data and environments.
  • Ownership, Deployment & Partnership: Own delivery workstreams end to end—from technical discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production stabilization. Work as part of the customer team rather than operating only as an external advisor.
  • Data Integration & Processing: Implement robust batch and real‑time ingestion, transformation, and processing patterns across heterogeneous data sources, APIs, databases, files, event streams, and enterprise platforms.
  • Production Engineering: Build solutions with production requirements in mind, including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, monitoring, observability, security, IAM, data quality, lineage, and operational supportability.
  • Performance & Cost Optimization: Troubleshoot and optimize data workloads for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost, particularly across BigQuery, Spark/Dataproc, Dataflow, and other GCP data services.
  • AI & ML Data Enablement: Build and integrate the data foundations required for Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions, including reliable data pipelines, feature preparation, data quality, vector and unstructured data processing, and integration with GCP AI services such as Vertex AI.
  • Field Intelligence: Systematically capture deployment learnings, reusable patterns, technical accelerators, and best practices from customer engagements and share them across Kyndryl engineering and delivery teams.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay current with the evolving GCP data ecosystem, modern Data Engineering practices, AI‑assisted engineering, and emerging technologies, applying new capabilities pragmatically to customer problems.
  • Platform & Engineering Contribution: Contribute reusable code, reference architectures, automation, frameworks, and feedback that improve Kyndryl’s Data & AI engineering capabilities and accelerate future customer engagements.

Required skills and experience

  • Programming Proficiency: Demonstrable expertise in Python, (or another modern language such as C#, Node.js or TypeScript); experience working with AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch is a plus.
  • Software Engineering: Solid grasp of the software delivery lifecycle, version control (Git & GitHub), and data engineering tools such as Pandas and Spark.
  • Cloud & Distributed Systems: Experience with cloud AI platforms (AWS, Azure, Google AI) and distributed computing architectures.

Preferred skills and experience

  • Open‑Source Ecosystems: Familiarity with community‑driven AI tools and libraries, including Hugging Face and relevant repositories.
  • T‑shaped Profile: Deep technical expertise in one or two domains, with broad understanding across AI/ML, cloud, and consulting.
  • Agentic AI Systems: Experience designing, building, or integrating multi‑agent systems and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Agent Framework, AutoGen, CrewAI), including the development of agent protocols and coordination mechanisms.
  • Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) & Knowledge Systems: Practical knowledge of deploying RAG architectures and integrating structured and unstructured knowledge sources into AI solutions.
  • Performance & Security: Knowledge of system‑level optimisation and security best practices for scalable AI systems.
  • Business Acumen: Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate technical value to diverse stakeholders, including executive audiences.
  • Flexibility: Willingness to travel and work on customer premises as required.
  • Education: Degree‑level qualification in Computer Science, Informatics, Data Science, Engineering, or a closely related discipline - or equivalent professional experience.

Being You

The 'Kyn' in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging - being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team - is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid‑friendly culture that supports your well‑being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in‑demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting‑edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands‑on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that.

title: Trainee Cyber Security
description:
Cyber Security Placement Programme - No Experience Required Are you looking to benefit from a new career in IT and Cybersecurity? Skills shortages in the IT sector are driving the need for qualified, entry-level career seekers and career changers.

The best part is you will not need any previous experience as fully accredited training, which includes tutor support and mentoring, provides you with the skills, practical knowledge and qualifications for you to secure a professional job and career in IT. You will also have the reassurance of a job guarantee (£26K-£35K) upon completion.

Whether you are working full time, part time or are unemployed, this package has the flexibility to be completed at a pace that suits you and can be completed in a few weeks or a few months (step 1 to 4 below). Your job and career goals are completed in 4 easy steps.

Step 1 - Accredited Online Training

The first step is completing a selection of professional, accredited and industry recognised courses from CompTIA which is the global leader in IT Technician, Networking and Cybersecurity training. The training is delivered via multimedia rich video tutorials, practice labs, presentations and quizzes through a portal that you study from home. You will also be assigned an expert tutor and a support mentor to help you throughout your training.

Step 2 - Practical Training

You will gain practical experience by using practice labs which enable you to practice and master what you have learned. Gaining practical hands-on experience gives you confidence to be proficient in your first IT role. This combination of theoretical and practical skills is what line managers need you to have to be effective and confident in your role.

Step 3 - Official exams

You will then go on to sit the CompTIA A+ and the CompTIA Network+ exams to give you the official certifications which will be recognised not only in the UK, but worldwide. The CompTIA A+ is the most asked for certificate for entry-level IT roles

and the certification most IT Managers start their own careers with. All PCs in a professional environment are networked to servers, cloud based or otherwise and the Network+ gives you a needed foundation level of knowledge in networking.

Step 4 - IT Technician placement (£26-£35K)

We work with you to secure your first role as an IT Technician, with a starting salary of anywhere between £26K-35K. Ideally you will need to gain two years’ experience in this role before you can progress into a cyber security role. While working as an IT Technician, we will release your second batch of training which is specifically designed to qualify you to move into the cybersecurity field. This official, accredited training consists of online training, practical training and an official exam (CompTIA Security+). Further we can tailor the package to include courses like the Certified Ethical Hacker and Certified Network Defender depending on your requirements and future direction.

Cybersecurity Role

Once you have completed all the mandatory training in step four and have gained two plus years experience in the IT industry, you will be ready to move into higher paying Cybersecurity roles. Our recruitment support team specialises in the IT and Cybersecurity space and roles at this level have an average starting salary of £35K.

We have been helping career changers and new career seekers gain new careers since 2009 and we are a CompTIA Gold Partner, accredited by the BCS (Chartered Institute of IT/ British Computer Society) and the EC-Council to ensure we provide the highest levels of training.

In addition, we are also ELCAS approved to help members of the Armed Forces, Service Leavers and Veterans gain rewarding careers in IT and Cybersecurity.

Job Guarantee

Due to the success of this programme and the skills shortage of entry-level IT staff, we can guarantee you will secure a job upon completion of your study programme or we will refund you up to 100% of your course fees back. This is subject to our terms of learning/ terms of business.

Passionate about starting a career in IT? Apply now and one of our friendly advisors will be in touch.

title: Senior Tax Consultant - Global Mobility
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Tax Consultant specializing in Global Mobility to join our dynamic tax advisory team. In this role, you will work in a collaborative team on diverse projects related to personal taxation, social security, immigration, and payroll for internationally mobile employees.

You will manage tax advisory and compliance projects, maintain ongoing client relationships, and contribute to the development of junior colleagues. You will collaborate with specialists from Romania and across the international Forvis Mazars network, gaining exposure to multicultural environments and cross-border projects.


We’re always looking ahead – for you, our clients and the communities we’re part of. Together, we grow, belong and impact.

We’ll support you to learn, explore, and grow as you take this journey with us. Here, you’ll feel safe to share bold ideas and unique perspectives. After all, success comes from working together. At Forvis Mazars, you’ll belong to your local team, gain global experience and have an impact – now and in the future.


What will you do:

  • Analyze the individuals’ tax implication of international mobility scenarios, including tax residency, employment income and employment-related income, and the application of double tax treaties.
  • Advise clients on cross-border employment arrangements, international assignments, and the related tax, social security, immigration, and payroll considerations.
  • Coordinate compliance processes, including tax registrations, personal income tax returns, tax equalization and payroll calculations, and immigration-related formalities.
  • Prepare technical advice, memoranda, reports, and client communications.
  • Review calculations, tax returns, and other deliverables prepared by junior colleagues, providing guidance, technical support, and feedback.
  • Manage multiple client engagements simultaneously, monitor deadlines, and maintain proactive communication with clients and internal teams.
  • Participate in client meetings and support discussions with the relevant authorities when required.
  • Keep up to date with legislative and regulatory developments and contribute to technical alerts, client updates, and internal knowledge-sharing materials.
  • Contribute to business development initiatives, proposal preparation, and client relationship activities in collaboration with the management team.


What we need from you for this job:

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in personal taxation and/or Global Mobility advisory;
  • A university degree in economics, law, or another relevant field; postgraduate studies or professional tax qualifications are considered an advantage.
  • Solid knowledge of personal income tax and social security contributions, together with an interest in international taxation, double tax treaties, social security coordination, and immigration matters.
  • The ability to work independently on complex assignments with limited supervision and experience reviewing the work of junior team members.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Romanian and English; knowledge of an additional foreign language is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical skills, initiative, attention to detail, and the ability to explain technical concepts in a clear and practical manner.
  • A client-focused mindset, commitment to quality, a proactive and practical approach, and the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and projects.


What we offer:

  • A competitive financial package, including but not limited to budget for a flexible benefit platform, health insurance, yearly performance bonuses and, based on your tenure within Forvis Mazars, private pension fund;
  • An environment where personal development is encouraged;
  • Intensive training through internal and external training sessions;
  • Support in obtaining relevant professional qualifications, full program costs supported by Forvis Mazars and extra 5 days/year for training purposes;
  • A collaborative and people-focused culture that encourages knowledge sharing, initiative, and continuous development;
  • Exposure to local and international clients across a wide range of industries, as well as diverse and challenging Global Mobility projects.


*Please note that only candidates whose qualifications closely align with the role requirements will be contacted.

title: Maintenance Technican I
description:
As a Maintenance Technician II at Superior Tire & Rubber Corp., you will be responsible for the installation, repair, and upkeep of machinery in manufacturing and production facilities. Our primary goal is to ensure equipment runs efficiently to maximize productivity and lifespan while minimizing downtime.

Essential Job Functions:

Planning/Coordinating Product:

  • Review daily schedule with Team Leader or Supervisor at start of each shift to establish correct work orders and preventative maintenance tasks to be completed.
  • Coordinate with Supervisor or Team Leader correct parts are available to complete assigned work orders

Safety and Compliance:

  • Follow all safety protocols and guidelines to ensure a safe working environment.
  • Comply with company policies, procedures, and standards.
  • Wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), as required.
  • Attend daily safety meetings
  • Perform daily crane, grinder, and lift inspections.

Team Collaboration:

  • Work closely with team members, supervision, and other cross-functional teams to achieve production and maintenance goals.
  • Communicate effectively with supervisors and team members regarding work order status and any issues.

SPS Responsibilities:

  • Support production to remain On-Quality, On-Time & On-Cost
  • Follow the 5S principles: Sort, Set, Shine, Standardize, and Sustain
  • Look for ways to improve production efficiency and safety using SPS Practices
  • Keep your work area organized and ready for daily 5S inspections

Working Responsibilities:

  • Preventative Maintenance: Performing routine checks, cleaning, and lubrication on motors, gears, and production machines to prevent malfunctions before they occur.
  • Repairs & Replacements: Disassembling machinery to remove defective parts and installing new components using hand and power tools.
  • Calibrations Support: Assist Senior Staff with setting up and calibrating equipment and machinery according to engineering specifications with some assistance from senior staff.
  • Mechanical Troubleshooting Support: Assist Senior Staff with diagnosing the root causes of mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic malfunctions with some assistance from senior staff.
  • Electrical Troubleshooting Support: Assist senior staff in diagnosing the root causes of electrical issues involving control circuits and line voltages up to 480V.
  • Fabrication: Using machine shop equipment like grinders and welding tools to create or repair metal parts.
  • Documentation: Maintaining detailed maintenance logs and reports, through Asset Essentials and OneNote
  • Training: Instruct and teach Maintenance Technicians level I on common preventive maintenance, repairs and replacements, calibrations and documentation.

Other Duties:

  • Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • No direct supervisory role but may include training or mentorship opportunities and responsibilities.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:

  • Full Time Non-Exempt
  • Monday through Friday
  • Weekends as needed.
  • Required to work onsite 100% of the time.

Travel:

  • Occasional travel in the Warren area

Work Environment:

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee regularly works in an industrial manufacturing environment.
    • Percentage of Manufacturing and Distribution - 100%

Physical Demands:

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands and fingers to handle, feel, or operate objects, tools or controls, and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to stand, kneel, and communicate
  • Occasional heavy lifting of up to 50 pounds.

Required and Experience:

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 0-1 Years Experience in industrial maintenance role OR repairing mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic systems.

Competencies/Skills:

  • Able to read/write and do basic math.
  • Good problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Basic math skills and ability to use measuring tools.
  • Ability to use computer and Microsoft Office Suite
  • Physical ability to lift and move materials as needed.

Growth and Advancement

  • The Maintenance Technician I role provides a structured path for advancement to the Maintenance Technician II position. Promotion is based on skill development, reliability, and leadership readiness

title: Verantwoordelijke Boekhouding België & Luxemburg
description:
Voor Meilleurtaux BeLux, onderdeel van de Meilleurtaux Peasy-groep, zijn we op zoek naar een nieuwe collega om ons Finance-team te versterken in het kader van een vervanging.

Samen bouwen we aan een nationaal platform dat Belgische gezinnen begeleidt bij hun behoeften op het vlak van krediet, verzekeringen en sparen.

In deze context zijn we op zoek naar een ervaren Verantwoordelijke Boekhouding, die verantwoordelijk zal zijn voor de boekhouding van onze Belgische en Luxemburgse entiteiten.

Als onderdeel van het Finance-team ben je verantwoordelijk voor de volledige boekhoudkundige cyclus, van het inboeken van verrichtingen tot en met de voorbereiding van afsluitingen, jaarrekeningen en fiscale aangiftes. Deze functie vereist een grote mate van zelfstandigheid, een grondige technische kennis van de Belgische boekhouding en een sterk analytisch vermogen om financiële gegevens te analyseren en te bewaken.

Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Instaan voor de volledige boekhouding van de Belgische en Luxemburgse entiteiten: aankoop- en verkoopfacturen, banken, financiële verrichtingen en diverse boekingen.
  • Uitvoeren van de maandelijkse en jaarlijkse afsluitingen en instaan voor de betrouwbaarheid van de boekhouding.
  • Opstellen en controleren van proef- en saldibalansen, resultatenrekeningen en balansen.
  • Voorbereiden van Belgische en Luxemburgse btw-aangiftes en andere fiscale en administratieve verplichtingen.
  • Meewerken aan de voorbereiding van fiscale aangiftes, waaronder de Belgische vennootschapsbelasting (ISOC) en de Luxemburgse belastingaangifte.
  • Opvolgen van voorzieningen, over te dragen kosten, afschrijvingen en vaste activa.
  • Controleren en boeken van loon-gerelateerde elementen: loonboekingen, voorzieningen, eindejaarspremie, vakantiegeld en analytische verdelingen.
  • Instaan voor de intercompany-reconciliaties tussen België en Luxemburg.
  • Uitvoeren van de matching, analyse en regelmatige opschoning van de boekhoudrekeningen.
  • Opvolgen van ontvangen commissies en deze afstemmen met de boekhouding.
  • Opvolgen van leveranciersbetalingen, terugbetalingen aan klanten en ontvangsten.
  • Meewerken aan het cashmanagement en de opvolging van de cashflow.
  • Instaan voor de opvolging van de bankzaken en de dagelijkse contacten met banken.
  • Voorbereiden van de nodige gegevens voor de maandelijkse financiële rapportering en meewerken aan de analytische opvolging van de kosten.
  • Onderhouden van de opvolging en contacten met de Belgische en Luxemburgse boekhoudkantoren.

Requirements

  • Je beschikt over een hoger diploma in boekhouding, financiën of een gelijkwaardige opleiding.
  • Je hebt minstens 10 jaar ervaring in een boekhoudkundige functie.
  • Je beheerst het volledige boekhoudkundige proces, van het inboeken van verrichtingen tot het opstellen van de balans en de verschillende fiscale aangiftes.
  • Ervaring opgedaan binnen een boekhoudkantoor of accountantskantoor is een sterke troef.
  • Je hebt een uitstekende kennis van de Belgische boekhouding en de BEGAAP-regels.
  • Je beschikt over een grondige kennis van btw en de Belgische fiscaliteit.
  • Ervaring met de Luxemburgse boekhouding en fiscaliteit is een belangrijke meerwaarde.
  • Je hebt een uitstekende kennis van Excel, een onmisbare tool voor het uitvoeren van analyses, controles, reconciliaties en rapporteringen.
  • Kennis van het boekhoudprogramma BOB 50 is noodzakelijk.
  • Je beheerst het Nederlands uitstekend. Kennis van het Engels is een bijkomende troef.

Benefits

Wanneer je bij ons komt werken, maak je deel uit van een dynamische onderneming en een geëngageerd team, binnen een stimulerende en aangename werkomgeving.

Daarnaast bieden we aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een contract van onbepaalde duur (voltijds – 38 uur per week).
  • Een jaarlijks brutoloon tussen €55.000 en €60.000, afhankelijk van je profiel en ervaring.
  • Een aantrekkelijk en volledig salarispakket met onder meer een bedrijfswagen, tankkaart, hospitalisatieverzekering, maaltijdcheques van €8 per gewerkte dag, een eindejaarspremie en extra vakantiedagen.
  • Een uitgebreid onboarding- en opleidingstraject, zodat je alle nodige ondersteuning krijgt om je functie volledig op te nemen, je expertise verder te ontwikkelen en binnen de onderneming te groeien.

title: Staff Mobile Engineer
description:
About the Company

At Rezilient, we’re redefining primary care by making access to healthcare more convenient, timely, and seamless. Our innovative CloudClinic model combines virtual provider visits with cutting-edge technology to create a personalized digital healthcare experience that puts patients at the center of their care. By streamlining care delivery and continuously expanding specialty services, we empower our care team to focus on patient well-being while providing the most comprehensive and accessible care possible.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Staff Mobile Engineer to own the technical strategy and architecture for Rezilient’s member mobile app, the main way our members experience their care between visits. This role is for a hands-on senior technical leader who has built and scaled consumer-grade native mobile health apps, and who will lead the rebuild of our app alongside a new brand, making multi-quarter platform decisions that are costly to reverse and being trusted to get them right.

You’ll work as a triad with our Senior Product Manager and Senior UX Designer for member experience, partner with Clinical and Engineering leaders to connect the app to care delivery, wearable device data, and AI-enabled features, and serve as technical lead and mentor for our front-end and mobile engineers. Your work determines whether members want to come back to the app, and how safely and reliably Rezilient delivers care through it, advancing our mission to make humane healthcare truly abundant.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own mobile technical strategy and architecture for the member app across iOS and Android, making multi-quarter decisions (including where our React Native codebase should stay cross-platform and where it should go native) that the organization trusts to be right.
  • Lead hands-on delivery of the rebuilt member app alongside our new brand, writing production code while setting the patterns other engineers follow.
  • Set mobile engineering standards that become the default way to build: app architecture, state and offline data handling, performance budgets, accessibility, testing, and code review.
  • Build mature release engineering: automated build, test, and release pipelines, code signing, phased rollouts, feature flags, over-the-air update policy, App Store and Google Play review, and crash-free rate and performance reported weekly.
  • Design secure, low-friction authentication and on-device data handling for PHI, including biometrics, session management, secure storage, and HIPAA-aligned logging and analytics.
  • Architect how health and device data reach the member, including Apple HealthKit, Android Health Connect, and third-party wearables APIs, so data is useful to members and trustworthy in clinical workflows.
  • De-risk the hardest mobile bets before they consume the organization, including safe patterns for AI-enabled features in members’ hands and for AI-assisted development of the app itself.
  • Work as a triad with our Senior Product Manager and Senior UX Designer to shape a consumer-grade experience, using product analytics, experimentation, and member feedback to drive engagement and retention, and grow our front-end and mobile engineers through mentorship, pairing, and design reviews.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
  • 12–15 years of software engineering experience, including 7+ years building and shipping native mobile apps and a track record of owning mobile architecture through significant scale or growth.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in native iOS (Swift, SwiftUI and UIKit, Swift concurrency, Xcode) and native Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines and Flow, Gradle) development.
  • Shipped and scaled at least one consumer (B2C or B2B2C) mobile health, wellness, or fitness app with a large active user base, with strong product instincts for onboarding, engagement, and retention.
  • Experience integrating health data platforms and connected devices, such as Apple HealthKit, Android Health Connect, Bluetooth LE, or third-party wearables APIs.
  • Deep expertise in mobile security and compliance, including HIPAA-aligned handling of PHI on device, secure authentication (OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, biometrics), and encrypted local storage.
  • Proven mobile release discipline: CI/CD (e.g., Fastlane, Bitrise, GitHub Actions), automated testing (e.g., XCTest, Espresso, Detox, Maestro), crash and performance monitoring (e.g., Crashlytics, Sentry), and app store release management.
  • Proven technical leadership, making architectural decisions across teams, growing senior engineers, and partnering with Product, Design, and Clinical leaders on strategy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Production experience with React Native and TypeScript, including the New Architecture (Fabric, TurboModules) and native module development, with sound judgment about when to go native.
  • Experience leading a mobile app rebuild or re-platform, including incremental migration of a live app without disrupting members.
  • Experience shipping AI- or LLM-powered features in a consumer mobile app.
  • Familiarity with regulatory and platform considerations for digital health apps, such as FDA general wellness versus software-as-a-medical-device boundaries and App Store health data policies.
  • Experience in a startup or growth-stage environment.

Benefits

At Rezilient Health, we're on a mission to make humane healthcare truly abundant, and we invest in the people who make that possible. This is a high-impact role where your ideas directly shape how care is delivered, within a supportive, collaborative, and diverse team that believes healthcare is fundamentally a human experience. We back that commitment with a robust total rewards package:

  • Meaningful ownership through stock options, allowing you to share directly in the value you help create as we grow
  • Competitive base compensation
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage options, with Rezilient contributing toward your premiums
  • Complimentary access to Rezilient's clinical programs for you and your household members, the same connected care we deliver to our patients
  • 401(k) retirement plan to support your long-term financial well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off, so you can recharge without counting days
  • Dedicated Paid Sick Leave, separate from your FTO, for when health needs come first
  • 11 paid company holidays each year
  • Paid family leave to support you through life's biggest moments
  • Optional ancillary benefits, including life insurance, disability coverage, and a Health Savings Account (HSA)

title: Principal Biomechanical Engineer
description:
Join Rimkus and unlock your potential with endless opportunities for growth, learning, and making a difference!

Rimkus ( is a worldwide leader in Engineering and Technical Consulting. Rimkus experts specialize in building envelope, engineering, forensic consulting, dispute resolution, construction management services, and solutions built for the environment.

NOW IS THE TIME to join this growing and stable company! We offer our full-time employees a competitive salary, bonus opportunities and a full benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, disability, employer-matching 401(k), and opportunities for advancement!

OVERVIEW:

Conducts technical investigations, analysis, and testimony in commercial and personal injury litigation and failure analysis involving medical equipment and accompanying procedural issues within a hospital or healthcare setting. Provides human-injury impact analysis in vehicular accidents, amusement park ride accidents, and cases involving falls or falling objects by performing occupant motion studies to determine injury potential/causation, seatbelt use, the effects of airbag interaction, and determination of occupant positions. Duties include using computer and physical models to re-construct accidents, to measure the load and injury levels, and to prepare written reports of findings.

Requirements

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Performs human-injury impact analysis of vehicular accidents, mechanical failures, falls, and falling objects.
  • Analyzes vehicular accidents, and mechanical failures, and reconstructs vehicular accidents.
  • Prepares written reports of findings in clear, concise, easy-to-understand terms.
  • Provides testimony in depositions and the courtroom.
  • Conducts human motion and injury impact analyses.
  • Analyzes injuries resulting from automobile, industrial, marine, and recreational accidents.
  • Conducts on-site vehicle examinations and provides written findings and conclusions.
  • Review various media (e.g., photographs, witness statements, depositions, police reports, medical and chiropractic records, etc.) to provide logical conclusions.
  • Locates and applies research of pertinent literature and governmental regulations.
  • Applies mathematical and empirical methods of analyses.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION, and CERTIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum master’s degree in biomedical or biomechanical engineering. A Ph.D. is preferred.
  • PE license preferred or the ability to obtain it within 1 year.
  • Minimum of 4+ years in biomedical engineering or biomechanical engineering with a master’s degree and will consider less experience for candidates with a Ph.D.
  • ACTAR certification preferred or the ability to obtain it within six months.

REQUIRED SKILLS and ABILITIES:

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Background in forensic engineering preferred.
  • Cognitive problem-solving skills required.
  • Experience working in anatomy, teaching, or the automotive industry is helpful.
  • Working knowledge of general PC applications and software.

Physical Demands, Overtime, and Travel Requirements

  • Physical Demands - Work is performed both in an office setting and at outside locations (i.e. Client’s office, industrial, construction, and/or residential sites). The employee is frequently required to stand, walk on slope roofs, sit, climb ladders, bend, climb inside attics and crawl under homes and tunnels, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, talk, hear, and drive a motor vehicle to job sites. Employees may lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Employees must be sharp, focused, and alert when conducting site inspections, speaking and interacting with clients, preparing written reports of findings, and testifying in deposition or trial. Clear vision and depth perception are also necessary.
  • Overtime - This position is classified as salaried with an exempt FLSA status. Regular working hours are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday, with one hour for lunch. There will be periods where overtime will be required, which the employee will need to comply with to meet the demands of the position.
  • Travel Requirements - This position requires up to 25% travel. Some out-of-area and overnight travel may be required.

At Rimkus, we value a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and respected. We are committed to creating a work environment that supports and celebrates the unique perspectives and experiences of all employees. If you share our commitment to diversity and inclusivity and are excited about joining a welcoming and supportive team, we encourage you to apply for our open positions.

Rimkus is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and will make all employment-related decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

title: Financial Crime Analyst
description:
Aviso Wealth:

At Aviso, we are dedicated to improving the financial well-being of Canadians. As a leading wealth management organization, we are committed to leadership, innovation, partnership, responsibility, and community. Working with talented and energetic professionals who exemplify our values every day, you will quickly notice that our people and dynamic ‘oneaviso’ culture sets us apart. If you are looking for interesting and challenging work, at a company committed to its people, find out more about what Aviso has to offer at www.aviso.ca.

The Opportunity:

We’re looking to fill an opening for a Financial Crime Analyst to join our Compliance team.

Reporting to the Manager AML Compliance, the Financial Crime Analyst is responsible for reviewing incidents of suspected fraud and AML risks against Aviso and its clients and ensure compliance to regulatory requirements and internal policy controls. The Financial Crime Analyst will conduct in-depth investigations and effectively take appropriate actions.

As oneaviso:

  • We Care – You do the right thing for clients, partners and colleagues. You build trusted relationships, champion service excellence, and contribute to a culture where people feel valued and supported
  • We Dare –You challenge the status quo with bold ideas and fresh perspectives. You embrace change, seek opportunities to innovate and are comfortable exploring new ways of working
  • We Share – You collaborate openly and build meaningful relationships. You seek out diverse perspectives, share your knowledge and work together to help colleagues, clients and partners succeed
  • We Deliver – You take ownership of your work, honour your commitments and focus on delivering meaningful results. You hold yourself accountable and continuously look for ways to improve

What your day looks like:

  • Day to day analysis and assessment of fraud and AML alerts including detailed review of client records and account activity
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders (e.g., other Financial Institutions) as required
  • Document actions and information reviewed throughout an investigation to develop and maintain case files, including drafting complete and concise investigation reports and regulatory filings
  • Remediate activity deemed fraudulent/suspicious as per regulatory and internal policies
  • Identify through fraud case analysis opportunities and business process review to enhance internal policies, procedures, and controls
  • High risk client monitoring
  • Provide fraud and AML guidance and clarification on requirements to stakeholders
  • From time to time, support compliance initiatives

Requirements

Your experience and skills:

  • 5 years experience in a securities dealer environment. Experience in a fraud, AML or compliance role is an asset.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and investigation skills
  • Strong attention to detail and high degree of accuracy
  • Proven ability to build and develop mutually beneficial relationships at all levels
  • Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) designation, Certified Financial Crime Specialist (CFCS) designation, Certified Financial Crimes Investigator (CFCI) designation, Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) Certification or Canadian Securities Course (CSC) is an asset
  • Strong communication skills in English are required, both verbal and written. Bilingual skills in French are an asset

Benefits

Why Aviso Wealth?

At Aviso Wealth, you will find a dynamic and inclusive culture that rewards innovation and celebrates success.
Here are a few things that set us apart:

  • Competitive compensation package that rewards and recognizes individual contributions
  • Excellent health, dental and insurance benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees
  • Generous vacation time, fitness benefit, parental leave top-up options
  • Matching contributions to our retirement program
  • Commitment to the continuous improvement of our staff through learning & development and an education assistance program
  • Regular social events to foster teamwork

Your Information

By submitting your application, you consent to the collection, use, and disclosure of your provided personal information for the purposes of assessing your qualifications and suitability for employment with Aviso. Your information will be handled in accordance with applicable Canadian privacy laws, including the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) and relevant provincial legislation. Your data may be shared with authorized personnel involved in the recruitment process and retained only as long as necessary to fulfill these purposes or as required by law.

Further information is available on the Privacy link on our Career Page – Privacy Policies

Equal Employment Opportunity

Aviso welcomes and encourages applications from all qualified individuals including persons with disabilities. If you require an accommodation, we will work with you to meet your needs in all stages of the hiring process.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted.

No recruiters or agencies, please.

Company Overview:

Aviso is a leading wealth management and investment services provider for the Canadian financial industry, with approximately $145 billion in total assets under administration and management, and over 1,000 employees. We’re building a comprehensive, technology-enabled, client-centric wealth services ecosystem. Our clients include our partners, advisors, and investors. We’re a trusted partner for nearly all credit unions across Canada, in addition to a wide range of portfolio managers, investment dealers, insurance and trust companies, and introducing brokers. Our partners depend on Aviso for specific solutions that give them a competitive edge in a rapidly evolving, highly competitive industry. Our investment dealer and mutual fund dealer and our insurance services support thousands of investment advisors. Our asset manager, NEI Investments, specializes in investing responsibly. Our online brokerage, Qtrade Direct Investing®, empowers self-directed investors, and our fully automated investing service, Qtrade Guided Portfolios®, serves investors who prefer a hands-off approach. Aviso Correspondent Partners provides custodial and carrying broker services to a wide range of firms. We have offices in Toronto, Vancouver, and Montreal. Aviso is backed by the collective strength of our owners: the credit union Centrals, Co-operators/CUMIS, and Desjardins. We’re proud to power businesses that empower investors.

A career with Aviso means being part of a group of talented, energetic professionals who live their values every day, and belonging to an organization dedicated to your success and career development. If you’re looking for interesting and challenging work, at a company committed to its people, apply to join our team.

Salary

title: Internal Call Only - (RFP500611) Job Trainee, Cacao of Excellence (Temporary Assignment, 6 months- Rome,Italy)
company: Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT
description:
(RFP500611)

Job Trainee, Cacao of Excellence

(Temporary Assignment, 6 months- Rome, Italy)


The Organization


Cacao of Excellence, led by the CGIAR’s Alliance of Bioversity International and the International Center for Tropical Agriculture (CIAT), is a neutral global platform that brings together the public and private sector to discover, promote, and reward cacao producers of excellence from all origins, focusing on superior cacao quality and flavour diversity. Since 2009, the platform has held the prestigious global Cacao of Excellence Awards, celebrating and rewarding the work of cacao producers and showcasing the diversity of exceptional flavours worldwide. By leading cacao research, discovering exceptional producers and training the next generation of value chain actors, Cacao of Excellence’s is supporting the expansion of superior quality cacao, ensuring more producers thrive as empowered entrepreneurs.

The CGIAR Alliance of Bioversity International and the International Center for Tropical Agriculture (CIAT) delivers research-based solutions that harness agricultural biodiversity and sustainably transform food systems to improve people’s lives. Alliance solutions address the global crises of malnutrition, climate change, biodiversity loss, and environmental degradation. With novel partnerships, the Alliance generates evidence and mainstreams innovations to transform food systems and landscapes so that they sustain the planet, drive prosperity, and nourish people in a climate crisis. The Alliance is part of CGIAR, a global research partnership for a food-secure future.

/ /


About the position

Based in Rome, Italy, and under the supervision of the Cacao of Excellence, Manager of the Program, the incumbent will provide support with communications and partnership.

  • Provide assistance with communications and follow-up actions with partners, collaborators, trainees, and other stakeholders, maintaining accurate records and supporting relationship management.
  • Assist in the planning, logistics, and delivery of events, workshops, and partner meetings, promoting cacao producers, Cacao of Excellence trainees, and strategic collaborations.

Communications & Outreach

  • Research, draft, and edit engaging online content, including web stories, opinion editorials, articles, and infographics.
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of creative communication and social media campaigns supporting major Cacao of Excellence projects, partnerships, and events.
  • Draft, edit, proofread, and update content for the Cacao of Excellence website and other communication channels, ensuring consistency and high editorial standards.
  • Support the maintenance and organization of communication assets, including mailing lists, email subscribers, photographs, videos, and other digital resources.
  • Contribute to Development of communication materials that highlight programme achievements, partner collaborations, and project impacts.

Programme Support

  • Provide communication and project support to the Innovation, Genetic Diversity, and Capacity Building pillars, including assisting in the development of project-specific communication materials.
  • Participate in national and international events, providing communications, coordination, and logistical support as required.
  • Provide additional programme, partnership, communications, and administrative support as required to contribute to the objectives of the Cacao of Excellence Programme.



Requirements

Essential Requirements

  • Secondary school education.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite packages.
  • Working knowledge of the English language, both written and spoken.
  • Good interpersonal, communication and teamwork skills, courtesy and tact, and the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with people of different cultural and national backgrounds.
  • Good skills in personal organization and priority setting.
  • Good client orientation and service approach.
  • Good time management skills and attention to details.
Desirable Requirements
  • Previous internships.
  • Work experience in an international environment.


Benefits

Terms of employment

This is a job traineeship based in Rome, Italy, open to internal candidates, namely: regular staff members, complementary staff members, and individuals who are currently employed or have completed a contract with Bioversity in the last 12 months. The monthly salary is Euro 1,217. The contract is initially for a period of six (6) months. The contract may be extendable based on performance and availability of funds.

The Alliance of Bioversity International & CIAT is committed to fair, safe, and inclusive workplaces. We believe that diversity powers our innovation, contributes to our excellence, and is critical for our mission. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization that reflects our global character is a priority. We encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability statuses, sexual orientations, marital status, and gender identities. Female candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Talent Management & Development Intern
description:
LUXASIA is the leading and largest beauty omnichannel brand-builder of Asia Pacific. With LUXASIA, an exciting career filled with robust professional growth awaits you. Isn’t that beautiful?

Over six months, you will experience how talent and learning programmes come together from design and execution to measurement and improvement. You will work on real programmes, collaborate with regional stakeholders and external partners, use data to generate insights, and take ownership of projects that improve how we develop our people.

  • Coordinate L&D administration including registrations, communications, publicity aids, learning materials, attendance and feedback.
  • Support group-wide learning needs analysis and research relevant learning trends, topics and potential speakers for initiatives such as the Learning Festival.

If you are curious about people, passionate about learning and ready to turn ideas into action, this internship will give you the opportunity to learn by doing and make a meaningful contribution from day one.

Do you have what it takes to succeed in a fast-paced and intense environment? Do you thrive on challenges? Do you want to bring innovative ideas to life? Are you keen to abandon the status quo, try new things, embrace failures as lessons, recover fast, yet always pursue excellence?

title: Fysiotherapeut
description:
Binnen Careyn draait behandelen om meer dan oefenen alleen. Het gaat om meebewegen met mensen, aansluiten bij wat nog wél kan en samen werken aan kwaliteit van leven. Als Fysiotherapeut sluit je aan bij een betrokken, deskundig team dat met plezier samenwerkt en blijft ontwikkelen.

Dit ga je doen als Fysiotherapeut

Je levert fysiotherapeutische zorg op de Wlz-afdelingen, met focus op bewoners met een PG-zorgvraag. Hierbij staan beweging, zelfstandigheid en vertrouwen centraal. Je werkt zelfstandig, maar altijd in verbinding met collega’s en andere behandelaren.

Concreet betekent dat:

  • Behandelen van cliënten met PG problematiek binnen de locatie.

  • Afstemmen met collega‑behandelaren zoals ergo-, logo- en muziektherapeuten.

  • Toepassen van behandelmethoden die passen bij reablement, positieve gezondheid en leven in vrijheid.

  • Meedenken over en bijdragen aan vakinhoudelijke ontwikkelingen binnen het team.

Wat je van ons mag verwachten

  • Salaris volgens cao VVT, FWG 55: € 3.772 - € 5.413 (o.b.v. 36 uur).

  • Een vast contract voor 17 uur per week, bij voorkeur per november 2026.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding, 8% vakantietoeslag en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering.

  • Mogelijkheid om gebruik te maken van het meerkeuzesysteem, zoals extra verlof of een fietsregeling.

  • Toegang tot o.a. HeyCoach, budgetcoach en DigiCoach voor jouw ontwikkeling.

  • Bij Careyn krijg je meer dan de arbeidsvoorwaarden uit de cao VVT. Meer weten? Bekijk onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Wat jij meebrengt

  • Een afgeronde hbo‑opleiding Fysiotherapie.

  • Zelfstandigheid en het vermogen om bewust keuzes te maken in je behandeling.

  • Interesse in ontwikkelingen binnen de ouderenzorg en het toepassen daarvan in de praktijk.

  • Bereidheid om actief bij te dragen aan de vakgroep fysiotherapie Utrecht‑West.

Over het team

Je komt terecht in een warm en divers team van fysiotherapeuten met verschillende leeftijden en expertises, waaronder geriatriefysiotherapie en Parkinson. Op de locatie werk je samen binnen een multidisciplinair behandelteam met onder andere Specialisten Ouderengeneeskunde, psychologen, ergotherapeuten en logopedisten. Daarnaast maak je deel uit van de vakgroep fysiotherapie Utrecht‑West, een groep van ongeveer 20 collega’s die zich in de opstartfase bevindt en waarin ruimte is om mee te bouwen, ideeën te delen en samen het vak verder vorm te geven.

Om de veiligheid van onze cliënten en medewerkers te waarborgen, is voor alle medewerkers die bij Careyn in dienst komen een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) vereist. Bij gelijke geschiktheid krijgen interne sollicitanten voorrang ten opzichte van externe kandidaten.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:

title: CAD Mechanical Draughtsperson

title: Senior Development Officer
description:
WorldFish Bangladesh will implement the GIZ-funded “Strengthening Inclusive Marine Protected Area Management and Community-Based Blue-Economy Livelihoods in Coastal Bangladesh” project across the Nijhum Dwip, St. Martin’s, and Naf MPAs. The project contributes to the broader objectives of the CONNECT (Better Protection of Mangroves, Swamp Forests and Marine Areas) project in Bangladesh by strengthening evidence-based MPA management, inclusive governance, community participation, and sustainable blue-economy livelihoods.

The CONNECT project is commissioned and financed by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and implemented by the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH. The position focuses on strengthening Marine Protected Area (MPA) management through fisheries co-management, EAFM and community stewardship, while promoting inclusive, and climate-resilient blue-economy livelihoods for MPA-dependent communities.

Under the supervision of the Lead Scientist, the Senior Development Officer is responsible for conducting and guiding development activities, including data collection, collation, and database entry, while implementing stakeholder mapping and needs assessments to establish baseline conditions. The role involves engaging with field staff, organizing meetings with stakeholders and partners, developing and implementing capacity building activities, and facilitating multistakeholder discussions to drive knowledge dissemination and promote technology adoption. The Senior Development Officer ensures timely completion of development activities, verifies data accuracy, maintains up-to-date databases, and contributes to quarterly and annual reports for informed decision-making.

Duties and Responsibilities
Main Purpose of Job:

  • Conduct practical demonstrations and field days to transfer technical knowledge and promote technology adoption.
  • Conduct and guide development activities, including data collection, collation, and database entry on MPA management, fisheries governance, livelihoods, and socio-economic and ecological conditions of coastal communities.
  • Collaborate with partners and stakeholders to promote ecosystem-based fisheries management (EAFM) through effective fisheries co-management, and climate-resilient blue-economy livelihood approaches.
  • Conduct practical demonstrations / field days, (informal) trainings for stakeholders here to transfer knowledge.
  • Conduct focus group discussions and meetings with stakeholders to identify community priorities, assess livelihood opportunities, strengthen MPA governance, and inform fisheries and livelihood interventions.
  • Implement needs assessments, stakeholder mapping to identify baseline conditions.

Main engagement, collaboration and communication responsibilities:

  • Engage with and guide field staff to implement daily activities, providing guidance to ensure adherence to quality and timeline standards.
  • Report to supervisors and project leaders to keep them informed about progress and challenges in implementation.
  • Organize meetings stakeholders and partners to discuss, plan, and streamline activities.
  • Develop and maintain networks of partners to collaborate, share knowledge and build capacity.
  • Organize multistakeholder discussions to generate buy-in for innovations and/or development interventions.

Main responsibilities in the delivery of timely and quality services:

  • Monitor project / development activities to ensure timely completion of development activities and data collection.
  • Provide content to quarterly and annual progress reports based on development activities.
  • Review and verify data to ensure the accuracy and reliability of results for analysis and reporting purposes.
  • Maintain up-to-date databases and records to ensure easy access and high-quality information for decision-making.

Requirements

Education/ Certifications / Training

Bachelor’s degree in Fisheries, Marine Science, Environmental Science, Conservation Biology, Anthropology, Social Science, Humanities or similar discipline.

Experience

  • Experience in natural resource management, fisheries co-management, livelihood development, environmental monitoring, wildlife conservation, MPA management, or related socio-ecological fields.
  • Experience conducting and guiding data collection, collation, and database entry to support development projects.
  • Practical experience tracking development activities.
  • Practical experience conducting needs assessments, stakeholder mapping, and facilitating structured discussions with community groups.
  • Hands-on experience organizing and conducting field days, demonstrations, and informal training sessions to transfer technical knowledge.
  • Experience providing information for presentations and reports.
  • Experience working in an international not-for-profit organization is an advantage.

Competencies (Knowledge, Skills and Abilities)
Core competencies

  • Accountability- Collaborates with team members, taking responsibility for both individual and team success and seeks feedback to improve performance. Meets deadlines consistently and follows ethical guidelines.
  • Collaboration and Communication- Conveys information clearly and ensures the recipient understands the message. Fully engages in conversations and shares relevant information to support informed decision-making.
  • Respect and Inclusion- Acknowledges team members' contributions and collaborates effectively with diverse colleagues. Demonstrates flexibility and openness, supporting inclusive approaches that encourage full participation.
  • Results and Impact Orientation- Proactively identifies challenges and demonstrates effective problem-solving; Consistently fulfills commitments and respects the organization’s mission and values. Adapts to new processes, emerging technologies and evolving requirements to maintain efficiency
  • Functional and Technical Competencies
  • Analytical, Critical and Systems Thinking- Analyzes information from multiple sources to identify trends, draw conclusions, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Data Analysis, Management and Visualization- Verifies data accuracy and consistency, addresses simple errors, summarizes and organizes data, and interprets basic trends using available systems and evolving data methodologies to support decisions or activities.
  • Capacity Building- Adapts capacity building styles to audience needs, customizing capacity building methods based on objectives, and seeking feedback to improve the quality and relevance of capacity building activities
  • Planning and Organizing- Plans and manages multiple priorities and deadlines independently, using time management tools to stay on track, and effectively balances competing tasks while adjusting as needed.
  • Problem Solving- Analyzes information to identify root causes, collaborates with colleagues to gather information, and prioritizes critical factors to propose effective solutions
  • Additional Technical Competencies:

i) Marine Protected Area and Fisheries Management – Applies knowledge of fisheries management, MPAs, and co-management to support sustainable coastal and marine resource conservation.

ii) Community-Based Blue-Economy and Livelihood Development – Applies knowledge of sustainable livelihoods and blue-economy enterprises to improve community resilience and economic wellbeing.

iii) Stakeholder Engagement – Applies inclusive and participatory approaches to strengthen co-management, community stewardship, and stakeholder collaboration.

Benefits

This is a Nationally Recruited Staff (NRS) position with salary commensurate to the position level. WorldFish NRS shall receive comprehensive benefits including (but not limited to) insurance coverage for staff and eligible dependents, and pension / provident fund contribution.

Eligibility, Location and Duration
WorldFish are hiring two (02) positions and one of the incumbent will be based in Teknaf, Cox's Bazar while another one will be based in Charfassion, Bhola. Interviews are expected to be held in October 2026 and only shortlisted candidates will be notified and expected to attend the interview. The successful candidate should be available to commence in October 2026 for an initial one (1) year and four (4) months fixed term contract, with the possibility of contract renewal depending on performance and funding availability.

How to Apply

Interested applicants are invited to submit the following information online latest by 5 October 2026:

  • A cover letter including a 2-page (max) description of why you are an ideal candidate and what you would bring to the role.
  • A current curriculum vitae.
  • Names and contacts (telephone and e-mail addresses) of three professional referees who are familiar with your qualifications and work experience. Your nominated referees ideally should have persons from each of the following category: direct supervisor, head of HR and peer.

The screening will start immediately, and will continue until the position is filled. Due to the high volume of applicants for WorldFish positions, we appreciate all interest, but only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

Our Gender, Diversity and Inclusion Commitment

WorldFish has seven offices across Asia, Africa and the Pacific, with more than 400 staff and 27 nationalities who contribute to a dynamic multicultural work environment.

WorldFish is committed to promoting a work environment where diversity and inclusion is valued and we seek to have gender balance in the organization. We aim to also seek balance across other diversity dimensions.

People in WorldFish are treated equally irrespective of gender, ethnicity/race, national or social origin, disability, religion, political affiliation, age, family size, marital status or any other form of personal identity.

We are an equal opportunities employer and strongly encourage qualified women and men from developing nations to apply
