title: Lead Construction Inspector (Night Shift) - Federal Sector
description:
Procon is a top-ranked construction management and technology consulting firm with 25 years of experience delivering high‑impact projects across the U.S. and worldwide. An ENR Top 100 CM/PM firm for five consecutive years, we specialize in program management, project controls, commissioning, and technology—and offer an excellent platform to grow your career while shaping the future of the built environment.

Procon seeks an experienced Construction Night Inspector to provide on-site quality assurance and construction inspection services in support of Energy Savings Performance Contract (ESPC) projects in Washington D.C. The Inspector will monitor construction activities to ensure compliance with contract requirements, approved drawings and specifications, applicable codes and standards, and federal agency requirements. Responsibilities include evaluating workmanship and materials, documenting daily progress, coordinating inspections, identifying and tracking deficiencies and corrective actions, and supporting project closeout. The position will work closely with project managers, contractors, A/E firms, government representatives, and other stakeholders to maintain quality, safety, schedule compliance, and successful project delivery. This is a night-shift, on-site position requiring strong construction inspection, communication, documentation, and coordination skills.

This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship.

Requirements

Qualifications & Skills

  • Minimum of 7 years of relevant construction experience, with a bachelor’s degree in Construction, Engineering, Architecture, or a related discipline preferred.

  • At least 6 years of experience on projects of similar scope and complexity, preferably within tenant-occupied facilities.

  • Previous experience serving as a Lead Inspector.

  • Ability to work night shifts as required by the project schedule.

  • Strong knowledge of construction practices, materials, installation methods, and quality standards.

  • Extensive experience interpreting construction drawings, blueprints, specifications, and related contract documents.

  • Experience estimating construction costs and schedule impacts associated with project changes, including material take-offs, pricing, proposal reviews, bills of materials, and contract adjustment negotiations.

  • Experience inspecting construction materials, workmanship, and building systems, including fire alarm and life-safety systems.

  • Strong knowledge of OSHA requirements, construction safety protocols, and jobsite safety best practices.

  • Proven ability to lead meetings, resolve construction issues, and effectively brief clients and management teams.

  • Strong written communication and documentation skills, including professional correspondence and accurate construction site records.

  • Government or military construction project experience preferred.

Responsibilities & Duties

  • Provide overall project quality assurance by evaluating workmanship, materials, and construction activities for compliance with drawings, specifications, and contract requirements.

  • Lead and coordinate on-site inspections for government construction projects in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local requirements.

  • Serve as the primary liaison between Procon, government representatives, contractors, and design teams to facilitate communication and resolve construction issues.

  • Monitor and document daily construction progress and verify compliance with approved plans and established quality standards.

  • Inspect architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire/life-safety systems, materials, and installation methods.

  • Prepare detailed field reports, non-conformance notices, inspection records, and photographic documentation.

  • Review drawings, submittals, shop drawings, and RFIs to verify compliance with design intent and contractual requirements.

  • Evaluate contractor pay applications, change order requests, and construction schedules for accuracy, completeness, and alignment with field conditions.

  • Lead and participate in progress meetings, quality control reviews, and safety inspections.

  • Monitor contractor compliance with OSHA, health, safety, environmental, and government-specific requirements.

  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to inspection staff to maintain consistent inspection and reporting standards.

  • Support project closeout, including punch-list verification, testing, final inspections, and acceptance of completed work.

Physical Requirements

This position requires regular onsite presence in an active construction environment. The employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, including:

  • Walking and standing for extended periods while performing site observations and inspections.

  • Navigating active construction areas, including stairs, uneven surfaces, temporary walkways, and varying elevations.

  • Occasionally bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, and climbing as necessary to observe construction activities.

  • Accessing mechanical, electrical, utility, process, and other construction areas as required.

  • Wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE) and complying with all applicable site safety requirements.

  • Working in indoor and outdoor environments with exposure to typical construction-site conditions, including noise, dust, weather, and temperature fluctuations.

  • Occasionally lifting and carrying up to 25 pounds.

Benefits

Salary commensurate with experience.

Interested and qualified candidates please submit a cover letter and a resume.

Procon offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, including full medical/dental insurance and 401(K) plan. Procon is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, gender, age, color, religion, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected factor.

title: SOFTWARE SOLUTION ENGINEER
description:
Securecell is a Swiss technology company at the intersection of biotechnology, engineering, and healthcare. For more than three decades, we have been developing innovative solutions that help advance scientific discoveries and improve people's lives. Combining deep expertise in bioprocess control with a strong culture of innovation, we collaborate across disciplines to transform complex challenges into practical technologies that create real-world impact.

Continuing steadily on our sustainable innovation path and growth journey, we are looking for a
SOFTWARE SOLUTION ENGINEER
for our Information Technology Department – Software Architecture team – product R&D role

THE OPPORTUNITY
It is an opportunity to contribute to technologies that support groundbreaking scientific discoveries and help shape the future of biotechnology and healthcare.
As a member of our Software Architecture team, you will play an important role in designing, developing, verifying, and managing the lifecycle of software solutions for innovative medical and biotechnological devices. Working closely with experts from various disciplines, you will contribute to challenging projects, develop innovative solutions, and help deliver products that create value for our customers worldwide.
Whether you are improving existing technologies, driving innovation, or solving complex technical challenges, your contributions will have a direct impact on our success and future growth.
You are part of our Software Architecture Team and accountable for the design, development, verification, and lifecycle management of our Lucullus software platform. In this role, you actively contribute to software development, provide technical leadership, and oversee the software development, integration, and verification of our innovative devices. Lucullus is our process information management platform for bioprocess labs: it connects and controls lab devices and bioreactors, acquires and stores process data, and supports experiment planning and analysis.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Design and evolve the architecture of the Lucullus platform (modules, APIs, data model, device-integration layer) and document key decisions in architecture decision records and design specifications.
• Implement key components yourself (approx. 50% of time is hands-on design and coding)
• Own the non-functional requirements: performance, reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability.
• Prototype and evaluate new technologies before they are adopted in the product.
• Create, review, and maintain technical documentation, including specifications and design descriptions.
• Support requirements management, risk management, and compliance activities in accordance with applicable standards and quality requirements.
• Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams across Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, and Product Management.

WHO YOU ARE
You enjoy solving complex technical challenges and thrive in an environment where software architecture and development are critical to delivering innovative technologies. You are proactive, hands-on, and motivated to develop technologies that advance biotechnology and improve lives. You are comfortable providing technical leadership within cross-functional and agile teams. You would rather design and build than coordinate: you enjoy writing code, sketching architecture, and defending technical trade-offs with facts. Leading here means leading by technical example, not by managing people or schedules.


YOUR PROFILE
• Completed studies (FH / Uni / ETH) in Engineering, preferably Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology.
• At least 3years of experience in software development.
• Strong expertise in software development with experience in enterprise-grade applications. Hands-on approach.
• Ability to collaborate effectively, translating architectural decisions into technical solutions across teams.
• Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complexity in a large technical stack.
• Ability to mentor engineers and drive technical decisions through design reviews, code reviews.
• Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD tools, and automation frameworks.
• Proficiency in Linux environments, particularly with LTS distributions and Oracle Linux (preferred but open to alternatives).
• Industry experience in Medtech/Biotech and in (bio)process technology is not a prerequisite; however, there must be a strong interest and awareness that the environment is regulated.
• Experience working with enterprise databases, particularly Oracle DB and PostgreSQL.
• Solid understanding of security best practices, compliance, and secure coding methodologies.
• A valid work permit is required, and only direct applications will be taken into consideration (no agencies)

WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL
• Experience in biotechnology, bioprocessing, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, diagnostics, or life sciences (nice to have)
• Proven track record of designing and personally implementing software systems end-to-end
• Passion for innovation and technology
• Ability to navigate ambiguity and identify practical solutions
• Strong sense of ownership and accountability
• Curiosity and a continuous learning mindset
• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trusted relationships across disciplines
• Experience working in multidisciplinary and international environments

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT SECURECELL

title: Software Engineer II - Athlete Performance
description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're hiring an Engineer II to join one of our cross-functional product teams in our Athlete Performance group, which is focused on building cutting-edge solutions for athletes and sports teams that directly impact how they train, compete and achieve peak performance.

In this role, you’ll focus on building high-performance mobile applications and core data services across iOS and Android. You will help build and maintain hardware-agnostic communication interfaces to stream live sensor and optical tracking data to the cloud and mobile clients. You'll work on translating complex physical and biomechanical data into clear, digestible metrics that support real-time decision-making for elite coaches, athletes, and medical teams.

In this position, you'll:

  • Work with a cross-functional team. You'll collaborate with Engineering, Quality Assurance, Product, Design and Scrum disciplines to deliver feature-rich mobile and the back-end services that power them.
  • Develop and deliver. You’ll take ownership of specific features, defining low-latency communication interfaces across the stack and building user-facing application features that turn complex sensor data into clear, actionable insights.
  • Test new ideas. At Hudl, we iterate rapidly, deploying changes to the product hundreds of times daily across our Engineering team. You'll write high-quality code, conduct code reviews, and help solve well-defined technical problems using modern mobile and cloud development best practices.
  • Grow your skills. You'll collaborate with senior engineers and tech leads to refine your technical architecture skills, learning to navigate trade-offs in system performance, real-time data streaming, and application responsiveness.

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

  • Mobile experience. Hands-on experience developing native or cross-platform mobile applications, ideally with React Native (iOS and Android).
  • Systems mindset. You have experience working with different API styles, communication patterns for streaming data across mobile clients and back-end systems.
  • A team player. You understand that problem-solving is a team effort and enjoy collaborating with peers to learn, share knowledge, and build great software together.
  • User-focused. You're excited to build intuitive interfaces that translate complex physical or optical sensor data into digestible information for real-world users.
  • Willingness to learn. You have solid core engineering skills and are excited to dive into mobile frameworks, time-series data streams, or cloud architecture as needed

Nice-to-Haves

  • Backend & Cloud Architecture knowledge: Hands-on experience with modern cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), microservice architectures, time-series databases, and CI/CD deployment pipelines.
  • Domain & Data Streaming experience: Background working with real-time video, wearable devices, or streaming optical/sensor data, ideally within sports technology or performance analytics.
  • Mobile CI/CD.Experience with mobile build and release pipelines (GitHub Actions), distribution platforms (TestFlight, Firebase App Distribution), and testing frameworks such as Jest and Detox.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
  • Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Base Salary Range
£51,000—£86,000 GBP

Inclusion at Hudl

Hudl is an equal opportunity employer. Through our actions, behaviors and attitude, we’ll create an environment where everyone, no matter their differences, feels like they belong.

We offer resources to ensure our employees feel safe bringing their authentic selves to work, including employee resource groups and communities. But we recognize there’s ongoing work to be done, which is why we track our efforts and commitments in annual inclusion reports.

We also know imposter syndrome is real and the confidence gap can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply—we’d love to hear from you.

title: Control Systems Engineer
description:
NEW JOB VACANCY IN SHROPSHIRE - CONTROL SYSTEMS ENGINEER

Are you an experienced Control Systems Engineer, Applications Engineer, Software Engineer, Systems Engineer, V&V Engineer or Senior Control Systems Engineer seeking a new job opportunity, and are you looking for a role within Shropshire (or are you open to relocating to Shropshire)?!

We are seeking a Control Systems Engineer to join a leading Agri-Tech business in Shropshire, this is working a fixed day shift pattern (37 hours per week) and the annual salary is up to £65,000 per annum (DOE), the hiring manager is looking for someone who will be based in the office 5 days per week, there is an opportunity to work from home 1 day per week every 2 weeks, and a relocation package can be offered for someone who lives more than 2 hours away from Shropshire and is prepared to move to the area.

PLEASE BE ADVISED THAT SPONSORSHIP IS NOT AVAILABLE, SO PLEASE DON'T APPLY IF YOU REQUIRE SPONSORSHIP NOW, OR AFTER POST STUDY.

This role would suit a practical person who is excited by making their designs reality, and suitable for a candidate that wants to make a difference, and be part of an exciting journey into advanced engineering relating to the agricultural sector. The primary focus of the role will be relating to the electronic control systems and architecture development of a 50-75hp electric and hybrid tractor.

What You Will Do:

  • Translate system requirements into control functions and clear software requirements for a Control Systems Engineer role.
  • Develop reusable, maintainable software functions, and analyse system behaviour to optimise control performance, particularly for power management in a hybrid/powertrain setup.
  • Contribute to vehicle-level functional architecture by allocating control functions, and help define system states, modes, diagnostics and failure responses.
  • Support HIL/SIL rig development, then lead debugging, commissioning and regression testing of the control system on prototype tractors.
  • Build test cases and validation criteria for control functions, ensuring robust evidence for performance and reliability.
  • Help manage vehicle fleet software versions, supporting smooth NPI activity and higher engineering standards within the control-systems development process.

What You Will Bring:

  • A minimum of 3 - 5 years experience within a similar role - ESSENTIAL
  • Previous experience with using Matlab and/or Simulink - ESSENTIAL
  • Previous Control systems development experience with one of the following - diesel engine, HV Inverters, Transmission and shifting, Cab, HVAC, HMI or Hydraulic valves - ESSENTIAL
  • Experience of Control Systems development for mobility applications or wheel based vehicles - ESSENTIAL
  • Confident software development from requirements through to physical validation, including practical experience using tools such as CANalyser, DBC Editor, CANape, and Matlab/Simulink.
  • Strong understanding of CAN and communication protocols, ideally CAN/J1939, alongside solid control theory and practical implementation experience.

This Control Systems Engineer position supports a skilled engineering team working on advanced agricultural technology for the UK and European markets. By delivering reliable control strategies, improving vehicle diagnostics and strengthening development processes, the role directly contributes to engineering excellence, safety-focused thinking and continuous improvement.

Location:

The Control Systems Engineer role is based in Shropshire, in a newly built engineering environment.

The hiring manager is looking for someone who will be based in the office 5 days per week, there is an opportunity to work from home 1 day per week every 2 weeks

Interested?:

If you want to progress with real vehicle impact and meaningful engineering responsibility, apply now for this Control Systems Engineer opportunity and take the next step in advanced agricultural technology.

title: CMDB - ITIL Analyst
description:

The CMDB & HAM Analyst is responsible for supporting the execution and operational maturity of the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) and Hardware Asset Management (HAM) processes within a global ITSM environment.   • Work with ServiceNow teams to support discovery, automation, and reporting enhancements.

  • Assist in maintaining documentation, standards, and process artifacts.

  • Able to enforce governing policies and / or escalate when necessary.

  • Able to manage and organize audits and audit requirements.

  • 6+ years of experience with CMDB & HAM processes in an enterprise ITIL-based or equivalent IT Service Management processes

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience with ServiceNow in an enterprise environment.

  • ITIL v3 or ITIL 4 certification required.

Preferred Qualifications & Skills

  • Exposure to asset discovery tools and automated reconciliation.

description:

£550 per day | Inside IR35 | Occasional travel to Swindon | Currently scheduled to end 31 March 2027

We're looking for a Data Modeller to help a large organisation build consistent,trusted data for reporting and analysis.

This is a hands-on dimensional modelling role. What you'll do

- Work with data architects,engineers and governance specialists to support consistent reporting and trusted datasets.

title: MEP Project Manager
description:
MEP Project Manager

Office Location: 601 First Street NW, Grand Rapids, MI 49504

Position Classification: Full-Time Regular

About this Opportunity

At Rockford, our success is driven by people who can bring complex projects to life through collaboration, innovation, and execution. As an MEP Project Manager, you will lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Fire Protection (MEP/FP) systems throughout the entire project lifecycle. From preconstruction and design through commissioning and turnover, you will partner with project teams, trade partners, designers, owners, and vendors to ensure critical building systems are delivered safely, efficiently, and to the highest standards. This role offers the opportunity to make a lasting impact on diverse and meaningful projects while working alongside a team committed to excellence, continuous improvement, and building communities that thrive.

Key Responsibilities

KEY DELIVERABLES

  • Foster an environment of diversity, equity, and inclusion.
  • Understand project workflows (schematic design, design development, construction documentation phases) and project management.
  • Experience with Design/Build, Design/Assist, and Plan/Spec project management process and methods.
  • Knowledge and understanding of various commercial mechanical/electrical/plumbing/fire suppression systems and types.
  • Ability to read and understand project plans and specifications at all levels of design.
  • Develop MEP/FP Bid Packages, create MEP/FP bid scopes, and provide MEP/FP Budget review and Value analysis.
  • Create and maintain library of historical of MEP/FP cost data, unit costs, and benchmarking information.
  • Partner with MEP/FP design team and drive timely resolution of design issues, decisions, and action items.
  • Leverage BIM/VDC processes and technology to support constructability, clash detection, prefabrication, installation planning, and stakeholder communication
  • Manage MEP/FP scope and cost changes, including change order requests, pricing review, and impact assessment.
  • Support MEP/FP equipment procurement, including long-lead identification, submittal status, release requirements, and delivery tracking.
  • Develop and maintain MEP/FP milestone schedules in coordination with the overall project schedule; identify risks and recovery actions early.
  • Coordinate MEP/FP permits, RFIs, submittals, and other project documentation required for timely execution.
  • Partner with Superintendents and project field leadership to support installation sequencing, site logistics, access, and trade coordination. Provide on-site MEP management support as required.
  • Lead or support MEP/FP commissioning, training, punch list, as-built documentation, and turnover activities.
  • Manage communication among MEP/FP trades and interface with the Owner, Architect, Engineers, subcontractors, suppliers, and vendors as needed.
  • Communicate technical, cost, schedule, and coordination issues clearly to a variety of audiences and facilitate timely decisions.
  • Promote collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and an inclusive team environment.
  • Support the development of MEP/VDC best practices, lessons learned, standards, and knowledge sharing across projects.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required in Construction / Engineering related program.
  • Mechanical engineering degree or Electrical engineering degree is preferred.
  • 7+ years’ experience in the construction industry. 5+ years’ experience in MEP coordination/management.
  • Working knowledge of BIM/VDC processes and their application to MEP coordination is preferred.
  • Strongly prefer a minimum of combination experience, including coordination, project engineering, virtual design, and construction experience.
  • Must possess the ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks at once.
  • Ability to communicate and present design and/or construction ideas to a variety of audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to work under pressure, to manage deadlines and prioritize assignments.
  • Motivated to advance the firm and advance your professional growth.
  • A passion for looking for ways to improve individual and/or company performance.
  • Must have working knowledge of MS Office, including strong skills in Excel, Word, and Outlook.

Benefits

At Rockford, we believe that investing in our people is essential to our success. We offer a competitive compensation package along with a 401(k) plan featuring a company match to help you plan for the future. Our team members have access to comprehensive healthcare coverage, generous paid time off, and flexible work schedules that support work-life balance. We encourage continued growth through tuition reimbursement and professional development opportunities, and we promote well-being through on-site health and wellness programs. Rockford also provides industry-leading technology to empower our teams and offers meaningful ways to give back through volunteer time off and partnerships with local organizations. Joining Rockford means more than just a job. It’s an opportunity to shape your career while helping to build stronger communities.

Who We Are

For nearly 40 years, Rockford has been a trusted partner to thousands of clients across the U.S. With construction management, real estate development and property management services all under one roof, we view space from every angle. We think like owners, build with precision and operate to achieve long-term value—always committed to craftsmanship, quality and service.

Our talented team brings expertise and innovation to commercial, educational, industrial, health + well-being, hospitality, multi-unit and retail markets. From complex, large-scale construction, to smaller renovations, we tailor our services and approach to meet the unique needs of our clients and the communities they serve.

Recognized by Engineering News-Record as one of the Top 200 Contractors in the nation and consistently honored as one of the 101 Best and Brightest Companies to Work For, Rockford delivers more than buildings. We deliver results that last. We’re deeply invested in our people, our communities and the continued success of every project we touch—driven by a clear purpose: to Build a Better World.

Environmental Factors and Working Conditions

The work environment for this position is a typical office environment with occasional construction site visits. When in the office, the physical demands require the ability to sit for long periods of time. Intermittent movement, such as accessing centrally located office equipment, lifting of 35 lbs, bending, stooping, kneeling, and climbing, may be necessary to perform the requirements of this position. Site visits may subject the individual to hazards commonly associated with construction. Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) to be worn as required on project sites and in the warehouse.

Rockford is an equal opportunity employer that supports and subscribes to a policy of nondiscrimination in all aspects of employment. Rockford will not discriminate based on religion, race, color, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy and related conditions, gender identity, and sexual orientation), height, weight, marital status, military service, partisan consideration, disability, genetic information, or any other reason prohibited by applicable federal and state laws.

title: Experienced Data Engineer
description:

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with modern data platforms, including Apache Spark and Databricks, and is passionate about transforming complex enterprise data into high-quality, reliable, connected and accessible information assets. This opportunity is with Naya, an EPAM company, a leading global provider of data platforms and development professional services.

Based in Israel, Naya is one of the fastest-growing companies in the data and development technology space, and we’re growing our team.

title: Recovery Coordinator
description:
Overview

Change Grow Live is a charity dedicated to the belief that we can make a difference to our Service Users lives, offering support and respect in a safe environment, treating each user as an individual and working with them to find the right treatment and care options.

Our core values are ‘Be open, be compassionate and be bold’ and our team members apply these daily to achieve our mission of helping people change the direction of their lives, grow as individuals, and live life to its full potential.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Recovery Coordinator who has the skills and experience to assess and engage with our service users, ensuring that they access the right intervention at the right time, in a way that best meets their needs.

No two days are the same and we treat every person who comes into our service as an individual, so being flexible, curious and a good listener are key.

The successful candidate will be based in Nelson and will be expected to work across various locations to meet the needs of the service.

Where: Nelson, Lancashire

Full Time Hours: 37.5 hours per week

Contract Type: Permanent

Full-time hours at Change Grow Live are 37.5 hours per week. For part-time roles, the salary and payments will be pro rata based on contracted hours.

Responsibilities

With this role you’ll be working as part of our Pendle team, based in Nelson, Lancashire.

The team supports people with their or their loved ones’ drug and/or alcohol issues.

About the role:

  • Supporting service users from point of entry into the service and through their treatment/recovery journey
  • Providing screening, assessment, and recovery planning and onward referral
  • Reducing drug and alcohol related harm to service users and the wider community
  • Promoting carer, service user and community involvement
  • Providing advocacy for access to partnership services
  • Working with service users to support social (re)integration, enabling them to lead meaningful and purposeful lives: promoting recovery, resilience, peer support and self-determination
  • Research, design and prepare subject matter and materials for groups / pods.
  • Deliver structured content within group settings to service users at various stages of recovery
  • Engage with debriefing and evaluations with co-facilitators after groups/pods have taken place, reviewing progress and identifying concerns with service users
  • Tailor specific workshops around the needs of the service users, such as: anger management, sleep disorders, relationships, etc

About you:

  • Have a strong understanding of substance misuse issues and experience of working within a similar field
  • Experience of working with groups/pods and managing group dynamics, such as conflict or challenging behaviour.
  • Be an excellent communicator, both verbal and written with good IT skills
  • Proactive and able to work on own initiative with excellent time management and prioritising skills
  • Have a good working knowledge of mental health interventions, services, and good practice
  • Be a supportive team player with strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work in partnership with a wide range of professionals, agencies, and internal/external stakeholders
  • Ability to manage change successfully in a way that prioritises the needs of service users
  • Understand the importance of information governance processes and commit to follow and apply all necessary safeguards
  • Seek out learning opportunities to improve and broaden your professional knowledge and skills and to contribute and oversee the learning and development of others

What we will give to you:

  • 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. Additionally, you'll receive one extra day of annual leave for each year of service during your first five years, therefore you will enjoy 30 days of leave after five years with us.
  • Paid ‘Wellness’ hour each week along with a ‘Wellness’ hub and Employee Assist Programme
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Several benefits incl. discounts for shopping, cinema, holidays, etc.
  • A friendly and supportive team
  • Training, career development & progression opportunities
  • Generous Refer-a-Friend Scheme

Please ensure that when completing your application form and supporting statement, you reflect on the details outlined in the job description. This will help us understand how your skills and experiences align with the requirements of the role.

A note about using AI in your application

AI can be a really helpful tool when putting together your application, and we're happy for you to use it. However, what we're most interested in is you.

We want to understand your experiences, achievements and strengths, so please make sure your application reflects your own story and clearly shows how you meet the essential criteria and the impact you've made in previous roles.

There's no need to write in a particular style. The strongest applications are those that are authentic, specific and clearly demonstrate your skills, experience and potential. We look forward to learning more about you.

Direct applications only — we will not be engaging agencies for this vacancy.

Please note: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK at the time of application. For applicants with time-limited visas, unfortunately, we are unable to support new visa applications or extensions.

We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if we receive a high number of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: 2D/3D Plant Layout Engineer - Energy from Waste - Chennai
description:
About the Role

Your primary role will be to support our global operations in preparation of layout in Feasibility study and project phase, including but not limited to:

  • Preparation and updating of 2D and 3D layouts of WtE, Carbon Capture, Biogas and industrial plants using Bentley MicroStation and AutoCAD.
  • Development of plot plans, equipment layouts, building layouts, sections and general arrangement drawings.
  • Support preparation and maintenance of integrated plant models for multidisciplinary coordination.
  • Incorporate review comments from project engineers and global teams into layout models and drawings.
  • Assist in model coordination, clash identification and space management activities.
  • Support preparation and updating of PFDs, P&IDs and associated engineering drawings.
  • Coordinate with process, mechanical, piping, civil, electrical and C&I disciplines for layout development.
  • Participate in layout review meetings and workshops and support closure of review comments.
  • Support document control and drawing register management activities for active projects.
  • Site visits, if required, and collection of site information required for layout development.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Bentley MicroStation, AutoCAD and other relevant engineering software and industry best practices.

The right person for this job will

  • Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.
  • 3-10 years of experience in plant layout engineering, drafting or 3D modelling activities.
  • Good English communication skills for effective collaboration with team members and stakeholders.
  • Experience in AutCAD and/or Bentley MicroStation is must
  • 3D modeling experience in Auto plant and/or Revit 3D is preferred.
  • Exposure to industrial plants, WtE, Thermal Power, Biogas, Energy or Process Industry projects is desirable.
  • Basic understanding of engineering drawings, layouts and modelling principles.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical documents.
  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn multidisciplinary plant design.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Als Scrum Master binnen Data Insurance combineer je agile coaching met peoplemanagement. Je helpt je team om vlotter samen te werken, verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen en continu te verbeteren. Tegelijk ben je de hiërarchisch leidinggevende van je team en zorg je voor duidelijke richting, ontwikkeling en betrokkenheid.
Je werkt in een complexe omgeving op het kruispunt van business, data en IT. De teams binnen Data Insurance ontwikkelen en beheren datagedreven toepassingen voor onder meer rapportering, analyse en besluitvorming. Daarbij moeten snelheid en innovatie voortdurend in balans zijn met vereisten rond governance, security, risico en regelgeving.
Als Scrum Master creëer je de structuur en dynamiek die het team nodig heeft om binnen die context goed te presteren. Je coacht medewerkers en stakeholders, maakt obstakels bespreekbaar en helpt het team evolueren naar meer zelforganisatie en ownership.


Jobomschrijving

  • Je geeft leiding aan je team en coacht je medewerkers in hun persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Je creëert een omgeving waarin mensen verantwoordelijkheid opnemen, samenwerken en blijven verbeteren.
  • Je faciliteert Scrum-events zoals sprintplanning, teamafstemmingen, sprintreviews en retrospectives en zorgt ervoor dat ze bijdragen aan een betere werking van het team.
  • Samen met de Product Owner werk je aan een heldere en haalbare backlog. Je bewaakt daarbij de teamdynamiek, faciliteert de samenwerking en helpt prioriteiten scherp te stellen.
  • Je detecteert obstakels die de voortgang van het team belemmeren en helpt om organisatorische, procesmatige of governancegerelateerde blokkades weg te nemen.
  • Je helpt het team om agile-principes toe te passen binnen de volledige levenscyclus van oplossingen, van intake en ontwikkeling tot risicobeheersing, implementatie en beheer.
  • Je stimuleert de principes van Agile en SAFe en neemt daarin zelf een voorbeeldrol op.
  • Je zorgt voor transparantie en een goede samenwerking tussen business, data en IT.
  • Je daagt je team en stakeholders constructief uit en helpt hen om kritisch naar werkwijzen, keuzes en prioriteiten te kijken.

  • Je hebt een bachelor- of masterdiploma en relevante ervaring als Scrum Master, Agile Coach of in een vergelijkbare rol.
  • Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen en coachen van mensen en weet hoe je ook in een uitdagende teamcontext duidelijkheid, vertrouwen en verantwoordelijkheid creëert.
  • Je kent Agile en Scrum grondig en bent vertrouwd met de principes van SAFe.
  • Je voelt je thuis in een complexe en gereguleerde omgeving waarin wendbaarheid moet samengaan met governance, risico en compliance.
  • Je bent een sterke facilitator en communicator. Je luistert, brengt verschillende standpunten samen en durft mensen op een constructieve manier uit te dagen.
  • Je kan complexe situaties analyseren, opties kritisch tegen elkaar afwegen en tot duidelijke keuzes komen.
  • Je beschikt over voldoende technische en IT-affiniteit om de context van je team te doorgronden en inhoudelijk mee te denken.
  • Je voelt je thuis in een data-, analytics- of IT-gedreven omgeving. Ervaring met softwareontwikkeling, risicobeheer of compliancegerichte frameworks is een plus.
  • Je communiceert vlot en helder in het Nederlands en Engels.

title: Facility Construction Engineer - Federal Sector
location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
Procon is a top-ranked construction management and technology consulting firm with 25 years of experience delivering high‑impact projects across the U.S. and worldwide. An ENR Top 100 CM/PM firm for five consecutive years, we specialize in program management, project controls, commissioning, and technology—and offer an excellent platform to grow your career while shaping the future of the built environment.

Procon seeks an experienced Facility Construction Engineer to provide design, construction, and facility management support for a federal facility in Washington, DC. The position will support facility renovations, space reconfiguration, operations and maintenance oversight, space planning, move services, procurement, occupancy support, lease administration, and management of an automated Integrated Workplace Management System (IWMS). The Facility Construction Engineer will also provide project coordination, cost estimating, budgeting, scheduling, and construction and building management support while collaborating with architecture, engineering, construction, and government stakeholder teams. The ideal candidate will have experience supporting complex federal facility projects throughout the design and construction lifecycle. This position reports directly to Procon’s Facility Program Manager and works closely with the client on a day-to-day basis.

This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship.

Requirements

Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.

  • Minimum of 10 years of project or facility management experience.

  • Professional certification or affiliation with AIA, ASID, PMP, or CMAA/CCM.

  • Experience managing construction projects within occupied Federal Government facilities.

  • Experience managing complex new construction, major renovations, and multiple concurrent construction or facility projects.

  • Strong knowledge of construction methods, scheduling, cost estimating, budgeting, and project controls.

  • Experience coordinating with Federal Government agencies, GSA, A/E firms, contractors, construction trades, and building suppliers.

  • Proficiency with MS Project and/or Primavera P6.

  • Ability to electronically review and print AutoCAD documents.

  • Experience supporting commercial projects involving systems furniture.

  • Professional-level proficiency in written and spoken English.

  • Proficiency in implementing Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools preferred.

  • Must successfully pass a Federal Government suitability background investigation and obtain an HSPD-12 clearance for access to the client facility and network.

Responsibilities & Duties

  • Manage interior workplace environments to support employee productivity, health, welfare, and workplace safety.

  • Oversee construction and renovation projects, including simultaneous facility improvement initiatives.

  • Direct facility construction activities and lead construction progress meetings.

  • Support development of government cost estimates, budget tracking, scheduling, and project financial controls.

  • Coordinate project activities with government agencies, design professionals, contractors, suppliers, and construction trades.

  • Provide building management services, including space management, facilities and equipment maintenance, energy conservation, and systems furniture planning and installation.

  • Plan, coordinate, and provide advisory support for facility and building support service functions.

  • Monitor workloads and adjust resources and priorities to promote timely and cost-effective delivery of services.

  • Ensure contract performance complies with applicable OSHA requirements and established quality control standards.

Physical Requirements

This position requires regular onsite presence in an active construction environment. The employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, including:

  • Walking and standing for extended periods while performing site observations and inspections.

  • Navigating active construction areas, including stairs, uneven surfaces, temporary walkways, and varying elevations.

  • Occasionally bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, and climbing as necessary to observe construction activities.

  • Accessing mechanical, electrical, utility, process, and other construction areas as required.

  • Wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE) and complying with all applicable site safety requirements.

  • Working in indoor and outdoor environments with exposure to typical construction-site conditions, including noise, dust, weather, and temperature fluctuations.

  • Occasionally lifting and carrying up to 25 pounds.

Benefits

Salary commensurate with experience.

Interested and qualified candidates please submit a cover letter and a resume.

Procon offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, including full medical/dental insurance and 401(K) plan. Procon is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, gender, age, color, religion, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected factor.

title: Site Logistics Supervisor

title: Senior UX Designer
description:
About the Company

At Rezilient, we're redefining what primary care looks like, making it more accessible, seamless, and patient-centered than ever before. Through our innovative CloudClinic model, we combine virtual provider visits with smart, tech-enabled infrastructure to deliver timely, personalized care. By removing traditional barriers to access and continuously expanding our specialty offerings, we're building a healthcare experience that's as convenient as it is comprehensive. We are a Series B company, which means the work is real, the pace is fast, and the design decisions you make now become the patterns we scale on.

About the Role

Rezilient is seeking a Senior UX Designer to help build a member app people love coming back to. As we extend care beyond the clinic, you'll shape how members understand their health, connect with their care team, and take useful next steps between visits.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role spanning research, interaction and visual design, prototyping, and iteration after launch. Your initial focus will be the member-facing mobile experience. You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Clinical Operations, and Growth to create a coherent experience across the app and the care it connects members to. Care-team workflow improvements will be prioritized alongside member-facing work, rather than treated as a separate, unlimited mandate.

AI will be an important part of what you design, but not the answer to every problem. You'll help determine when AI makes an interaction more useful and when a simpler approach is better. Where AI is involved, you'll design for transparency, user control, appropriate human review, and recovery when something goes wrong.

Our ideal candidate brings deep consumer mobile experience, strong interaction and visual design skills, and a record of improving products after launch. You care about the details of the shipped experience, learn directly from users, and can explain how your work helped people accomplish something that matters to them.

What You'll Design

  • The member mobile experience: Onboarding, access to care, navigation, communication, and between-visit engagement that feel coherent, useful, and easy to return to.
  • Health and wearable data experiences: Clear ways for members to connect devices, understand relevant health information, and identify useful next steps without being overwhelmed by data.
  • Member-facing AI experiences: Assistance with intake, care navigation, education, and follow-up, with clear boundaries and a straightforward handoff to a person when needed.
  • Connections to the care team: Member-to-care-team handoffs and supporting workflows that keep the digital experience connected to how care is delivered.
  • Efficient clinical workflows: Intuitive experiences for medics, providers, and care navigators across visit preparation, encounters, documentation, orders, and referrals, designed to reduce repetitive work and context switching so care teams can focus on members.
  • Care-team coordination: Clear task queues, messaging, and handoffs that make ownership, priority, and next steps visible across virtual and CloudClinic care, helping teams move work forward without losing clinical context.
  • Innovative AI-assisted care delivery: New ways to summarize relevant information, draft documentation, and support follow-up, designed and tested with care teams, with appropriate clinician review, easy correction, and clear accountability.
  • Trust, control, and recovery: Consent and permission flows, review and correction, understandable explanations, and recovery when information is incomplete or a system is wrong, slow, or unavailable.
  • Reusable mobile patterns: Accessible components and interaction patterns, including loading, empty, error, and success states, that maintain a consistent quality bar as the product grows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end member experience design: Take priority journeys from discovery and workflow mapping through prototypes, production-ready designs, implementation review, and post-launch iteration.
  • Partner in product discovery: Work closely with the Product Manager and mobile engineering lead to define problems, explore alternatives, and make informed tradeoffs before committing to a solution.
  • Deliver a high standard of craft: Create polished interaction and visual designs with clear information hierarchy, thoughtful content, and platform-appropriate mobile patterns. Partner with Engineering through design QA so the shipped experience meets the intended quality bar.
  • Learn directly from users: Run practical interviews, concept tests, and usability sessions with members and, where relevant, medics, providers, and care navigators. Combine those findings with product data to challenge assumptions and guide iteration.
  • Accelerate product and design cycles with AI: Rethink traditional research, synthesis, prototyping, and validation workflows using AI to test more ideas, reach evidence-backed decisions faster, and shorten the path from problem to shipped experience. Demonstrate measurable improvements in cycle time while preserving research integrity, privacy, and design quality.
  • Build realistic prototypes: Use Figma and approved prototyping tools to test interactions before implementation. For AI-powered flows, explore representative model outputs and failure cases rather than relying only on idealized mockups.
  • Develop reusable design foundations: Define and document components, patterns, and guidance with Engineering so quality and consistency scale beyond individual features.
  • Connect design to member outcomes: Partner with Product and Engineering to evaluate onboarding success, task completion, comprehension, satisfaction, and meaningful repeat engagement. Use AI acceptance, correction, and override behavior as additional diagnostic signals, not substitutes for a useful member experience.
  • Design responsibly: Work with Clinical Operations, Quality, and Compliance to translate agreed safety expectations into clear review, consent, escalation, and recovery flows. Use approved tools and appropriately protected or synthetic data for research and prototyping.
  • Support focused delivery: Participate in planning, backlog refinement, and delivery rituals, keeping design work well-scoped and aligned with product priorities. Establish practical design review and learning habits without adding unnecessary process.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Senior-level design experience: 5+ years in UX, product design, or interaction design in a high-growth, technology-enabled environment, with a record of taking work from an unclear problem through launch and iteration.
  • Deep consumer mobile experience: Experience designing and shipping a consumer health, wellness, or fitness app used by a substantial active user base. You can explain the audience, scale, your contribution, and what changed as the product grew.
  • Strong interaction and visual design: A portfolio showing excellent craft and shipped mobile experiences, with a clear account of the problem, research, tradeoffs, and results. Anonymized examples and directional results are welcome when work is confidential.
  • Research and evaluation skills: Experience learning directly from users and combining qualitative findings with product data to make and test design decisions.
  • Mobile and accessibility fundamentals: Familiarity with iOS and Android interaction patterns and the ability to design for people with different abilities, levels of health literacy, and comfort with technology.
  • Prototyping and systems skills: Strong proficiency in Figma, including component-based design, interactive prototyping, design systems, and clear communication of behavior and intent to engineers.
  • Sound AI design judgment: An understanding of uncertainty, disclosure, review and correction, permissions, and human handoff. You can reason about failure cases and avoid creating unwarranted trust in an automated response.
  • Thoughtful use of AI tools: Fluency with AI-enabled design, research, and productivity tools, and the judgment to know where they help and where direct human research and review remain necessary.
  • Cross-functional ownership: Proven ability to partner closely with Product and Engineering on a small team where priorities evolve and designers are expected to remain hands-on.
  • Systems thinking and communication: The ability to simplify complex journeys, explain design rationale, facilitate tradeoff discussions, and incorporate clinical, technical, and business feedback without losing sight of member needs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Shipped AI-powered features: Experience bringing AI interactions to real users, including evaluating quality, handling errors, and learning after release.
  • High-trust products: Experience in care delivery or another regulated environment where privacy, clarity, and safety influence design decisions.
  • Sustained engagement: Experience helping people build useful habits or follow through on health goals without relying on unnecessary notifications or manipulative patterns.
  • Connected health experiences: Work with wearable or device data, personalized health information, or experiences spanning an app and a human care team.
  • Clinical workflow familiarity: Experience with documentation, referrals, care-team tasks, or patient-provider messaging, and familiarity with clinical data standards such as FHIR or HL7.
  • Early-stage design practice: Experience establishing practical design foundations and research habits on a small team while continuing to deliver hands-on product work.

Benefits

At Rezilient Health, we're on a mission to make humane healthcare truly abundant, and we invest in the people who make that possible. This is a high-impact role where your ideas directly shape how care is delivered, within a supportive, collaborative, and diverse team that believes healthcare is fundamentally a human experience.   • Competitive base compensation

description:
Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW), New Delhi

Programme Associate GeoAnalytics- Tech and AI

Terms of reference


At CEEW, we are deliberate about what we stand for (and what we don’t stand for!) as an employer. If the description below resonates with you, we would love to hear from you!

At CEEW, we build careers in public policy

· We offer strong visionary leadership – with emphasis on research and impact at scale

· We actively promote leadership by initiative

· We celebrate talent and ambition

· You will be surrounded by smart people who will challenge you and help you grow

· You will learn faster than your peers in other organisations

· Curiosity and irreverence, as well as responsibility, come together at CEEW

· You will get above-market remuneration

· We provide a safe space for all

· At CEEW, your life is your example for others


Designation offered

Programme Associate GeoAnalytics

Focus area

Technology & AI


Location

New Delhi, India


Duration:

Full- Time


Purpose
 CEEW seeks to hire a Programme Associate – GeoAnalytics to lead applied geospatial research and develop analytical tools that support climate resilience, clean air and sustainable urban development. Working within the Tech and AI team and across CEEW’s research programmes, the candidate will combine satellite observations, ground measurements and socioeconomic data to address policy and planning questions at national, state, city and neighbourhood scales.

The role will contribute to climate-intelligence platforms such as CRAVIS and the Climate Risk Atlas, and to mobility initiatives such as BBUS. It will involve developing reproducible geospatial workflows, applying and validating machine-learning models, and translating results into maps, research outputs and decision-support tools for government and other users.

Job duties and accountabilities

Roles & Responsibilities
Geospatial research

· Lead applied geospatial research using GIS, remote sensing and GeoAI, from framing research questions and selecting methods to validation, interpretation and documentation.

· Develop scalable workflows in Google Earth Engine and Python to process satellite imagery, climate records, terrain data, infrastructure, population and field observations across geographic scales.

· Undertake spatial assessments of urban heat, air quality, floods, landslides and environmental exposure, integrating satellite, sensor and ground observations with population and infrastructure data.

· Apply network analysis, urban morphology, accessibility assessment and multi-criteria methods to sustainable mobility and urban planning, including demand estimation and the identification of potential bus corridors and service gaps.

· Develop and evaluate statistical and machine-learning models for classification, prediction and prioritisation. Assess data quality, spatial and temporal leakage, uncertainty and transferability through independent validation.

· Evaluate emerging geospatial datasets and analytical methods for accuracy, coverage, resolution and suitability for Indian policy applications. Document limitations and communicate findings in terms relevant to planning and policy.

Data products and programme delivery

· Develop and maintain documented datasets, indicators and processing pipelines for CRAVIS, the Climate Risk Atlas and other analytical products, ensuring consistency across locations, time periods and updates.

· Work with software and product colleagues to translate research methods into dashboards, interactive maps, scenario tools and analytical modules. Define data structures and acceptance criteria, and verify displayed results against source analyses.

· Maintain data dictionaries, standard operating procedures and reproducible outputs. Apply appropriate data licensing, access controls and privacy safeguards.

· Plan and deliver assigned workstreams, coordinate inputs across teams and partners, and identify data or implementation constraints early. Review outputs and maintain clear documentation for continuity and handover.

· Prepare research reports, policy briefs, technical notes, presentations and visualisations. Contribute to proposals and concept notes, including methods, data requirements, timelines and resource estimates.

Stakeholder engagement and capacity building

· Engage with government departments, urban local bodies, research institutions, technology providers and development partners to understand analytical needs, obtain data and validate research findings.

· Contribute to technical partnerships and assess proposed datasets, platforms and vendor deliverables against programme requirements.

· Conduct stakeholder consultations, platform demonstrations and training on GIS, remote sensing and geospatial tools. Gather feedback and support the adoption of analytical outputs in planning and decision-making.

· Build internal capacity through practical training, standard operating procedures and technical guidance for colleagues and interns. Represent CEEW in relevant technical and policy forums.

Support to research teams for geospatial datasets and analytics

· Work with research teams across CEEW to translate programme questions into clearly defined geospatial data requirements, analytical tasks and outputs, agreeing on scope, methods and delivery timelines.

· Identify, acquire, clean and harmonise suitable geospatial datasets from open sources, government agencies, research partners and other providers. Assess spatial coverage, resolution, completeness and fitness for the intended use.

· Provide tailored spatial analyses, including overlays, buffers, zonal statistics, hotspot mapping, change detection, network analysis and exposure assessment, to support research across climate resilience, clean air, mobility, water, agriculture and energy.

· Prepare analysis-ready datasets, maps, indicators and visualisations at the geographic scale required by each study. Support teams in interpreting results and incorporating them accurately into reports, policy briefs and presentations.

· Maintain a shared catalogue of reusable datasets and analytical workflows with source information, metadata, update schedules and usage limitations to reduce duplication across projects.

· Review geospatial methods and outputs developed by research teams or external partners, troubleshoot analytical issues, and advise on data gaps, validation needs and appropriate interpretation of findings.

Selection Criteria

Qualification and experience

· A master’s degree in geoinformatics, geomatics, remote sensing and GIS, geography, environmental science, urban or transport planning, engineering, data science, or a related discipline, with substantial applied geospatial work. A relevant PhD is desirable.

· A minimum of four years of relevant experience in geospatial analytics, remote sensing or applied spatial research, with evidence of independently delivering analytical workstreams and usable outputs.

· Demonstrated application of geospatial methods to one or more of climate risk, environmental monitoring, air quality, sustainable mobility, urban planning, agriculture or water. The ability to work across disciplines is essential.

· Experience working with government, research institutions, development organisations or technology partners, and translating technical findings into planning or policy recommendations, is desirable.

Essential skills

· Strong practical proficiency in Google Earth Engine, Python and at least one desktop GIS platform such as QGIS or ArcGIS. Ability to process large raster and vector datasets and automate repeatable analyses.

· Sound understanding of coordinate systems, spatial resolution, resampling, raster and vector operations, satellite-image preprocessing, time-series analysis and classification accuracy assessment.

· Hands-on experience with geospatial Python libraries and statistical or machine-learning tools, such as GeoPandas, Rasterio, GDAL, xarray and scikit-learn, or equivalent libraries suited to the task.

· Ability to design defensible validation, assess data quality and uncertainty, and explain the limitations of spatial models. Familiarity with open datasets such as Landsat, Sentinel, OpenStreetMap and building or population products.

· Ability to write clear technical documentation and policy-facing outputs, produce accurate maps, and communicate complex findings to non-technical audiences.

· Strong project organisation, collaborative working and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage concurrent assignments and maintain research quality under deadlines.


CEEW offers an intellectually challenging work environment focused on research rigour, innovative thinking and strategic outreach. The candidate should be willing to undertake field visits and respond flexibly to evolving programme needs.

Compensation

Competitive compensation, commensurate with experience and matching the best standards adopted by the industry or similar organisations for comparable roles.

Application Process

CEEW is an equal-opportunity employer, and the selection process does not discriminate based on age, gender, sexuality, ethnicity, religion or caste. Female candidates and those from marginalised backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Interested applicants should submit their CV and a relevant writing sample or technical portfolio through CEEW’s careers portal. Portfolio examples may include geospatial analyses, documented code, maps, dashboards or published research, with the applicant’s contribution clearly identified.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Selection will include a technical or written assessment and interviews. We appreciate your interest.

title: Senior Software Test Engineer (Python), Intelligence Systems
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers’ most pressing national security requirements.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our rapidly growing team in Reston, Virginia. In this role, you will take cutting-edge designs from our engineering team and own the end-to-end functional testing effort.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Conduct comprehensive functional testing and validation of advanced networking devices and systems.
  • Design and implement critical test cases and strategies for high-impact, rapidly evolving technology programs.
  • Develop custom software and/or utilities, scripts, and automation frameworks to effectively exercise and validate designs under test.
  • Lead rigorous root cause analysis for identified test failures, collaborating closely with engineering teams to diagnose issues, propose solutions, and drive the implementation of effective corrective actions.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Demonstrated proficiency in Python programming
  • Comprehensive understanding of standard software testing principles and methodologies
  • Strong understanding of core networking principles and basic IP networking protocols
  • Experience with test automation frameworks and instrument control (OpenHTF, Selenium, Playwright).
  • Familiarity of automated testing frameworks such as Pytest
  • Proven ability to interpret complex requirements and translate them into robust, effective test cases and strategies.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active secret security clearance (at a minimum)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience performing Hardware-In-The-Loop (HITL) testing of networking devices.
  • Proficiency in using network analysis tools, such as Wireshark.
  • Experience working with embedded systems or devices.
  • Experience testing designs for high-volume production.
  • Experience validating designs intended for harsh or deployed environments (ruggedized, airborne, or space).
US Salary Range
$191,000—$253,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: QA Lead
description:
CD PROJEKT RED is looking for QA Lead to join the Hadar project. In this role, you will manage the QA team within the project, adapting the project QA strategy into clear team plans, priorities and measurable outcomes.

You will be responsible for developing a high-performing QA team, ensuring reliable milestone verification, maintaining visibility on gameplay quality status and risks, and continuously improving QA workflows, tools, reporting, and gameplay testing practices within your area of ownership.

You will collaborate closely with Production, Development, Tech, Shared Development Services, QA Experts, other QA Leads, and cross-functional teams to support gameplay integrity, engine and tools quality, performance, stability, gameplay consistency, and development pipeline reliability.

Responsibilites:

  • Building and shaping a high-performing QA team by supporting recruitment, onboarding, team structure, and the development of the right skills and capabilities to meet project needs.
  • Leading, mentoring, and developing the QA team while fostering accountability, role clarity, and continuous skill growth.
  • Adapting & Implementing the overarching QA strategy into practical testing approaches, measurable outcomes, and clear team priorities.
  • Owning testing execution and milestone verification, ensuring tasks are completed on time and meet gameplay quality standards.
  • Monitoring quality metrics, and bug trends to identify risks early and build practical mitigation plans.
  • Partnering with development, production, and external QA vendors to coordinate dependencies, gameplay requests, and alignment.
  • Actively participating in hands-on testing, including exploratory, feature, and regression testing, to maintain direct product knowledge and support the team during critical development phases.
  • Maintaining clear, data-informed reporting on quality status, blockers, and project readiness for all relevant stakeholders.
  • Driving continuous improvements in QA workflows, tools, testing frameworks, technical documentation, and overall team effectiveness.
  • Providing direct assistance with complex investigations, issue analysis, and debugging workflows when required.
  • 5+ years of experience leading and managing QA Teams preferably in AAA environments.
  • Strong knowledge of testing methodologies, bug workflows, defect management, test planning, test coverage, QA practices, and quality reporting.
  • Experience with game engines and editors, especially in Unreal Engine.

  • Experience with performance analysis, profiling tools, crash analysis, memory investigations, platform-specific testing, or console development environments.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to clearly present quality status, risks, blockers, priorities, and recommendations.
  • Experience working with external QA vendors, distributed QA teams, or cross-location development teams.
  • Strong ownership, accountability, and ability to work effectively under pressure, ambiguity, and changing priorities.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with User Experience Research (UXR), focus groups, usability testing, and gathering player feedback to inform product and design decisions
  • Experience with automation frameworks, automated test authorship, build verification, CI/CD pipelines, or technical validation workflows.

Work mode: office-first in full capacity from the Warsaw office.

Perks & Professional Growth

title: Lead Cloud Operations Engineer
description:

title: Senior UI Artist (Unreal Engine 5)
description:

Responsibilities

  • Drive the visual direction of the UI look and feel from concept through ship quality

  • Deliver final UI art directly in Unreal Engine using UMG, Slate, and widget animations

  • Craft game menus, HUD elements, iconography, and UI motion aligned with gameplay needs
  • Develop material-driven effects, 2D or animated effects, and basic Blueprint logic for UI
  • Tune UI assets for performance and clarity across PC, console, and mobile targets
  • Guarantee UI supports accessibility and localization readiness without compromising quality
  • Manage UI asset libraries, style guides, and reusable components

  • 3+ years of professional experience as a UI Artist or in a closely related art discipline, ideally within games
  • Skills in leadership to own a UI theme from concept through final implementation
  • Showcase of shipped UI across PC, console, and mobile targets in prior projects
  • Expertise in Unreal Engine 5 with UMG, Slate, and the Material Editor
