title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Are you driven by data, customer success, and bold innovation? Do you thrive in fast-paced environments where hustle meets heart? If you're ready to help shape the future of ecommerce technology, Cymax Group Technologies wants you on our team.

At Cymax Group Technologies, we empower leading brands and retailers to thrive in the digital marketplace through cutting-edge technology, data-driven insights, and seamless logistics. We’re a tech-driven brand accelerator in home, lifestyle, and adjacent categories. Our proprietary platforms—Channel Gate and Freight Club—leverage automation, AI, and over two decades of ecommerce expertise to simplify multi-channel selling, optimize fulfillment, and unlock scalable growth.

We support thousands of partners across North America, helping them navigate complex marketplaces like Amazon, Walmart, Wayfair, and more. Our mission is to make ecommerce effortless, and our team is at the heart of that transformation.

Recognized as one of Canada’s fastest-growing tech companies, Cymax Group is proud to foster a culture where innovation, collaboration, and employee experience come first. If you're passionate about making an impact and being part of a company that’s redefining online retail, we’d love to meet you.

Let’s build the future of ecommerce—together.

This is a Hybrid role, based in Vancouver, Canada

About The Role

Freight Club is building out its Analytics & Insights function, and we’re looking for an Analytics Engineer to help build the data foundation that everything else depends on. This is a hands‑on, build-focused role for someone who enjoys working in the layer between raw data and analytics modelling data and building the pipelines that turn messy source data into clean, trusted, well-structured datasets.

You’ll work closely with the Director of Analytics and Insights and alongside the wider analytics team. You won’t do this alone — you’ll be part of a small team, with guidance on architecture and direction — and you’ll play a key role in how our data is transformed and made ready for analysis, reporting, and in time machine learning. It’s a great fit for someone with a few years of experience who is ready to grow their scope.

The immediate focus is helping to audit and rebuild our data foundation on Databricks using a medallion architecture, so the business can be served with clean, reliable data it can trust — using solid SQL and Python skills, and modern AI tooling, along the way.

Why This Role Exists

This person helps build the reliable, well-modelled data layer that makes trustworthy reporting and advanced analytics possible for the business.

What You’ll Do

These are shared team priorities — you’ll focus on the hands‑on engineering work and partner with the analytics team and the Director of Analytics and Insights on architecture decisions and the rest.

Build the Foundation

  • Help audit the current warehouse. Review existing tables and data quality, and contribute to the target-state design and migration plan.
  • Build out the lakehouse. Help implement a medallion architecture on Databricks — structuring raw, cleansed, and business-ready layers (bronze / silver / gold).
  • Model the data. Build well-documented data models (e.g. dimensional / star-schema) that are intuitive for analysts and reliable for reporting.
  • Build the pipelines. Develop and maintain ELT/ETL pipelines using SQL and Python/PySpark, with Delta Lake as the storage foundation.

Make the Data Trustworthy & Usable

  • Improve data integrity. Build testing, validation, and data-quality checks so the business can trust the numbers.
  • Automate reporting foundations. Replace manual refreshes with reliable, scheduled, automated data pipelines feeding Power BI and other consumers.
  • Enable clean BI. Help build the well-structured model layer that Power BI reports sit on, and support the clean-up of existing reporting.
  • Document and follow good practices. Write clear documentation and follow team conventions and engineering practices (version control, code review, CI/CD for data) so the platform is maintainable.

Support Advanced Analytics, ML & AI

  • Prepare data for ML. Build clean, reliable datasets and feature-ready tables that make advanced analytics and machine-learning models possible as the team grows its capabilities.
  • Use modern AI tools. Use current AI tooling — including LLM-based assistants such as Claude — to speed up development (SQL, Python, pipelines, documentation).
  • Partner with the team and the business. Work with the analytics team and business stakeholders to understand how data is consumed, and design models that fit real analytical and business needs.

Who You’ll Work With

You’ll work most closely with the Director of Analytics and Insights and day to day with the wider analytics team. The business is the primary consumer of the data models, pipelines, and reporting you help build, so you’ll collaborate with stakeholders across the company to understand the data they rely on.

What We’re Looking For

Our ideal candidate is a hands‑on analytics or data engineer with strong experience who takes pride in well-modelled data and is excited to help bring order to a messy environment. The traits below matter as much as the technical checklist that follows.

  • A builder at heart. You enjoy building data models and pipelines, and you care about doing it well, not just quickly.
  • Curious about architecture. You think in layers, models, and data flows, and want to grow your data architecture skills.
  • A self‑starter. You’re comfortable in a less structured environment, ask good questions, and take initiative on your work.
  • Quality-focused. You treat data integrity, testing, and documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought.
  • A collaborative translator. You understand how analysts and the business use data, and design your models and pipelines around those needs.
  • AI‑curious. You actively use modern AI tooling, such as Claude, to work faster, and you’re interested in how ML models use data.

Skills & Experience

Databricks & Spark

Hands‑on experience with a modern data platform — Databricks preferred (Spark / PySpark, Delta Lake), or similar such as Snowflake.

Lakehouse concepts

Understanding of layered data design (e.g. bronze / silver / gold); hands‑on medallion experience is a plus.

Data warehousing

Good grasp of data warehouse/lakehouse fundamentals, with interest in contributing to design and migration work.

Data modelling

Working data modelling skills (dimensional / star-schema and similar) for analytics-ready datasets.

SQL

Strong SQL for transformation and validation — a core, everyday tool in this role.

Python & data manipulation

Solid Python (PySpark a plus) for data manipulation, transformation, and automation.

Machine learning

Basic understanding of ML concepts and what data models need.

AI stacks & LLMs

Comfort using modern AI tooling, including LLM assistants such as Claude, to speed up development.

Pipelines & orchestration

Experience building and scheduling ELT/ETL pipelines (e.g. Databricks Workflows, Airflow, or similar).

Data quality & integrity

Testing, validation, and data-quality practices that make data trustworthy.

BI enablement

Familiarity with Power BI and building the clean model/semantic layer that reporting depends on.

Engineering practices

Version control (Git), code review, and CI/CD applied to data / analytics engineering.

Nice to Have

  • dbt or similar transformation frameworks.
  • Experience on a major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Exposure to ML workflows or feature engineering.
  • Experience working in an agile, sprint-based environment.

Why It’s a Great Opportunity

This is a great chance to help build a data platform from the foundations up — working on the lakehouse the whole business will rely on, with mentorship from analytics leadership. If you want to grow your skills and help take an organisation from manual, ad-hoc data to a clean, automated, ML-ready platform, this is the role.

Compensation And Benefits

Salary - $100k-$120k per annum

  • Health and wellness support for you and your family, including an employee assistance program
  • 100% paid premiums for health and dental benefits in Canada
  • Paid time off
  • Easy access to online and phone-based counselling services
  • A genuinely hybrid-flexible work environment

At Cymax Group, we thrive on innovation and entrepreneurship. As an AI-first organization, we are on an exciting journey to continuously grow and evolve our focus on AI, empowering our people at all levels. Our fast-paced environment encourages agility and nimbleness, enabling our team to adapt swiftly to changing market dynamics. We're passionate about continuous learning and growth, offering opportunities for professional development. Our data-driven decision-making ensures we make informed choices that lead to success. title: Estimator
description:
Purpose: The Estimator serves as a technical specialist and subject matter expert responsible for conducting accurate cost estimation of time, materials, labor, and equipment quantification for commercial roofing projects, wall panel projects, and coating projects. This role ensures the organization's bids are thorough; capturing all essential elements of the opportunity via roof tech checklist information, blueprints and drawings, and specification manuals when available. The priority of an Estimator is to present a viable and accurate bid proposal that is competitive, rigorously assessed for risk, and accurately scoped to maximize project profitability and successful completion. This role plays a critical part in both external and internal client relations, project management, and overall project consultancy to ensure client expectations are met and projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and on target.

  • Estimation and Quantification: Assess and analyze roof tech checklists, project documents, blueprints, and plans to prepare precise cost estimates for commercial roofing systems, including managing take-offs from bid documents and field notes.
  • Cost Research and Sourcing: Conduct detailed research on current labor costs, material pricing, and production times, utilizing specialized software for data analysis and accurate forecasting. Solicit, compare, and analyze material quotes from manufacturers and suppliers to ensure competitive project pricing.
  • Risk and Profitability Analysis: Identify and thoroughly mitigate potential risks, uncertainties, and hidden costs in project bids and pricing strategies. Apply excellent understanding of project costing and profitability analysis to ensure estimates support profitable company growth.
  • Site Verification: Conduct roof surveys and travel to work sites as necessary to inspect existing materials, gather accurate data, and verify site conditions that impact project scope and cost.
  • Technical Communication and Presentation: Prepare detailed summaries of the scope of work, cost breakdowns, comprehensive reports, and bid packages. Present and technically explain estimates and scope limitations to clients and internal stakeholders, answering questions and addressing concerns regarding project costs.
    • Present project information during a technical review with senior estimator, verifying all aspects of the project are considered and calculated.
    • Present project scope of work, details, and finalized estimate during bid review process to align internal stakeholders before presenting bid/proposal to client.
    • Coordinate preconstruction handoff meetings to ensure information and communication flows efficiently and effectively to the operational teams executing the work.
  • Technology Mastery: Utilize and champion The Edge estimating software, digital takeoff tools, and associated technologies for efficient measurement, analysis, and bid generation.
  • Technical Mentorship: Collaborate with fellow preconstruction team members, advising on complex estimation problems and best practices.
  • Coordinate and attend regular production meetings (internal and external) and advise and guide to ensure quality, safety, and profitability are maintained throughout the project.
  • Additional duties as needed and agreed upon.

Tools for the Job:

Required:

  • Minimum 2 years experience in Edge Estimating Software performing takeoffs, condition building, labor calculations, and materials calculations
  • Proven experience in commercial roofing estimation, with a strong track record of successful project bids.
    • Proven understanding of the following roofing systems:
      • Single Ply: EPDM/TPO/PVC
      • Multi-Ply: BUR cold applied
      • Wall Panels: hidden and exposed fasteners
      • Roof Coatings
      • Standing Seam Metal Roofing
      • Tapered Insulation systems
  • Excellent understanding of project costing, risk assessment, and profitability analysis. Minimum of ten years of experience.
  • Proven track record of delivering successful projects on time and within budget.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and foster collaboration among team members.
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Math and problem solving are critical.

Preferred:

  • Proven understanding of the following building envelope systems:
    • Wall Panels: hidden and exposed fasteners
    • Roof Coatings
    • Standing Seam Metal Roofing
    • Vapor Barriers
  • Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, or a related field or experience.
  • A valid certification, like Certified Professional Estimator (CPE)
  • General Construction and/or manufacturing experience

Direct Reports: None

Work Location: In Office/Hybrid/Remote

title: Engineering Summer Intern Program (3-month contract)
description:
The Bigger Picture

At Andromeda, we're building the social intelligence layer for humanoid robots - technology that allows robots to understand people, build relationships and become a meaningful part of everyday life.

Our first robot, Abi, is already doing this in aged care and healthcare, where she brings conversation, companionship and engagement to people every day.

Now we're scaling from early deployments into a platform that can operate across thousands of real-world environments. We're looking for individuals who want to tackle hard problems across robotics and AI, and help define what it means for robots to live and interact alongside people.

Introducing our First Engineering Summer Intern Program

We’re seeking up to 6 ambitious engineering students to join our Melbourne team for an immersive summer experience. You won't be watching from the sidelines, you’ll be embedded in our core engineering teams, actively assembling, testing, and deploying real-world hardware, firmware, and autonomous systems alongside industry pioneers.

We have positions available across:

  • Hardware Engineering - Electrical, Mechanical & Testing
  • Software Engineering - Software, Firmware & Autonomy

You can nominate your preferred stream in the application.

This is a paid internship program commencing in late October 2026 and concluding at the end of February 2027. The programme would provide approximately three months of active placement, excluding the EOY company shutdown period.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Rapid Prototyping & Hardware Assembly - Assemble, wire, and modify custom test rigs, fixtures, and cutting-edge prototype hardware.
  • Rigorous Verification & Testing - Design, execute, and document technical test protocols across complex hardware, firmware, and autonomous software modules.
  • Workshop & Field Operations - Work shoulder-to-shoulder with senior engineers on mobility rigs, active field testing, and advanced workshop builds.
  • High-Impact R&D Ownership - Take ownership of discrete engineering projects designed to accelerate our core robotics roadmap.

Requirements

  • Ideally penultimate or final year engineering students (Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Firmware/Embedded, Software, or related discipline) but open to all high-achieving engineering students
  • Comfortable getting hands-on in a workshop or lab setting
  • Able to follow technical procedures accurately and work safely under direction
  • Strong communication skills and eagerness to learn alongside senior engineers and technicians
  • Relentless curiosity and a genuine passion for pioneering human-centric robotics
  • Willingness to work onsite, 5 days per week in our Southbank Office

As part of our application process, you’ll be invited to showcase your practical skills beyond your resume by submitting a portfolio, case study, project walkthrough, video introduction, slide deck, or another work sample that reflects how you think and what you can do. You’ll also be asked to provide your academic transcript.

We’re moving quickly to fill these roles, and this advertisement will close as soon as all positions have been filled. We encourage you to apply early so your application can be considered as part of the process.

Benefits

By joining our Engineering Summer Intern Program, you will have the unique opportunity to work at the forefront of social robotics, helping shape technologies that bridge the gap between people and autonomous systems. Throughout the program, you'll learn directly from industry-leading experts in engineering and robotics, gaining hands-on experience supported by dedicated mentoring and coaching to accelerate your professional growth.

Our Values

  • Empathy – Kindness and compassion are at the heart of everything we do.
  • Play – Play sharpens focus. It keeps us curious, fast and obsessed with the craft.
  • Never Settle – A relentless ambition, bias toward action, and uncomfortable levels of curiosity.
  • Tenacity – Tenacious under pressure, we assume chaos and stay in motion to adapt and progress.
  • Unity – Different minds. Shared mission. No passengers.

title: Azure Infrastructure Engineer
description:
The Opportunity

We are currently recruiting for an experienced Infrastructure Engineer on a permanent basis to join a well-established organisation based near Salisbury. This role offers hybrid working. You will be joining the Architecture and Engineering team who focused on supporting and enhancing a complex on-premises infrastructure estate while also contributing to the organisation's ongoing cloud transformation journey.

As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the performance, reliability, security and availability of critical IT infrastructure environments. Working closely with operational teams, developers and project stakeholders, you will help deliver and maintain robust infrastructure solutions that support business objectives and future growth.
The RoleYou will be responsible for managing and optimising core infrastructure services including Active Directory, Azure AD, Group Policy, DNS and DHCP. Alongside maintaining Windows Server environments across physical and virtual platforms, you will oversee storage technologies including NAS and SAN solutions.

The role will involve working closely with security teams to ensure infrastructure remains secure, compliant and resilient through effective patch management, system hardening, vulnerability remediation and threat protection measures. You will also support backup, replication and disaster recovery processes, ensuring business continuity requirements are met.

As part of the organisation's cloud strategy, you will assist with the migration of workloads from on-premises environments into Microsoft Azure. title: Full Stack Engineer - Must be DV Cleared
description:
Full Stack Engineer

Contract | 6 months+ | UK hybrid | DV Cleared

Morela is proud to be supporting a sovereign AI business whose software has to run where most software cannot: offline, locked down, and under real scrutiny. Their platform is an AI operating system built for exactly those conditions.

They are well funded, growing quickly, and already live on serious government and commercial programmes. The engineering team is small and senior, so nobody here is a spare pair of hands.

The Job

You would sit inside the delivery team on a defence programme and build across the whole stack. Python services and pipelines at one end, the TypeScript front end that operators actually use at the other. The environments you ship into have no internet, the deadlines do not move, and the requirements will.

It is a high trust seat. You take a problem from a conversation with the customer through to something running in production, and you are the one on site when it needs fixing. In exchange you get properly hard problems, senior people around you, and real influence over a product that matters.

Not many engineers get this close to sovereign AI in defence. What is being built here will shape how these organisations work for years.

What the Work Looks Like

  • Building and maintaining features top to bottom: Python back end services and APIs, React and TypeScript on the front.
  • Getting software into secure, air-gapped and sensitive environments, which means on-site deployment, integration and troubleshooting.
  • Owning features properly. Scope it with the technical lead, CTO and customer, build it, test it, ship it, then support it.
  • Containerising services and shaping how the platform runs on Kubernetes and bare-metal Linux.
  • Writing code you would be happy to inherit, and holding that same line in review.
  • Fixing production problems calmly, usually with less tooling than you would like and someone waiting on you.
  • Working alongside the data, AI and platform engineers so models, pipelines and infrastructure land as one product rather than three.
  • Improving the day to day: CI/CD, observability, security hardening, documentation.
  • Sitting in front of customers and partners and turning what they need into something buildable.

What You Will Need

  • Python. Serious commercial experience building back end services, APIs and tooling. FastAPI, Django, Flask, whichever you have used in anger.
  • TypeScript. Serious commercial experience on modern front ends with React, Vue or Angular.
  • Linux. Properly comfortable without a GUI: shell, networking, processes, permissions, systemd, packages, and working out why a host is misbehaving.
  • Full stack delivery. A track record of shipping whole features from database to browser, relational databases and SQL included.
  • Containers and CI/CD. Docker plus automated build, test and deploy pipelines.
  • Composure. You have delivered against customer deadlines that do not slip, and you get methodical rather than frantic when something breaks.
  • Secure environment fit. Happy following strict security and handling procedures, and getting to UK customer sites when the programme needs you there.
  • Communication. Clear with engineers and with customers who are not engineers.
  • Clearance. Current, active SC. You must be UK based and able to hold and maintain UK clearance.

What Would Put You Ahead

  • Delivery into defence, national security or another heavily regulated sector.
  • Running software in air-gapped or disconnected environments, including offline dependencies and moving artefacts across the boundary.
  • Good instincts on secure development, authentication, authorisation and secrets management.
  • Putting AI or ML models into production, LLM features included.
  • Infrastructure as code with Terraform, Ansible or similar, plus configuration management.
  • Observability and incident response: metrics, logging, tracing.
  • Message queues, event-driven architectures or data pipelines.

Also Welcome

  • Kubernetes. Deploying, running or debugging workloads, including K3s, RKE2 or OpenShift.
  • Data at scale. Spark, Trino, Parquet, Iceberg or similar columnar and distributed query tooling.
  • GPU workloads and serving models on-premise.
  • Open source contributions or a portfolio worth a look.
  • Mentoring engineers or leading a small delivery team.
  • DV clearance, or eligibility for it.

title: Maskinmesterpraktikant
description:
Er du klar til at kickstarte din karriere i et af Nordens største ingeniørhuse? Så søg en praktikplads hos AFRY!

Hos os får du som praktikant lov til at prøve kræfter med spændende projekter og arbejde tæt sammen med et dygtigt team, der hjælper dig med at udvikle dine kompetencer i praksis.

”Som maskinmesterpraktikant hos AFRY er jeg blevet taget rigtig godt imod og har fra første dag fået følelsen af at være en del af teamet. Her er ingen spørgsmål for dumme, og alle er parate til at hjælpe, hvilket giver tryghed til selvstændigt at løse faglige opgaver med solid sparring. Udover spændende og udfordrende opgaver oplever jeg en moderne, rådgivende ingeniørvirksomhed med frihed under ansvar og højt til loftet.”

Om opgaverne

Vi søger en praktikant til vores Electrical Engineering & BMS-team. Her arbejder vi med alt fra elinstallationer, automatiserede systemer og projektudvikling. Teamet består af 13 dygtige kollegaer med forskellige baggrunde, herunder ingeniører, maskinmestre, installatører og tekniske designere. Vi arbejder tæt sammen, deler viden og hjælper hinanden med at finde de bedste, bæredygtige løsninger for vores kunder.

I din praktik vil du blandt andet prøve kræfter med at:

  • bestykke hospitaler, skoler, lejligheder, kontorer m.v.
  • være med til at udarbejde f.eks. hovedledningsdiagrammer, etageplaner samt disponering af føringsveje m.v. i Revit
  • udføre kabeldimensionering i Simaris, Caneco-BT m.v.
  • udføre lys- og spændingsfaldsberegninger m.v.
  • deltage i både interne og eksterne projekteringsmøder, myndigheds- og bygherremøder samt tilsyn på nogle af vores projekter under udførelse.

Praktikken forventes at starte primo januar 2027.

Vi forestiller os, at du er i gang med at læse til maskinmester eller el-ingeniør. En baggrund som elektriker eller anden relevant faguddannelse er en fordel - men ikke et krav.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage initiativ
  • har gåpåmod og lyst til at lære
  • trives som teamplayer i et miljø med sparring og konstruktiv, løsningsorienteret dialog

Om AFRY

AFRY leverer ingeniørydelser, projektledelse og rådgivning, der fremmer transformation inden for industri, energi og infrastruktur. Med eksperter over hele verden kombinerer vi globalt udsyn med lokal indsigt og dyb brancheforståelse for at skabe værdi for kommende generationer. Vores principper - Result driven, Client Centric, Empowering, Accountable - viser vejen for, hvordan vi arbejder og lykkes sammen. Bliv en del af AFRY, og vær med til at drive omstillingen til et bæredygtigt og resilient samfund.

Vi er et af Nordens største ingeniørhuse og sætter rammerne for en god arbejdsplads, hvor digitalisering og bæredygtighed er strategiske pejlemærker. Her kan du udvikle din faglighed gennem projekter fra A-Z, og på tværs af fag og landegrænser.

Sparring, feedback og teamwork er nøgleord i vores daglige arbejde. Og vi efterstræber en venlig og rummelig kultur med respekt for hinanden. Vi arbejder bevidst med inklusion og diversitet - hos os kan du være dig selv.

Interesseret?

Send dit CV samt uddannelsesdokumentation/eksamensbevis til os snarest muligt.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtale og stopper processen, når vi har fundet vores næste praktikant.

At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. title: Medewerker Magazijn & Expeditie
description:
Medewerker Magazijn & Expeditie

Houdt overzicht in de logistiek en zorgt dat alles op het juiste moment op de juiste plek is.

Als Medewerker Magazijn & Expeditie werk je binnen een klein en gezellig team aan maatwerk hijsoplossingen voor klanten over de hele wereld. Jij focust je op het logistieke gedeelte en zorgt ervoor dat goederen, materialen en complete projecten goed worden ontvangen, verwerkt en verzonden.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Het gesloten magazijn en de Kardex-kast beheren.

  • Zorgdragen voor de inkomende en uitgaande goederenstroom.

  • Goederen controleren die klaarstaan voor assemblage en zorgen dat de juiste bevestigingsmiddelen voorhanden zijn.

  • Na assemblage samen met je collega’s zorgen dat het project compleet en goed verpakt de deur uitgaat.

  • De voorraad van zowel magazijn- als facilitaire artikelen op peil houden.

  • Transporten boeken voor kleine goederen en spareparts.

  • Een bijdrage leveren aan het verbeteren en efficiënter maken van de logistieke werkprocessen.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je bent secuur en bekend met (internationale) logistieke processen.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met techniek.

  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een soortgelijke functie.

  • Je hebt een afgeronde mbo-opleiding op minimaal niveau 3, of een gelijkwaardig niveau op basis van ervaring.

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

  • Je bent handig met de computer, beheerst MS Office en bent bekend met ERP-systemen en digitale processen. Ervaring met MS Dynamics is een pré.

  • Je denkt vooruit en bent een doener. Afspraak is afspraak voor jou.

  • Je staat klaar voor een ander en werkt samen met het team aan het beste resultaat.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een contract voor een jaar met uitzicht op een contract voor onbepaalde tijd.

  • Een contract van 40 uur per week.

  • Een salaris tussen € 3.354 en € 3.960 bruto per maand.

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 13 roostervrije dagen volgens de cao Metalektro.

  • 8% vakantiegeld, PME-pensioen en een bonusregeling tot 12%.

  • Reiskosten- en thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Een moderne en schone werkomgeving in de hightech industrie.

  • Een duidelijk ontwikkelsysteem (Dialog Performance) met aandacht voor jouw groei en ontwikkeling

Waarom Mennens Cleanroom Cranes?

Mennens Cleanroom Cranes ontwerpt en produceert maatwerk hijsoplossingen voor schone productieomgevingen. Denk aan de computerchipindustrie, food, farmacie en luchtvaart. Dat kan variëren van een eenvoudige takel tot hijskranen met meerdere takels en geavanceerde besturing.

Mennens Cleanroom Cranes is een zelfstandige B.V. binnen de Mennens-groep, met 7 vestigingen verspreid over Nederland en België. De klanten bestaan onder andere uit grote internationale spelers in de computerchipindustrie en hun toeleveranciers. Op de werkvloer heerst een informele sfeer: er wordt hard gewerkt, maar er is ook ruimte om samen te lachen. Samen zet het team zich in om projecten veilig en op tijd op te leveren en creatieve oplossingen te bedenken voor ingewikkelde uitdagingen.

Enthousiast?

Wil jij jouw logistieke ervaring inzetten binnen een technische omgeving en bijdragen aan projecten voor klanten over de hele wereld? Solliciteer dan direct.

title: Product Designer III
description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

About the Role :

We're looking for a Product Designer III to own end-to-end design for a significant area of the product. This is a individual contributor role: you'll lead design on complex, ambiguous problems, partner closely with Product and Engineering, and help raise the bar for craft and process across the design team. You'll spend meaningful time in our design system, both using it and shaping it, and you'll be expected to make sound design decisions independently with minimal oversight.

What You'll Do :

  • Own the end-to-end design process for major features or product areas — from problem framing and research through wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity, polished UI
  • Lead design on cross-functional initiatives, partnering with Product Management, Engineering, and Research as a peer, not just an executor
  • Conduct and synthesize user research (qualitative and quantitative) and turn it into clear design decisions and rationale
  • Contribute to, extend, and enforce consistency in the design system (components, patterns, tokens), rather than working around it
  • Prototype at varying levels of fidelity to test ideas quickly and de-risk decisions before engineering investment
  • Present and defend design work to stakeholders, including leadership, with clear rationale tied to user and business outcomes
  • Give and receive design critique regularly; mentor and unblock more junior designers on your team
  • Balance speed and craft — know when a rough prototype is enough and when a problem deserves deeper exploration
  • Prototype with AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, v0, Lovable) to go from a Figma frame to a working, data-connected prototype — not just clickable mocks — for anything where real interaction or logic matters
  • Design the human-AI interaction layer where relevant: how the product surfaces confidence, uncertainty, and AI-driven suggestions; how users stay in control and build trust in automated or predictive output
  • Use AI tooling inside the design stack itself (Figma AI, generative UI, AI-assisted research synthesis) to speed up production work without lowering the bar on originality or craft.

What We're Looking For :

  • 5–7+ years of experience as a Product Designer or similar, with a strong portfolio showing shipped, end-to-end product work (not just concepts)
  • Deep fluency in Figma, including component/variant systems, auto-layout, and design tokens.
  • Demonstrated experience designing within and contributing to a design system at scale
  • Strong interaction design and visual design fundamentals — typography, layout, hierarchy, motion
  • Working knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.2) and a habit of designing for accessibility by default, not as an afterthought
  • Experience running and synthesizing user research and usability testing, and using data to support design decisions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication — you can explain why, not just show what
  • A track record of leading design work independently on ambiguous problems with limited direction
  • Comfort collaborating directly with engineers on feasibility and implementation details
  • Hands-on, regular use of AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, v0, or Lovable) to turn designs into working, data-connected prototypes — not just static mocks
  • Demonstrated experience designing interaction patterns for AI-powered or predictive features: surfacing confidence and uncertainty, giving users appropriate control, and building trust in automated output
  • Fluency with AI features inside the design toolchain itself (e.g., Figma AI, AI-assisted research synthesis) as part of your everyday workflow, not a novelty.

Nice to Have :

  • Experience designing for B2B SaaS or data-heavy/analytics products
  • Front-end fluency beyond the basics (React/JS) sufficient for close collaboration with engineering on handoff
  • Prior experience mentoring designers or informally leading a small design pod
  • Experience working in a company where the design system is actively evolving (contributing to it, not just consuming it)

Our Benefits:

Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.

We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com.

We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:
Liiketoiminta ja teknologia puhuvat usein eri kieltä, mutta sinä osaat molempia. Nyt etsimme kokenutta Solution Architectia.

Jos tunnistat itsesi tästä, saatat olla etsimämme asiantuntija:

Olet kokenut Solution Architect, jolle kokemusvuosia on kertynyt jo vähintään 8. Toimit asiakasprojekteissa itsenäisesti ja luotat omaan asiantuntijuuteesi. Lähdet liikkeelle liiketoiminnan tarpeista: selvität, mitä asiakas oikeasti tavoittelee, ja muutat tavoitteet toimiviksi, kustannustehokkaiksi ja toteutettaviksi ratkaisuiksi. Toimit siltana johdon, liiketoiminnan ja kehitystiimien välillä, ja perustelet arkkitehtuurivalinnat niin, että ne ymmärretään myös johtoryhmässä.

Hahmotat kokonaisuuksia, tunnistat riippuvuudet ja riskit ajoissa ja osaat tehdä perusteltuja valintoja eri vaihtoehtojen välillä, oli kyse sitten valmisratkaisusta, räätälöidystä kehityksestä tai näiden yhdistelmästä. Osaat myös jakaa osaamistasi ja parhaita käytäntöjä ymmärrettävällä ja käytännönläheisellä tavalla.

Saatat etsiä seuraavaa työpaikkaasi tai seuraavaa projektiasi yrittäjänä.

**Millaista osaamista etsimme**

- Vähintään 8 vuoden kokemusta ratkaisuarkkitehtuurista, kokonaisarkkitehtuurista tai vastaavista tehtävistä

- Kokemusta liiketoimintatarpeiden ja vaatimusten kartoittamisesta ja niiden muuttamisesta ratkaisuiksi

- Kokemusta ratkaisuvaihtoehtojen vertailusta, esimerkiksi kustannusten, riskien, elinkaaren ja toimittajien näkökulmasta

- Ymmärrystä liiketoimintaprosesseista ja siitä, miten tietojärjestelmät tukevat niitä

- Kokemusta tiekarttojen ja arkkitehtuurikuvausten laatimisesta

- Ymmärrystä pilvipalveluista, integraatioista ja tietoturvasta ratkaisujen kokonaisuuden kannalta

- Erinomaisia viestintä- ja sidosryhmätaitoja sekä kykyä toimia itsenäisesti asiakasprojekteissa

- Eduksi näemme kokemuksen julkisen sektorin hankinnoista sekä JHS 179 -kokonaisarkkitehtuurimenetelmän tuntemuksen


Arvostamme kokemusta esimerkiksi seuraavista menetelmistä ja teknologioista: TOGAF, ArchiMate, JHS 179, BPMN, UML, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, LeanIX, Sparx Enterprise Architect

Emme oleta, että osaat kaikkia listattuja menetelmiä ja teknologioita. Jos sinulla on vahva kokemus liiketoimintalähtöisestä ratkaisuarkkitehtuurista, kuulemme sinusta mielellämme! Kerrothan meille hakemuksessasi tarkemmin juuri sinun vahvuuksistasi.

**Mahdollisia työtehtäviäsi**

- Asiakkaan liiketoimintatavoitteiden, tarpeiden ja vaatimusten kartoittaminen

- Kokonaisratkaisujen ja niiden arkkitehtuurin suunnitteleminen

- Ratkaisuvaihtoehtojen, teknologioiden ja toimittajien arvioiminen ja vertaileminen

- Tiekarttojen, arkkitehtuurikuvausten ja päätöksenteon tukimateriaalien laatiminen

- Hankintojen ja tarpeiden määrittelyn tukeminen

- Kehitystiimien ohjaaminen niin, että toteutus vastaa liiketoiminnan tavoitteita

- Muutosten vaikutusten, riskien ja kustannusten arvioiminen

- Yhteistyö asiakkaan johdon, liiketoiminnan, kehittäjien ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa

- Oman osaamisen jakaminen ja muiden asiantuntijoiden sparraaminen

title: Consents advisor
description:
Consents Advisor


Stirling


We are easy to do business with That's why we need people like you to help us support our customers. Our Energy team is recruiting …


We are seeking a proactive and organised Consents Advisor to support both the management of the consents process and the execution of stakeholder engagement activities. This role is crucial in ensuring that regulatory approvals are obtained in a timely manner and that effective communication with stakeholders is maintained throughout the lifecycle of key energy infrastructure projects. Reporting to the Consents Manager, the successful candidate will play a key role in helping projects progress smoothly across Scotland by combining technical know-how with strong communication skills.
The Consents Advisor will support the coordination of consents, ensure full regulatory compliance, and be responsible for building and maintaining relationships with stakeholders including local authorities, environmental bodies, and community representatives.


Here are some of the activities you would get involved with...


  • Consents Management: Assist in managing the consents and approvals process for infrastructure projects, ensuring that all necessary permissions, permits, and licences are obtained within project deadlines.

  • Regulatory Compliance: Support the Consents Manager by staying up to date with planning regulations, environmental legislation, and other legal frameworks to ensure compliance throughout the project's lifecycle.

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Develop and maintain positive relationships with key stakeholders, including local authorities, community groups, landowners, and environmental agencies. Help facilitate clear communication to ensure stakeholders are informed and engaged with project developments.

  • Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate records of all consent applications, stakeholder interactions, and engagement activities. Prepare reports for both internal and external stakeholders, ensuring that all documentation is compliant with regulatory and company standards.

  • Risk Assessment: Assist in identifying potential risks and challenges associated with obtaining consents and engaging stakeholders. Work with the project team to develop strategies that mitigate these risks and ensure smooth project progression.

  • Project Coordination: Liaise with project managers and engineers to ensure that consents and stakeholder feedback are incorporated into project timelines, helping to streamline approvals and maintain good relations with external parties.

  • Process Improvement: Contribute to improving processes for managing consents and engagement, streamlining workflows, and adopting best practices to ensure efficient project delivery.

  • Support Team Leadership: Provide administrative and strategic support to the Consents Manager and assist in leading engagement activities with the wider team, including geospatial analysts and other officers, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team environment.


We would love to hear from you, if you can demonstrate…


  • Proven experience (ideally 3-5 years) in consents management, environmental permitting, or regulatory compliance within the construction or infrastructure sector.

  • Strong understanding of either planning regulations, environmental legislation or land rights and regulatory frameworks relevant to construction projects.

  • Project management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, manage competing deadlines, and coordinate activities across multiple projects.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite and experience with consents management software or databases.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages to different audiences and build positive relationships.

  • A proactive problem-solver who can anticipate issues and develop solutions that minimise project delays and enhance stakeholder engagement.

  • Ability to work flexibly in a hybrid environment, with a willingness to travel.


The role will require occasional travel between project sites and offices, as well as the flexibility to attend stakeholder meetings and public consultations in various locations.


Our Company
Every day we work smarter, greener and use our imaginations.
Our purpose at Clancy is simple - we make life better for everyone's growing families. We play a vital role in providing fresh drinking water and power to millions of homes and businesses and so much more.
We are one of the biggest family owned construction businesses in the UK and we care about our people, our clients and the environment.


What Next
You apply, and we respond within two weeks (we know how annoying it is not to hear anything back)! If you don't receive feedback within that timescale, please don't be afraid to chase us - one of our values is to do what we say we will do!


Benefits
In addition to helping you reach your career goals, a competitive salary, pension, healthcare and holiday allowance starting at 24-26 days per annum, we also offer perks including Clancy Xtras, our employee benefits programme with discounts for numerous well-known retailers such as Tesco, Sainsbury's, Currys PC World and Vue Cinemas, cycle to work scheme as well as an Employee Assistance Programme.

Clancy is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all our employees. If you require any reasonable adjustments to be made for you to attend an interview, please do let us know and we will be happy to accommodate.
We are proud signatories of the Armed Forces Covenant and Disability Confident Committed.

title: Finance & Office Administrator
description:
Finance & Office Administrator

Location: Edinburgh
Salary: Competitive, DOE
Contract: 12–18 Month Fixed-Term Contract – Maternity Cover
Hours: Part-time, 3 days per week, office-based
Start Date: Ideally October 2026

The Opportunity

Caledonian Heating & Plumbing Ltd is looking for an experienced Finance & Office Administrator to join the team on a fixed-term basis, providing maternity cover and ensuring the smooth running of day-to-day finance and office administration.

This is a varied and hands-on position, combining finance administration, bookkeeping, job costing and general office support. You'll play an important role in keeping financial records accurate and up to date, supporting invoicing and cash flow, and ensuring managers and operational teams have the information they need.

Working closely with Directors, managers, engineers, customers, suppliers and external advisers, this is an ideal opportunity for an organised and experienced finance administrator who enjoys working in a busy SME environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Maintain accurate day-to-day financial records, including sales, purchases, expenses and bank transactions.
• Prepare and issue customer invoices and credit notes, ensuring supporting job information and purchase orders are accurate.
• Process, code and match supplier invoices, resolving discrepancies and preparing authorised payment information.
• Complete regular bank and control account reconciliations, investigating and resolving outstanding items.
• Maintain accounts receivable, accounts payable and aged debt records, supporting credit control and escalating overdue or disputed balances.
• Support job costing and work-in-progress, checking labour, materials, subcontractor costs and completion information.
• Monitor completed work awaiting invoicing and follow up on missing timesheets, purchase orders, costs and supporting documentation.
• Prepare regular finance and management information for Directors, including cash, aged debt, creditor and cost information.
• Collate and check payroll, overtime, mileage and expenses information before submission.
• Liaise with customers, suppliers, engineers and internal teams to resolve finance and administration queries.
• Provide general office support, including calls, emails, document management, filing, supplier/customer records and work-order administration.
• Maintain organised, accurate and confidential financial and administrative records.
• Support the documentation and handover of key finance and administration processes throughout the fixed-term contract.

About You

We're looking for someone with proven experience in bookkeeping or finance administration, ideally within an SME or commercial service environment.

You'll be confident managing a range of finance processes and comfortable working independently while also supporting colleagues across the wider business.

You'll bring:

• Previous hands-on experience across sales ledger, purchase ledger, invoicing and bank reconciliations.
• Experience with credit control and maintaining accurate financial records.
• A good understanding of bookkeeping principles, invoice controls and VAT.
• Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
• Excellent organisation skills and the ability to manage competing deadlines.
• Confidence using accounting software, Excel, Outlook and digital systems.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a professional telephone manner.
• A discreet and trustworthy approach when handling financial, payroll and customer information.
• The ability to work proactively, use initiative and provide reliable general office support.

Desirable: Experience within engineering, construction, facilities, trades or another job-costed service business, along with knowledge of Sage, Xero, QuickBooks, WIP/job costing or payroll administration. AAT, IAB, ICB or equivalent qualifications would also be advantageous.

What You'll Be Doing

This role sits at the heart of the company's finance and administration processes, helping to ensure that work is costed accurately, invoiced promptly and financial records remain complete and up to date.

You'll work closely with the Managing Director and wider management team, as well as operational colleagues, customers, suppliers and the external accountant. You'll also be responsible for ensuring key finance processes continue smoothly throughout the maternity-cover period.

A structured handover will be provided ahead of the current Administration Manager's planned maternity leave, giving you the opportunity to become familiar with the company's systems, processes and priorities.

About Caledonian Heating & Plumbing Ltd

Caledonian Heating & Plumbing Ltd is a commercial service business based in Edinburgh, with a close-knit team working across finance, administration and operational functions.

This is an opportunity to join a business where your finance and administrative expertise will have a direct impact on the smooth running of day-to-day operations.

If you're an experienced Finance & Office Administrator looking for a varied part-time fixed-term opportunity, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today.

No agencies please.

title: Senior ML / Evaluation Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Senior ML / Evaluation Engineer to join our team in Portugal in a fully remote working mode. In this role, you will own the design and implementation of advanced evaluation frameworks for an Enterprise Agent Development Platform—a production-grade, cloud-native ecosystem enabling scalable, secure AI agent deployment. You will create evaluation strategies that combine LLM-as-judge grading with deterministic checks, define enterprise evaluation standards, and implement CI/CD deployment gates to enforce quality metrics prior to release. This position requires strong expertise in ML system testing, evaluation design, and integration into automated pipelines for agentic environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement multi-layer evaluation frameworks for agentic workflows and AI-driven applications
  • Build LLM-as-judge evaluators leveraging AWS AgentCore built-in modules and custom logic for correctness and helpfulness checks
  • Develop deterministic evaluators as AWS Lambda functions for rule-based validation
  • Define enterprise evaluation standards, including mandatory dimensions, scoring criteria, and pass/fail thresholds
  • Implement CI/CD deployment gates using on-demand evaluation modes to enforce quality in automated pipelines
  • Enable online evaluation in production by integrating sampling-based evaluation strategies and PII detection guardrails
  • Incorporate observability signals (OpenTelemetry spans) from AWS AgentCore into grading frameworks for trace-level assessment
  • Generate metrics, logs, and dashboards from evaluation outcomes via CloudWatch or equivalent monitoring platforms
  • Collaborate with platform, orchestration, and DevOps teams to maintain evaluation reliability and scalability

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in ML engineering, AI evaluation frameworks, or AI platform development
  • Hands-on expertise designing LLM evaluation frameworks (LLM-as-judge and deterministic graders)
  • Practical experience implementing CI/CD deployment gates for ML model or AI agent quality assurance
  • Proficiency in Python for building evaluation logic (deterministic Lambda-based evaluators)
  • Strong understanding of advanced validation dimensions, including multi-turn context integrity and workflow-level scoring

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with AWS AgentCore Evaluations API (CreateEvaluation, GetEvaluationResult)
  • Exposure to AWS Bedrock Guardrails for compliance and sensitive data validation
  • Experience integrating evaluation metrics into AWS CloudWatch for monitoring and alerting
  • Knowledge of OTel instrumentation and trace ingestion for quality scoring inputs

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation depending on experience and skills
  • Variety of projects within one company
  • Being a part of a project following engineering excellence standards
  • Individual career path and professional growth opportunities
  • Internal events and communities
  • Flexible work hours

title: HGV Technician
description:
HGV Technician

£58,256.14 + Bonus

Northampton
44 hours per week
Rotating Shifts- Week 1: Monday - Thursday 06:00-18:00; Week 2 Tuesday - Friday 06:00-18:00, with a 1 hour unpaid lunch.

Looking for your next move as a HGV Technician?

Want to work somewhere where 80% of our people would recommend us as a Great Place to Work?

Fancy joining a business that invests in its people, offers genuine development opportunities and even has double-figure numbers of returning “boomerang” employees every year?

Then we’d love to hear from you.

We’re looking for an experienced HGV Technician to join our growing team at Northampton.

You’ll work on a wide range of commercial vehicles, including HGVs and RCVs (Refuse Collection Vehicles), carrying out servicing, maintenance, diagnostics and repairs.

And if you haven’t worked on specialist vehicles before — don’t worry. We’ll provide specialist training to build on the skills you already have.

What will you be doing?

As a HGV Technician you will be responsible for servicing, maintenance and repairs on HGVs / commercial vehicles; diagnosing faults and carrying out repairs, as well as carrying out routine inspections and preventative maintenance.

You will also be responsible for attending breakdowns, electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic repairs, as well as Tacho calibrations, repairs and wheel alignment.

You will prepare vehicles for MOT and carry out commercial vehicle / HGV MOT inspections, while makings sure paperwork completed and up to date.

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for someone who knows their way around HGVs and enjoys keeping vehicles moving.

You'll ideally have:

· Experience as an HGV Technician, HGV Mechanic, HGV Engineer or Fleet Engineer

  • A HGV technical qualification such as NVQ Level 3, City & Guilds or equivalent
  • Experience with RCVs or municipal vehicles would be a bonus.
  • Experience with tacho and wheel alignment as well as commercial vehicle repairs
  • A Class 2 licence would be preferred
  • A good understanding of Health & Safety a customer-focused approach

What's in it for you?

We think great people deserve great rewards.

You'll get:

  • £58,256.14 salary + up to £3,000 annual bonus
  • 33 days annual leave
  • Salary sacrifice pension and Death in Service benefit
  • OnDemand GP & face-to-face counselling; employee Assistance Programme & wellbeing support
  • Retail, leisure & holiday discounts in addition to dedicated training & development
  • Recommend a Friend bonus of up to £2,000
  • Free onsite parking and free uniform

Who are NRG Riverside?

We’re the UK’s largest municipal and specialist fleet hire company, providing specialist vehicles for short- and long-term hire, alongside vehicle maintenance and support package. We work with customers across the UK to keep their fleets moving, reduce vehicle downtime and support their operational needs.

But we're not just about vehicles, we're about our people.

Our culture is built around our PACER values:

Progressive | Authentic | Collaborative | Exemplary | Reputable

These values shape how we work, how we support our customers and, most importantly, how we work together as a team.

Not a traditional CV person?

We welcome applications in different formats — whether that's a traditional CV, video, photo application, or even something a little more creative.

If you're applying by video or photo, simply upload a Word document confirming you've sent your application and email your video/photo application to alexandra.bent@nrgriverside.com.

Please ensure your application demonstrates the skills and experience relevant to the role.

NRG Riverside has a recruitment process that is fair, inclusive and free from bias and we encourage our applicants to let us know if we can make it more user friendly for them. If our vacancies sound exciting, but your experience doesn’t 100% align, we still want to hear from you and would strongly encourage you to apply. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under anti discriminatory laws.

title: Beauty Expert
description:
Beauty Expert, Manchester Airport

Part Time (32 hours available)

About Charlotte Tilbury Beauty

Founded by British makeup artist and beauty entrepreneur Charlotte Tilbury MBE in 2013, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty has revolutionised the face of the global beauty industry by de-coding makeup applications for everyone, everywhere, with an easy-to-use, easy-to-choose, easy-to-gift range. Today, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty continues to break records across countries, channels, and categories and to scale at pace.

Over the last 10 years, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty has experienced exceptional growth and is one of the most talked about brands in the beauty industry and beyond. It has become a global sensation across 50 markets (and growing), with over 2,300 employees globally who are part of the Dream Team making the magic happen.

Today, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty is a truly global business, delivering market-leading growth, innovative retail and product launches fuelled by industry-leading tech — all with an internal culture of embracing challenges, disruptive thinking, winning together, and sharing the magic. The energy behind the bran­d is infectious, and as we grow, we are always looking for extraordinary talent who want to be part of this our success and help drive our limitless ambitions.

About the Role

  • You can work at a fast pace to achieve and exceed KPI’s. You feed on the buzz of achieving your goals and being the best, you can be. You do not want to meet expectation – you exceed it.
  • “Team work makes the dream work” – is your working motto. You understand your impact and how vital your role is. You can adapt to change at the last minute and be a real support to your managers and colleagues alike.
  • You champion the art of world-class artistry and an impeccable customer experience. You are a Charlotte Tilbury brand ambassador and want to pass on your knowledge to customer after customer. You live and breathe the Charlotte Tilbury makeup looks – and can recreate the magic of these on your customer, as well as offering advice and guidance. You pride yourself on knowing your customers are returning back to you.
  • You follow the company grooming standards to a tee – you know what good looks like and are not afraid to display this.

About You

  • You will ideally have had some experience as a Sales Advisor. Ideally this will be gained from a fast-paced environment such as beauty, retail or FMCG.
  • You aspire to be part of a beauty brand that disrupts the way it is seen – and continues to grow. You love all things Charlotte Tilbury – and are not afraid to spread the word.
  • Ideally you will have experience in applying makeup – and knowing how to adapt your style to different customers with different needs.
  • You champion positivity – and can think in a limitless way that makes your energy shine.
  • You are required to be flexible to work on a shift basis, including both early shifts and late shifts.
  • You will be required to give a five-year working and personal reference, along with a Criminal Reference Check as the store is airside in the departures lounge. This will be discussed in more detail at interview stage.

Why join us?

  • You can only be the best when you are set up to succeed – not only do we offer on the job training. We offer you the opportunity to attend Charlotte’s Magic Academy – where dreams are truly made. Combining art, commerce and Charlotte’s own values. You will feel truly empowered to live the magic in your role.
  • Opportunities to disrupt processes (in a positive way!) and have your voice truly heard.
  • The opportunity to be part of a company where we celebrate our achievements, and you are included. With a real scope for growth and progression to support your own development.
  • You receive exclusive launches of our incredible products before anyone else – not only that you even receive a full Charlotte Tilbury look once you pass your probation. (That is right all the products from one of our iconic looks)
  • We also offer an incredible staff discount, and access to Tilbury Treats – our very own rewards platform allowing you to save money and gain money cannot buy discounts on anything from gym memberships to cinema tickets.

At Charlotte Tilbury Beauty, our mission is to empower everybody in the world to be the most beautiful version of themselves. We celebrate and support this by encouraging and hiring people with diverse backgrounds, cultures, voices, beliefs, and perspectives into our growing global workforce. By doing so, we better serve our communities, customers, employees - and the candidates that take part in our recruitment process.

If you want to learn more about life at Charlotte Tilbury Beauty please follow our LinkedIn page!

title: IT-Infrastrukturtekniker
description:
Är du en erfaren Infrastrukturtekniker som trivs med att arbeta brett inom drift, server, virtualisering och modern IT-infrastruktur?

Tillsammans med vår kund söker vi nu en Infrastrukturtekniker som vill arbeta i en större och tekniskt bred IT-miljö. Här får du arbeta med både den dagliga driften och den fortsatta utvecklingen av infrastrukturen, med fokus på stabilitet, säkerhet och tillgänglighet.

Du blir en del av ett infrastrukturteam där du arbetar tillsammans med andra tekniker och specialister och får möjlighet att vara med och utveckla både tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt.

Om rollen:

Som Infrastrukturtekniker arbetar du med drift, förvaltning, felsökning och vidareutveckling av kundens IT-infrastruktur.

Miljön består av flera olika plattformar och tekniker, och rollen passar dig som har en bred infrastrukturbakgrund och tycker om att arbeta med hela kedjan, från operativ drift och felsökning till förbättringar, modernisering och teknisk utveckling.

Du kommer även att arbeta med mer komplexa incidenter och problem samt delta i projekt och förändringsinitiativ kopplade till infrastrukturen.

Arbetsuppgifter:



Drifta, administrera och vidareutveckla server- och infrastrukturmiljöer



Arbeta med Windows Server, Active Directory och Group Policy



Förvalta och utveckla virtualiserade miljöer



Felsöka komplexa problem inom server, nätverk och infrastruktur



Arbeta med behörigheter, patchning och säkerhetsrelaterade aktiviteter



Hantera incidenter, problem och förändringar



Delta i migreringar, uppgraderingar och andra infrastrukturprojekt



Arbeta med övervakning och proaktivt förbättringsarbete



Dokumentera tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt



Samarbeta med andra infrastrukturspecialister, supportteam och övriga delar av IT

Teknisk miljö:



Windows Server



Active Directory och Group Policy



VMware och andra virtualiseringsplattformar



Nätverk och nätverkstjänster



Microsoft Azure och hybridmiljöer



PowerShell och automation



Backup och återställning



Övervakning och loggning

Vem vi söker:

Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet av IT-infrastruktur och som är van vid att arbeta med drift och utveckling av större tekniska miljöer.

Du har en bred grund inom Windows Server, Active Directory, virtualisering och nätverk och känner dig trygg med att självständigt felsöka mer komplexa tekniska problem.

Vi ser gärna att du även har erfarenhet av automation och skriptning, exempelvis PowerShell, samt förståelse för hybrid- och molnmiljöer.

Det är också bra att ha erfarenhet av Linux och Open Source, även om det inte är rollens huvudsakliga fokus. Erfarenhet av exempelvis Nutanix, databaser eller andra infrastrukturella plattformar är också meriterande.

Du behöver inte ha arbetat med samtliga tekniker ovan. Det viktigaste är att du har en bred förståelse för IT-infrastruktur, är nyfiken på ny teknik och har lätt för att sätta dig in i nya miljöer.

Som person är du lösningsorienterad, strukturerad och ansvarstagande. Du trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra och tycker om att lösa tekniska problem samtidigt som du bidrar till att utveckla miljön framåt.

Rollen kräver mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Om CONSULTING it:

När du börjar hos oss som konsult på CONSULTING it blir du en del av vår gemenskap. Du får dessutom kollegor runt om i Sverige! Du har en dedikerad konsultchef som stöttar dig och din utveckling. Vi hjälper dig hitta nya vägar genom att prova på nya roller och nya branscher, för oss är det viktigt att du trivs på din arbetsplats. Vi ser till att du hamnar på ett bra bolag under ditt uppdrag och att uppdragen ligger i linje med hur du vill utvecklas framöver. Oavsett vad det blir, står vi bakom dig hela vägen – i ditt nästa, nästa och nästa steg. Gå med i vårt team och ta del av en spännande och utvecklande arbetsmiljö!

title: SAP S/4HANA Architect - ERP
description:
We are seeking a SAP S/4HANA Architect – ERP to design end-to-end architecture for SAP S/4HANA solutions, lead modernization initiatives, and drive the adoption of AI-powered engineering practices across mission-critical ERP implementations.

Responsibilities

  • Design the end-to-end architecture of SAP S/4HANA solutions, encompassing ERP modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, PM, QM, HCM) and SAP IS-U (Utilities), and document decisions and trade-offs
  • Define integration architecture spanning REST/OData APIs, IDocs, BAPIs, RFCs, SAP Integration Suite (CPI), and Event Mesh
  • Develop critical areas with the team, including ABAP/ABAP OO customizations and extensions in SAP BTP (CAP, RAP, Fiori Elements)
  • Ensure technical quality through ABAP code review, Clean Core standards, automated testing, HANA performance tuning, and observability with Cloud ALM
  • Lead modernization and migration efforts, including ECC to S/4HANA conversions and IS-U to S/4HANA Utilities migration
  • Apply AI to the development cycle through code assistants for ABAP (Joule, Copilot), test generation, and documentation
  • Design solutions with generative AI, including SAP Business AI, SAP AI Core/Launchpad, and RAG on master data
  • Evaluate AI-assisted engineering tools and estimate model and infrastructure costs
  • Participate in discovery and assessments to understand processes such as Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and IS-U billing cycle
  • Build POCs and demo environments in S/4HANA and BTP
  • Support the technical preparation of proposals and RFPs, including reference architecture, sizing, assumptions, and risks
  • Conduct technical presentations to engineering audiences and the board of directors

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields
  • 8+ years of experience in SAP projects with mission-critical implementations
  • 3+ years of experience in SAP solution architecture with decisions delivered to production
  • Knowledge of ERP modules including FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, PM/QM, PS, and HCM, with integrated functional and technical understanding
  • Background in SAP IS-U, including Facility structure, Device Management, Smart Metering/AMI, Billing, FICA, EDM, and integration with the energy market
  • Expertise in Advanced ABAP OO, CDS Views, AMDP, Enhancement Framework, and BAdIs
  • Proficiency in SAP HANA modeling, SQLScript, and optimization, along with Fiori/UI5 and SAP Build Apps
  • Familiarity with SAP BTP (CAP, RAP), Integration Suite, API Management, gCTS, and CI/CD for SAP
  • Skills in migration tools such as SAP Readiness Check, Custom Code Migration, LTMC, and Data Services
  • Understanding of SAP in the cloud, including RISE with SAP, BTP, and HANA Cloud, along with hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) for hybrid scenarios
  • Knowledge of SAP Security, including roles, authorizations, SoD, GRC, SAP IAS/IPS, OAuth2, and SAML
  • Intermediate/advanced English for documentation and global interaction

Nice to have

  • SAP S/4HANA or BTP Architect certification
  • Experience in ECC → S/4HANA conversion projects
  • Background in utilities with IS-U and Smart Metering
  • Knowledge of SAP Activate and agile methodologies

Benefits

  • Meal vouchers and food vouchers: Monthly benefits to cover your food expenses, both at home and away from home
  • Private Pension Plan: Planning for the future with supplementary contributions to your retirement
  • Benefits Package
  • Wellhub: Benefits and discounts at gyms and wellness programs
  • Childcare Assistance: Financial support for expenses related to early childhood education
  • Learning and professional growth
  • Development opportunities
  • Multicultural Collaboration
  • Referal Program

title: Forensic Fire Investigator - Charlotte
description:
Join Rimkus and unlock your potential with endless opportunities for growth, learning, and making a difference!

Rimkus ( is a worldwide leader in engineering and technical consulting. Rimkus experts specialize in building envelope engineering, forensic consulting, dispute resolution, construction management, and solutions for the environment.

NOW IS THE TIME to join this growing and stable company! We offer our full-time employees a competitive salary, bonus opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, disability, employer-matching 401(k), and advancement opportunities!

ALTHOUGH THIS POSITION IS REMOTE, YOU MUST RESIDE IN THE CHARLOTTE AREA

Requirements

OVERVIEW:

Investigates, assesses, and determines the origin and cause of fires and explosions in residences, commercial/industrial buildings, vehicles, heavy equipment, marine equipment, and other property. Analyzes fire/explosion scenes, burn patterns, debris, mechanical components, and electrical systems/components to determine the origin and cause. Conducts fraud analyses for possible incendiary-related losses. Prepares detailed written reports of findings that illustrate the investigation's conclusions/opinions, observations, and analysis. Works under general supervision, exercising initiative and independent judgment in performing assigned tasks.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Determines the origin and cause of fires and explosions involving structures, equipment, vehicles, heavy equipment, agricultural equipment, and other losses.
  • Assists in securing the fire/explosion scene to prevent removal or damage of potential evidence.
  • Conducts on-site, hands-on forensic fire analysis. This includes scene photography, interviewing witnesses and gathering information, taking possession of items, determining cause and origin, report preparation, and providing testimony at deposition and trial.
  • Searches for, identifies, collects, and labels any potential evidence/items from the fire scene, including devices used to set, start, or further the progress of the fire; protects the chain of custody of potential evidence/items.
  • Provides technical and scientific support to clients for subrogation and litigation purposes.
  • Conducts code compliance research, including electrical, gas, fire, building, and installation code violations.
  • Facilitates and helps present continuing education seminars on fire-related topics.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Physical Demands, Overtime, and Travel Requirements

  • Physical Demands—Work is performed both in an office setting and at outside locations (i.e., client's office, industrial, construction, and/or residential sites). The employee is frequently required to climb ladders, walk on roofs, and work in space-limited areas. Employees must wear a tight-fitting respirator during investigations. Employees may be required to shovel fire debris, move furniture and other household/commercial items, and operate lifts as needed. Employees may lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Employee must be sharp, focused, and alert when conducting site inspections, interacting with clients, preparing written reports of findings, and testifying in deposition or trial. Clear vision and depth perception are also necessary.
  • Overtime—This position is classified as salaried with a non-exempt FLSA status. There may be periods when overtime is required, and the employee must comply to meet the demands of the position.
  • Travel Requirements—This position requires up to 50% local travel. Some out-of-area and overnight travel may be required. Valid driver's license and reliable form of transportation.

At Rimkus, we value a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and respected. We are committed to creating a work environment that supports and celebrates the unique perspectives and experiences of all employees. If you share our commitment to diversity and inclusivity and are excited about joining a welcoming and supportive team, we encourage you to apply for our open positions.

Rimkus is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and will make all employment-related decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status

THIS JOB DESCRIPTION IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE AND DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A CONTRACT FOR EMPLOYMENT OR A GUARANTEE OF CONTINUED EMPLOYMENT.

Rimkus works with a limited number of approved recruiting partners. All agency submissions must be made through our designated submission process. Unsolicited resumes will not be recognized.

Requirements

-REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION, and CERTIFICATIONS:

  • IAAI-CFI certification preferred.
  • A minimum of NAFI-CFEI with the ability to obtain an IAAI-CFI within 18 months.
  • 5+ years of related work experience in fire investigation or a related field.
  • AAS in Fire Science, Fire Investigation, Forensic Science, or related experience as a fire investigator, firefighter, or law enforcement officer/investigator.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Must have a high level of analytical skills. Work requires continual attention to detail with the ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
  • Must be able to interact and communicate with clients at all levels (e.g., internal and external).
  • Must have knowledge of a variety of computer software applications, including but not limited to Microsoft Office applications and computer-assisted engineering and design software.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret standard scientific and technical reports, journals, financial reports, and legal documents.
  • Ability to write scopes of work clearly and coherently, budget estimates, schedules, reports of findings, proposals, general correspondence, and other technical documents.
  • Ability to respond to inquiries from internal and external clients.
  • Capable of effectively presenting information to top management, clients, public groups, and/or boards of directors.

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Short Term & Long Term Disability
  • Training & Development
  • Work From Home
