title: Chief Data Officer (CDO) — Insurance & Investments
description:
Job Summary

The Chief Data Officer (CDO) is responsible for the organization's enterprise-wide data strategy, governance, quality, analytics, AI, and data-driven transformation.

Within an Insurance & Investments organization, the CDO ensures that data is treated as a strategic asset across underwriting, claims, customer management, investment/asset management, risk, finance, compliance, and regulatory reporting.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute the enterprise data strategy and roadmap.

Establish enterprise-wide data governance, ownership, standards, policies, and controls.

Improve data quality, consistency, accuracy, availability, and accessibility.

Lead the organization's data management and data architecture strategy.

Establish data models, data platforms, data warehouses, data lakes, and data integration capabilities.

Lead Business Intelligence (BI), analytics, reporting, and advanced analytics.

Develop and oversee AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics initiatives.

Support data-driven decision-making across insurance, investments, finance, risk, and operations.

Establish data governance frameworks covering data privacy, security, lineage, classification, and access.

Partner with the CIO/CTO and technology teams on data platforms and architecture.

Support regulatory and management reporting through reliable and controlled data.

Develop data capabilities for underwriting, claims, pricing, fraud detection, customer analytics, and risk management.

Support investment teams with portfolio analytics, market data, performance reporting, and investment intelligence.

Establish data KPIs and monitor data quality and governance performance.

Lead data transformation and modernization initiatives.

Manage relationships with data, analytics, AI, and technology vendors.

Build and lead data, analytics, BI, governance, and data-science teams.

Promote an enterprise-wide data-driven culture.

Present data strategy, risks, opportunities, and transformation progress to executive leadership and the Board.

Ideal Candidate Profile

15+ years of progressive experience in data, analytics, technology, information management, or financial-services data.

5+ years in CDO, Chief Data Officer, Head of Data, Director of Data, Head of Analytics, or equivalent senior leadership positions.

Experience in insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, wealth management, or financial services preferred.

Strong expertise in:

Enterprise data strategy

Data governance

Data architecture

Data quality & master data

Business intelligence

Advanced analytics

AI / machine learning

Data privacy & security

Data management

Data integration

Regulatory data

Cloud data platforms

Strong understanding of financial-services data and regulatory requirements.

Experience managing enterprise data transformation programs and large multidisciplinary teams.

Strong C-suite, Board, and business stakeholder engagement.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Engineering, Business, or related discipline; master's degree/MBA preferred.

title: Logistics Site Coordinator
description:
Overview

Logistics Site Coordinator Shadwan Project - Ras Gharib

At Scatec, you get to work on something that matters. We develop, build, own, and operate renewable energy solutions that accelerate access to reliable and affordable clean energy. As part of a global and agile organisation, you will work with skilled colleagues across functions and geographies, take real ownership, and contribute to a company driven by the vision of improving our future. At the heart of everything we do is our belief that we bring the energy - the energy for change, connection, and growth. It shapes how we collaborate, innovate, and create impact together. If you are looking for a role where your contribution is visible, your development matters, and your work supports a more sustainable future, Scatec may be the right place for you.

Ready to make an impact?

Why this role matters

The Logistics Site Coordinator plays a critical role in ensuring the efficient flow, control, and availability of materials required for project execution. By maintaining accurate inventory records, coordinating material deliveries and issuance, and supporting logistics operations across the project site, this role helps ensure uninterrupted construction activities, compliance with project requirements, and effective cost control throughout the project lifecycle.

What you'll be doing

In this role, you will:

  • Coordinate the receipt, inspection, and documentation of materials, equipment, and containers arriving at the project site.
  • Prepare and maintain Material Receipt Notes (MRNs), Material Issue Notes (MINs), and all supporting logistics documentation.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records, material tracking logs, and stock reconciliation activities across the project site.
  • Monitor material issuance, consumption, transfers, returns, and storage locations to ensure visibility and accountability.
  • Coordinate deliveries and transportation activities with suppliers, contractors, warehouses, and project stakeholders.
  • Support construction teams by providing material status updates, inventory reports, and shortage or surplus alerts.
  • Prepare logistics, inventory, transportation, and material control reports for project management and supply chain teams.
  • Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, documentation requirements, and HSE regulations across all logistics activities.

Your work will support real decisions, real assets, and real operational outcomes.

What you'll gain

  • Professional growth through ownership, exposure, and meaningful contribution from day one.
  • Hands-on experience in a role where the challenge is energising, fast-moving, meaningful, and built on learning through doing.
  • Exposure to large-scale renewable energy construction projects and international supply chain operations.
  • Opportunity to work closely with project, construction, procurement, warehouse, and logistics teams across multiple functions.

What you'll bring

Experience and qualifications

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in logistics, warehouse operations, inventory control, material management, or site coordination.
  • Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience managing material receipt, issuance, inventory tracking, and stock reconciliation processes on construction or industrial projects.
  • Strong knowledge of logistics documentation, delivery records, transportation coordination, and inventory control systems.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, and experience using ERP or inventory management systems.
  • Fluent in English, spoken and written.

    What it’s like to work at Scatec

    At Scatec, we combine purpose with performance. We value responsibility, clarity, and collaboration and we encourage people to challenge existing ways of working, contribute ideas, and keep developing. You can expect an environment where people work together across disciplines and geographies, where good performance matters, and where you are trusted to take ownership without unnecessary hierarchy.

    If you are motivated by analysis with purpose, commercial insight, and real operational impact, this could be a strong next step in your career.

    What we offer

    At Scatec, you will be part of a company with a clear and ambitious purpose, working on renewable energy solutions that make a lasting difference. You will gain responsibility early, learn from experienced colleagues, and build your capabilities in a business that offers global exposure, strong development opportunities, and meaningful work in the energy transition. We are continuously evolving as a digital and data-driven organisation, leveraging technology and AI to improve how we work and create value for our teams

    Scatec is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit, competence, and business needs.

    We review applications on an ongoing basis.

title: Project Manager
description:
EPAM is delivering a multi-year cloud migration program for one of Greece's large enterprises, moving IT infrastructure from dozens of production sites into Google Cloud. We are looking for an On-site Project Manager to join the on-site discovery phase and lead technical discovery activities at client sites across Greece. The role combines hands-on project coordination, team leadership and stakeholder management.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the discovery team on-site: daily planning, task allocation, progress check-ins
  • Ensure the site discovery scope is completed according to defined standards and exit criteria
  • Own the site dossier and ensure its completeness before the team leaves the site
  • Act as the main point of contact for the client's site management during the visit
  • Plan and prepare each site visit with the client site owner, including scheduling, access, safety requirements, and stakeholder availability
  • Coordinate stakeholder interviews and validation of the site's IT landscape
  • Track and resolve on-site issues and risks, escalating to program management as needed
  • Hand over site findings to the assessment and planning team
  • Report site status and effort actuals to the Service Delivery Manager
  • Close the visit with the client site owner and contribute lessons learned to the discovery runbook

Requirements

  • 4+ years of project or delivery management experience in IT infrastructure, ideally within a migration or transformation program
  • Experience running on-site discovery, assessment, or audit activities; exposure to industrial or Operational Technology environments is an advantage
  • Ability to lead small technical teams on-site and represent EPAM to client site management
  • Working knowledge of infrastructure and application landscapes sufficient to coordinate discovery activities and validate findings
  • Strong documentation skills and disciplined execution against defined standards and exit criteria
  • Fluent in Greek and B2+ English
  • Willingness to travel regularly across Greece, including islands

Benefits

title: AI Enablement Lead
description:
About us

At Environment Bank, we’re working together to help restore natural habitats across England. With thousands of acres of new habitat creation already underway, our projects are delivering biodiversity gains and helping vital ecosystems to recover and flourish.

Our diverse team includes ecologists, land managers, habitat specialists, geospatial analysts, planning advisors, account managers, digital creatives, legal experts, and more.

From our habitat specialists to our sales and marketing teams, everyone at Environment Bank is a champion for our values, working towards our goal of reversing biodiversity loss.

Environment Bank is a market-leading organisation in a sector that’s experiencing rapid growth. We’ve already built a highly skilled team of experts and we’re actively looking to expand our team in the coming months.

We’re incredibly proud of all we achieved so far and we’re still growing. If you'd like to be part of a driven organisation that's making a real difference, find your next role with the team at Environment Bank.

About the role

At Environment Bank, we adopt AI, machine learning and automation to enhance our ability to restore nature at scale and to empower our people to work more efficiently and insightfully, always in a secure, sustainable, and responsible manner.

The AI Enablement Lead will drive real, practical value from AI tools and platforms across Environment Bank. You'll work with colleagues around the business to understand their process and workflows, and identify where AI, and alternative forms of automation, can genuinely improve efficiency, and collaboratively turn those opportunities into working solutions. The function of the role is to bring the right people together to agree which opportunities are worth pursuing, and giving teams ownership of the solutions, so AI capability grows across the business rather than sitting with one person. This includes training people to use AI tools responsibly, effectively and confidently, prototyping automations that eliminate repetitive work, and developing bespoke internal AI skills and tools, always in service of our core mission to restore nature at scale.

Based in our fully remote Data, Systems & GIS team, you'll be the go-to person for AI knowledge across the business, lead AI knowledge-sharing and a network of AI champions, stay current with platforms and capabilities, all while collaborating seamlessly across a distributed team. The role is remote-first, with travel to run workshops and work with teams in person.

Responsibilities

  • Champion the responsible use of AI across the business, staying current with relevant platforms, tools and capabilities so that every new adoption supports our mission to restore nature at scale
  • Develop and deliver training, guidance and documentation to help colleagues use AI tools effectively and efficiently in their roles
  • Lead structured discovery with teams to map how work is done and identify opportunities across the business where process automation and/or AI-powered tools could improve efficiency or reduce repetitive work, bringing the right people together to agree which are worth pursuing and giving teams ownership of the solutions
  • Maintain a prioritised pipeline of AI and automation opportunities, and report progress and value delivered to leadership
  • Collaboratively prototype and test new tools and approaches, assessing their suitability for development, and work with colleagues to turn those opportunities into working, implemented solutions
  • Enable colleagues to implement simple solutions themselves, and work with the Data, Systems & GIS team to scope, develop and build internal process automation tools and in take them into production
  • Create, maintain and update documentation for tools, processes and training materials
  • Build a network of AI champions and self-serve guidance so that day-to-day troubleshooting and technical queries relating to AI tools are handled within teams, stepping in on the harder cases
  • Establish sensible guardrails and best practices for responsible AI use, balancing productivity gains with data security, quality control and our duty of care to the nature recovery outcomes we deliver

Requirements

  • Desire to work at Environment Bank and be part of a team supporting colleagues working in nature recovery
  • Practical experience using LLM platforms (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) for real work tasks, not just casual use
  • Workflows automations and prototyping experience
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and mapping business processes, with audiences from frontline teams to senior leaders
  • Able to influence and align stakeholders without direct authority, including heads of department
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate a business need into a clear use case, priority and working solution
  • Confident communicator, comfortable explaining technical concepts to non-technical colleagues and running training sessions for a variety of audiences
  • Ability to work collaboratively and independently as part of a fully remote team
  • Self-starter with a curious mindset and a genuine enthusiasm for the environment, responsible AI and emerging technologies

Desirable

  • Experience within the environmental or ecology sector, with an passion for using technology to support nature restoration
  • Experience working with others to build and deploy standalone tools or apps
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects in a fast-paced environment
  • A background in helping people adopt new ways of working, through training, facilitation, agile coaching, service design, learning and development or change management
  • Experience setting up and connecting AI tools, e.g. building agentic workflows and/or configuring MCP servers
  • Experience with other platforms in our stack (e.g. HubSpot, ArcGIS, Snowflake), and comfortable getting hands-on with unfamiliar environments.

We recognise that women are less likely than men to apply for a role if they do not have experience in all the areas mentioned. The list above is indicative; we would still welcome your application even if you do not have experience in all the listed areas, but think that you could do the job.

Many of us hold back unless we can tick every box. Not because we lack ability, but because we have been conditioned to treat job descriptions as pass or fail criteria rather than a guide.

A gentle reminder for anyone who needs it:

𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗱𝗼 𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝗼 𝗺𝗲𝗲𝘁 𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘆 𝗿𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝘁𝗼 𝗯𝗲 𝗰𝗮𝗽𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲, 𝗰𝗿𝗲𝗱𝗶𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗼𝗿 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗱𝘆.

If you can do the core of the role and you are willing to learn the rest, you are already in the right place to apply.

Benefits

As an organisation, we believe that work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced, so we’re creating a space where our team can thrive, both personally and professionally – providing flexible working arrangements, mental wellbeing support, and more.

We offer...

🎁 Performance-based annual bonus up to 10% of salary

💸 Pension scheme with employer-matched contributions at 6% of salary

🏖️ 30 days of annual leave, plus paid bank holidays, birthday, and wellbeing day
➕ Option to purchase 5 additional days of annual leave after probation

🏡 Hybrid flexible working options
💼 Regional and departmental team co-working days

🌞 Expenses-paid whole company meet twice a year
🎗️ Team fundraising and charity events
🎓 Ongoing career development with training and mentoring

🧠 Employee assistance mental wellbeing support

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Java)

Senior Backend Engineer (Java)

title: Cliëntbegeleider | Karpaten 5 | 18 uur per week | Purmerend
description:
Ben jij die clientbegeleider met een gezonde dosis humor, die dat weet te combineren met de diverse zorgvraag binnen Karpaten 5? Dan is deze vacature iets voor jou! Bij Prinsenstichting maak je deel uit van een organisatie met lef! Hier pakken we een uitdaging met beide handen aan!

Wat ga je doen?
Op Karpaten 5 wonen momenteel zeven cliënten; 3 vrouwen en 4 mannen in de leeftijd van 38 tot 72 jaar. Zij functioneren op laag-midden niveau maar zijn, met ondersteuning, toch redelijk zelfstandig. Twee cliënten maken gebruik van een rolstoel maar zijn ondanks dat ook zelfredzaam. Twee cliënten wonen zelfstandig binnen een appartement aanleunend welke wij begeleiden en ondersteunen. Hun appartement is dicht bij de groep gesitueerd. De meeste cliënten hebben i.v.m. hun autistische vorm van gedrag een grote behoefte aan zekerheid en duidelijkheid. Jij als begeleider bent daarbij de belangrijkste factor, jij biedt hun deze veiligheid. Tevens zijn sfeer, gezelligheid en harmonie belangrijk binnen deze groep.

De cliënten zijn in beperkte mate zelfredzaam en dienen in meer of mindere mate geholpen en/of gestimuleerd te worden bij de ADL zorg. Binnen Karpaten 5 ligt de nadruk bij het behouden van een bepaalde mate van zelfstandigheid en minder bij de ontwikkeling hiervan. Ook moet je als begeleider rekening houden met het ouder worden van deze cliënten waarbij andere problematiek (zoals bijvoorbeeld dementie) een rol speelt. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor huishoudelijke taken zoals het verzorgen van de was en de maaltijden.

Hoe pas je in het team?
Als Cliëntbegeleider houd je bezig met de begeleiding en ondersteuning en/of verzorging/verpleging van de cliënten m.b.t. de individuele zorg/ behandelvraag (conform het ondersteuningsplan). Je ondersteunt en begeleidt de doelgroep (en verwanten) in de ADL en de specifieke zorg/ begeleidingsvraagstukken. Je werkt in teamverband samen. Het is belangrijk dat jij volgens de methode van "Gentle Teaching” werkt. Je hebt passie en ervaring in het werken met onze doelgroep. Je bent positief ingesteld, bent stabiel en maakt er elke dag het beste van!

Daarnaast is het belangrijk dat jij;

  • een afgeronde relevante opleiding hebt op mbo-niveau 3;

  • beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel professioneel als binnen de driehoek van zorg;

  • in staat bent continuïteit en kwaliteit van zorg te waarborgen en te bewaken;

  • flexibel bent in werktijden. Er wordt gewerkt in dagdiensten en late diensten.

Wat bieden wij?
Bij Prinsenstichting krijg jij de kans om te groeien als persoon. Een loopbaan lang! Jij wordt bij Prinsenstichting gezien en gewaardeerd. Bovendien heb je binnen zelforganisatie volop ruimte om initiatief te nemen. Jouw persoonlijkheid en ervaring zijn van waarde om samen het verschil te maken.

Daarnaast ontvang je:

  • Veel waardering van onze mooie doelgroep;

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling (o.a. door scholing en toegang tot een breed aanbod aan veelzijdige e-learnings);

  • Als Regiebegeleider een bruto maandsalaris van minimaal € 2.597,00 en maximaal € 3.635,00 op basis van 36 uur (FWG 35 CAO gehandicaptenzorg);

  • CAO-verhoging van 2% inde maand november;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling, vakantiegeld 8%, collectieve verzekeringen en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%;

  • 144 vakantie-uren en 57 uur balansverlof per kalenderjaar op basis van 36 uur;

  • Een leuke werkplek in zelf organiserend team met enthousiaste, betrokken collega’s;

  • Een onboardingsweek voor een vliegende start!

Enthousiast?
Voor inlichtingen over deze functie neem je contact op met het team van Karpaten 5, via 06-12331353. Zij vertellen jou graag meer!

Solliciteren:
Ben jij op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging in de zorg? Wacht niet langer en klik hier om direct te solliciteren.

title: Project Administrator / Language Assistant
description:
The role:

We are seeking a Project Administrator / Language Assistant to join our project team in Kyiv. The post is dual-hatted. You will run the administration and document control of the project management office, and you will provide the Ukrainian and English interpretation and translation the project depends on.

The project is the reconstruction of an existing medical building in Kyiv, delivered for an international donor through a Ukrainian construction sub-contractor, with Ukrainian state bodies approving and accepting the works. The site stays in clinical use throughout.

You will report to the Project Manager, with a functional line to the PMO Lead on document and reporting standards. You will work closely with the Liaison Officer, the Procurement Officer and the Clerk of Works.

The project runs in two languages and under two legal systems. Construction records, site journals and statutory documents are kept in Ukrainian; reporting to our customer is in English. Much of what the project has to prove at the end is proved by documents, and the timeliness of what the office produces is scored against contractual deadlines. That is why the post exists, and why accuracy carries as much weight here as speed.

Requirements

Responsibilities/ deliverables:

Additional tasks may emerge, but primary responsibilities will include:

Meetings and reporting

  • Run the secretariat for every project meeting: scheduling, invitations, papers, minute-taking and action tracking. The meeting pack is issued five working days before each monthly progress meeting and minutes within two working days of the meeting. These are contractual deadlines and our performance against them is measured and reported.
  • Maintain the joint action list continuously, issue it ahead of each meeting and reissue the updated version afterwards.
  • Prepare the inputs to the monthly progress report and the weekly update pack, and hold the internal cut-off that protects the external deadline.

Project controls and records

  • Maintain the schedule and progress-tracking data, and enter and reconcile cost and change data.
  • Keep the correspondence, action and risk registers current in support of the PMO Lead.
  • Run filing and version control in a single controlled information environment, so that every document can be traced to its issue and its change from the previous version is identifiable.
  • Support the compilation of payment milestone evidence and the build-up of the acceptance documentation set.
  • Flag data or record discrepancies to the PMO Lead and the Project Manager, and hold back circulation of any report or register that falls short of the document control standard until it is corrected.

Interpretation and translation

  • Provide live interpretation at meetings, site visits and stakeholder engagements, including with the Ukrainian client body, the designer, the technical supervisor, the sub-contractor and the site command.
  • Produce accurate written translation of technical, safety and contractual documents in both directions, using the correct Ukrainian construction terminology.
  • Check that every translated notice or record faithfully reflects the original before it is issued, and raise any ambiguity or risk of mistranslation before the document goes out.
  • Redact addresses and location-specific information from documents before they are submitted, where the contract requires it.
  • Identify where a certified or notarised translation is needed rather than a working one, and arrange it. Where a text falls outside your competence to certify, say so and refer it.
  • Record translation time and maintain the monthly summary of translation charges reported to our customer.

Support to the wider team

  • Support the Liaison Officer with personnel notifications, site access requests and correspondence with local authorities and the sub-contractor, including the rolling three-week access forecast.
  • Maintain the personnel records our customer requires, handling personal data under the contract’s data protection terms.
  • Provide general office administration: onboarding of new team members, correspondence, invoices and expenses, and travel and logistics arrangements for the team and for visiting staff.

You:

You will have previous experience and qualifications in the following areas:

  • Proven experience in office administration or project support, preferably in a construction, engineering or infrastructure environment.
  • Demonstrable experience of live interpretation and of written translation between Ukrainian and English, ideally in a technical or construction setting.
  • Higher education (Bachelor’s, Master’s or Specialist Degree) in translation, philology, linguistics, international relations, business administration, construction or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong command of construction and contractual vocabulary in both languages, and the judgement to know when a literal translation would mislead.
  • Excellent accuracy and attention to detail in record keeping, with the organisation to carry several fixed deadlines at once.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook, and in document management through SharePoint and Teams.
  • Familiarity with Ukrainian construction documentation is a strong advantage: acts of hidden works, executive documentation, material and equipment passports, and the site journals.

Other requirements:

You will also meet the following essential requirements, and may meet some or all of the following desirable requirements:

  • Essential – Based in Kyiv, with regular attendance at the project site and at meetings with Ukrainian stakeholders.
  • Essential – Fluent Ukrainian and fluent English, written and spoken. The statutory records are kept in Ukrainian and reporting to our customer is in English.
  • Essential – Able to provide a clean criminal record certificate issued by the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Ukraine.
  • Essential – A valid military registration document, produced at the point of offer as Ukrainian law requires.
  • Essential – Able to handle sensitive material appropriately. Project information carries a protective marking and is handled under the customer’s security and data protection terms, which we will brief you on.
  • Desirable – Experience of donor-funded, international or government-funded projects.
  • Desirable – Experience of preparing or submitting documentation to Ukrainian state bodies.
  • Desirable – A translation or interpreting qualification, or evidence of continuous professional development in translation.
  • Desirable – Experience of project controls or scheduling software, including Microsoft Project.

The appointment:

This is a fixed-term appointment tied to the project, employed in Ukraine by Prevail Consulting LLC. The core term runs for around 24 months from contract award, with two further six-month options that our customer may exercise. The start date is contract award, expected in October 2026, and conditional offers will be made before then.

The post is mobilised on day one. The heaviest administrative load falls in the first 30 days, when the management plans, the registers and the reporting templates are all due together, so we are looking for someone who can work at pace from the start and who will stay with the project through to handover.

Us:

Prevail Advisory Services delivers high quality construction project management, risk management, intelligence, research and consultancy services to clients ranging from governments and multinational corporations to non-governmental organisations. These services are delivered predominantly across Europe, the Middle East and Africa.

We pride ourselves on selecting interesting projects which we believe can genuinely make a difference. You will be joining the company at a time of continued growth and may be required to support a wide variety of these projects across the whole company.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • At Prevail, we believe in recognising and rewarding our people. Our benefits are designed to support your wellbeing, development, and life beyond work:
  • Voluntary Medical Insurance:
  • Employee Assistance Programme (EAP): Confidential mental health, legal, financial and wellbeing support via Health Hero
  • 25 days Leave Entitlements: Supporting you through important life moments with flexibility
  • Professional Development Days: Dedicated time off to focus on your personal and professional growth through training, courses, or self-directed learning
  • Culture & Development: A values-led culture with regular social events, collaborative initiatives, and meaningful opportunities for personal and professional development

description:
We are seeking an SAP Joule & Multi-Agent Integration Engineer to drive the architecture and implementation of the agentic AI roadmap. In this role, you will design, build, and secure cross-platform agent networks that integrate SAP’s Joule ecosystem with ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms using open agent communication protocols. You will oversee the complete lifecycle of agent development, ranging from SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) provisioning to production-grade Agent-to-Agent (A2A) orchestration.

Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy pro-code AI agents on SAP BTP (Cloud Foundry/Kyma) using Joule Studio, LangGraph, or SAP Cloud SDK for AI — defining agent tools, orchestration logic, and backend integrations against S/4HANA OData APIs (Orders, Quotes, Contracts, Accounts) via BTP Destination Service
  • Architect and implement end-to-end A2A communication between SAP Joule and the ServiceNow platform — exposing Joule agents as A2A-compliant servers via SAP Agent Gateway, authoring Agent Cards, configuring JSON-RPC endpoints, and registering External Agent Providers in ServiceNow AI Agent Studio over Google A2A protocol v0.3.0
  • Design primary/secondary agent delegation patterns, async push notification flows, and timeout-resilient pipelines across SAP and non-SAP agent networks — ensuring agents reason, delegate, and recover reliably at enterprise scale
  • Configure end-to-end authentication across agent boundaries using OAuth2, SAP IAS App2App trust, and BTP Cloud Identity Services — enforcing least-privilege access, token governance, and audit-ready agent call chains
  • Own the full SAP BTP stack underpinning agent workloads — AI Core provisioning, SAP Build Process Automation entitlements, Cloud Foundry runtime, Destination Service, and SAP Agent Gateway configuration
  • Instrument agent pipelines with structured logging, distributed tracing, and alerting so failures are caught early, root-caused quickly, and prevented systematically across multi-hop agent calls

Requirements

  • 4+ years of hands-on SAP BTP engineering experience including Cloud Foundry, SAP Cloud Identity Services, and Destination Service configuration
  • Proven experience building and deploying custom Joule agents in Joule Studio (pro-code path) with tool definitions wired to SAP backend systems via OData or REST APIs
  • Demonstrated production experience enabling Agent-to-Agent (A2A) integration between SAP Joule and ServiceNow AI Agent Studio — including Agent Card authoring, External Agent Provider registration, credential aliasing, and A2A protocol handshake validation
  • Strong command of agentic AI frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent) and multi-agent orchestration patterns including delegation, fallback, and async response handling
  • Solid understanding of API security and authentication: OAuth 2.0, mutual TLS, SAP IAS trust configurations, and BTP service bindings
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow platform internals — Now Assist AI Agents, Integration Hub, Flow Designer, and Connection & Credential Aliases
  • Strong grasp of distributed systems design, API performance, and fault-tolerance patterns relevant to multi-agent pipelines
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex agent topology designs for both engineering and business audiences

Nice to have

  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) alongside A2A for tool and resource exposure across agent boundaries
  • Exposure to SAP BRIM, SOM, or BTP Integration Suite (CPI) for SAP business process integration context
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow Yokohama/Zurich release features for external agent interoperability
  • SAP BTP or ServiceNow certifications (Certified Application Developer, Certified Implementation Specialist)
  • CI/CD experience for BTP workloads using Cloud Foundry CLI, MTA deployment, or GitHub Actions pipelines

Benefits

  • Global scope, international projects

EPAM's Data & AI Practice is hiring a Manager / Senior Manager, AI & Data Consulting to help our customers craft Analytics and AI strategies, design best-in-class Data & AI platforms, and lead the AI-driven transformation of their enterprises. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with industry leaders, translating cutting-edge capabilities (GenAI, agentic systems, ML, advanced analytics) into products that move the needle. We're passionate about delivering measurable value from data and AI, and we're looking for people who share that mindset.

What makes this role different: you won't just advise — you'll own outcomes, shape product strategy at the senior stakeholder level, build and lead high-caliber teams, and have direct influence on how some of the world's largest companies adopt AI responsibly and effectively.

Responsibilities

  • Engage with customer business stakeholders to discover data, analytics, and AI opportunities — from platform to analytics to GenAI and agentic use cases

  • Act as a data and AI advocate, removing business, technical and organizational roadblocks
  • Mentor and coach clients and team members on data, analytics, and AI product best practices
  • Partner with account managers to build, grow, and retain strategic customer relationships
  • Work with the business development team on proposals and pitches, including AI-focused opportunities

Requirements

  • 3+ years in product, delivery, consulting, or presales roles
  • Preferred: 5+ years in one of our core industries (Life Sciences, CPG & Retail, Energy & Utilities, Financial Services, Automotive), or a track record of working with clients in those sectors
  • Demonstrated experience managing data products for enterprises — including data platforms, data warehouses, data lakes, BI, and advanced analytics solutions — across the full product lifecycle
  • Familiarity with designing AI products for probabilistic, non-deterministic outputs and setting user expectations accordingly
  • Proficiency in defining evaluation strategies (offline and online), benchmarks, and quality metrics for ML and GenAI systems, including translation to business meaningful metrics
  • Skill in overseeing the model lifecycle (data → training/fine-tuning → evaluation → deployment → monitoring → retraining)
  • Track record of scoping and shipping GenAI use cases (RAG, agents, copilots, summarization, extraction) with clear awareness of cost, latency, and accuracy trade-offs
  • Working knowledge of responsible AI principles — bias mitigation, explainability, human-in-the-loop, governance, and regulatory considerations
  • Experience managing prompt engineering, evaluation harnesses, and continuous improvement loops as first-class product activities
  • Familiarity with the modern AI stack and ecosystem (foundation models, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, MLOps/LLMOps tooling, evaluation platforms)
  • Ability to facilitate and drive strategy discussions at executive level, including value articulation and tracking of value realization
  • Experience working with end-users driving product design, running UATs, and facilitating and measuring adoption
  • Ability to participate in and influence solution and AI architecture design discussions
  • Solid knowledge of the data, analytics, and AI landscape and recent trends
  • Experience in end-to-end project delivery as part of the team: Cloud Data Platforms, BI/Reporting, Data Catalog / Marketplace, Analytics Migration & Modernization, Predictive Analytics & ML, Generative AI, and Agentic Systems
  • Practical experience designing human-in-the-loop review into production AI systems, including the trade-off between oversight coverage and operational cost
  • Exposure to complex multi-market or cross-domain products and programs
  • Track record of leading project teams of 10+ individuals
  • Excellent communication skills and dynamic presenter — equally comfortable with technical depth and executive narratives
  • Ability to manage customer expectations, present and explain project deliverables to senior stakeholders, and have honest conversations about what AI can and can't do
  • Ability to frame a presales opportunity into a customer engagement
  • A genuine passion for the Data & AI space and a track record of staying ahead of the curve
  • A growth mindset — eager to learn, experiment, and expand your comfort zone as the AI landscape evolves

title: Go-to-market Lead - Avon.AI
description:
About Pagaya

Shape the Future of Finance

Pagaya is building a leading artificial intelligence network to help our partners grow their businesses and better serve their customers.

Pagaya is a global technology company making life-changing financial products and services available to more people nationwide, as it reshapes the financial services ecosystem. By using machine learning, a vast data network and a sophisticated AI-driven approach, Pagaya provides comprehensive consumer credit and residential real estate solutions for its partners, their customers, and investors. Its proprietary API and capital solutions integrate into its network of partners to deliver seamless user experiences and greater access to the mainstream economy. Pagaya has offices in New York and Tel Aviv. For more information, visit .

Let's create better outcomes together!

About Avon AI

Avon AI was recently acquired by Pagaya, which backs our growth. Avon AI is the management and control platform for enterprise conversational AI. Enterprises are deploying AI agents faster than they can govern them. Avon AI gives them one place to manage those agents and the knowledge behind them: continuous quality monitoring of real conversations, proactive testing and simulation before changes ship, knowledge-base management, and real-time guardrails that sit inline in the conversation path to block, redact, or correct what an agent says.

We are agent-agnostic. Avon AI works with agents our customers built themselves and with third-party agents they only integrate with, across any framework or vendor. Customers run us as SaaS on AWS or deploy the full platform inside their own private cloud when regulation demands it. We are a small, fast-moving team based in Tel Aviv, already deployed at banks and insurers, and working with enterprise customers in finance, healthcare, insurance, travel, and more.

About the role

You will be one of the first hires in our sales and marketing organization and our first person on the ground in the US. This is a player-coach role: you carry a quota and close enterprise deals yourself, and as the pipeline grows you help build the US team around you.

You own the go-to-market motion end to end: generating demand, finding the champion inside a large regulated organization, mapping the stakeholders, running a complex sales process, and getting to a signed contract. You will work directly with the founders and have real influence over how we sell, what we say, and who we hire next.

What you will do

Sales

  • Own the full sales cycle with enterprise accounts in the US, from first conversation to closed deal, with a focus on banks, insurers, and other regulated companies.
  • Identify champions, map buying committees (business, risk, IT, procurement), and run multi-threaded processes that reach sign-off.
  • Run discovery and demos, scope pilots on the customer's real production conversations, and convert pilots into production contracts.
  • Manage the pipeline in the CRM with accurate forecasting.

Marketing and demand generation

  • Build the top of the funnel: outbound campaigns, events, webinars, partner referrals, and content.
  • Work with partners and resellers, including consulting firms and the AWS Marketplace, to source and accelerate deals.
  • Sharpen our positioning and messaging for the US market based on what you hear from buyers.

Build the organization

  • Define the sales process, playbook, and qualification criteria we will scale with.
  • Help recruit and onboard the next sales and marketing hires as the US business grows.
  • Feed structured customer and market input back to the product team.

What we are looking for

  • A US-based seller with a track record of closing enterprise software deals with large organizations, ideally in regulated industries such as banking, insurance, or healthcare.
  • Experience selling into financial companies is a strong advantage.
  • Startup background: you have sold an early-stage product without a large brand behind you and are comfortable building from little.
  • "Full stack" go-to-market: you can prospect, run marketing activities, present to executives, and negotiate contracts yourself.
  • Comfortable with technical products. You can explain AI agents, quality monitoring, and deployment options (SaaS and private cloud) credibly to both business and IT buyers.
  • Self-directed and structured: you set your own priorities, build process where none exists, and report clearly.
  • A connection to Israel, or experience working with an Israeli headquarters, is a plus.

Why join

  • A real product with paying enterprise customers in production, not a pitch deck.
  • The chance to own a market: you define how Avon AI sells in the US and build the team that follows.
  • Direct work with the founders and a short line between customer feedback and product decisions.

Location & Engagement: Our primary preference is a full-time role based out of our NYC office (Monday-Thursday), collaborating with the team in Tel Aviv.

The pay ranges for New York-based hires are commensurate with candidate experience.

Pay ranges for candidates working in locations other than New York may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.

Compensation Range for New York Based Hires
$135,000—$155,000 USD

Our Team

Pagaya was founded in 2016 by seasoned research, finance, and technology entrepreneurs with our head quarters located in NYC and Tel Aviv.

We move fast and smart, identifying new opportunities and building end-to-end solutions from AI models and unique data sources. Every Pagaya team member is solving new and exciting challenges every day in a culture based on partnership, collaboration, and community.

Join a team of builders who are working every day to enable better outcomes for our partners and their customers.

Our Values

  • Continuously Learn- We challenge ourselves for the sake of getting better as individuals, as teams, and as an organization to deliver for our partners.
  • Debate and Commit- We respectfully and openly debate to strengthen our ideas and build shared conviction - once we decide, we go all in, together.
  • Dream Big and Act- We boldly tackle complex problems, pressure-test solutions in real-time, and adapt with speed and energy.
  • Advance Inclusion- We create a world where everyone can win, designing systems that better represent people and generate sustainable value for our employees, partners and investors.
  • Be Accountable Together- We proudly own our actions and our results, taking initiative to ensure our work gets over the finish line as a team.

More than just a job

We believe health, happiness, and productivity go hand-in-hand. That's why we're continually looking to enhance the ways we support you with benefits programs and perks that allow every Pagayan to do the best work of their life.

title: State Engagement Officer - Karnataka
description:
Job Description

Purpose

The incumbent will have the responsibility for delivering the program management of the schemes and initiatives of National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) & Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (MSDE), Government of India, in the respective State. In addition, the incumbent will be responsible for business development, organizational development, representation, and talent management in the allocated State.


Key Responsibilities

1. Programme Implementation & State Coordination

1.1 Support implementation of MSDE/NSDC projects/schemes (PMKVY-CSCM, Apprenticeship, PMVK) in the State.

1.2 Coordinate with the State Skill Mission on various matters on behalf of MSDE.

1.3 Undertake monitoring visits to Training Centres, review workshops/meetings, capacity building of Training Partners (TPs), and handholding support.

1.4 Organize workshops as required by Scheme PMU teams and conduct review workshops/meetings to improve implementation of schemes in the State.

1.5 Provide SIP and process-related support to local TPs/Training Centres (TCs) and State PMUs.

1.6 Facilitate resolution of IT, operational, and systemic issues.

1.7 Coordinate with Sector Skill Councils (SSCs) and District Administration/District Skill Committees.

2. Implementation of Central & State Skill Development Schemes

2.1 Support the State in implementation of Central Skill Training Schemes such as PMKVY-CSSM, STRIVE, SANKALP, and other State-funded schemes.

2.2 Build the capacity of the State Skill Development Mission and other relevant departments on new policies, developments, programmes, and other related initiatives of MSDE/NSDC.

2.3 Support State PMUs on IT/SIP and scheme guidelines.

2.4 Participate in monthly/weekly review workshops/meetings of State TPs.

2.5 Participate in capacity-building workshops for SSDMs and District PMUs and organize workshops as required by SSDMs.

2.6 Facilitate resolution of operational and systemic issues.

2.7 Coordinate with SSCs for assessment, certification, and Qualification Pack (QP)-related issues.

2.8 Undertake monitoring visits to Training Centres as and when required by the State Mission.

2.9 Provide thematic support to the State in the conduct of State Skill Competitions.

3. Business Development & New Opportunities

3.1 Identify suitable business opportunities in the State, across both public and private domains, for implementation of skill development and related programmes.

3.2 Support NSDC in identifying corporates willing to pool funds for skill development activities under Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) or other available models.

3.3 Promote Apprenticeship programmes through industry and corporate connect/collaboration.

3.4 Support industry connect, NAPS Portal handholding, regular monitoring, and TPA recommendations.

3.5 Undertake outreach and capacity building of SSDMs, Directorate of Industries, and other relevant State departments related to NAPS.

3.6 Support onboarding of new establishments and BTP/TPA recommendations.

3.7 Connect with industries, MSMEs, and potential employers for registration on NAPS/ASSEM and participation in Rozgar Melas, etc.

3.8 Establish linkages with regional chapters of industry associations in the State.

4. Promotion of NSDC International Initiatives

4.1 Create awareness and conduct capacity-building sessions for relevant stakeholders in the State.

4.2 Facilitate candidate registration and counselling.

4.3 Coordinate with PMU, NSDC International, and the State Skill Development Mission as required.

5. Capacity Building of Training Partners / Academic Institutions

5.1 Build the capacity of TPs/Academic Institutions (AIs) on new developments, IT portals, guidelines, and related processes of skill development programmes.

5.2 Design TP performance review mechanisms and FAQs to address queries of Training Partners.

5.3 Conduct weekly meetings to review TP performance and address issues related to payments, assessment, certification, placements, etc.

6. Citizen Engagement Activities

6.1 Facilitate mobilisation of potential candidates for skill development schemes, RPL, etc., through active engagement with SSDM, TPs, SSCs, District Skill Committees, and other stakeholders.

6.2 Design quarterly plans/calendars for mobilisation camps, Kaushal Melas, Rozgar Melas, etc.

6.3 Conduct mobilisation camps and Kaushal Melas involving private Training Partners, State Government, and Sector Skill Councils.

6.4 Represent NSDC in Kaushal Melas, Rozgar Melas, and similar events in the State.

6.5 Explore potential areas of collaboration for NSDC in such events.

6.6 Track and share reports of Rozgar Melas/Kaushal Melas conducted by PMKVY/PMKK/Fee-based Model TPs, SSCs, and State Skill Development Missions in the State.

7. India Skills, Regional Skills & State-Sponsored Events

7.1 Facilitate conduct of Regional Skills Competitions, Rozgar Melas, and State-level events by extending necessary support.

7.2 Support skill development events, including workshops, seminars, exhibitions, etc., conducted in the respective State.

7.3 Explore potential areas of collaboration for NSDC in State-sponsored events.

7.4 Track and share reports of events conducted by PMKVY/PMKK/Fee-based Model TPs, SSCs, and State Skill Development Missions.

7.5 Ensure adoption of manuals and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) in the conduct of events.

8. Reporting to Standing / Consultative Committees & MPs

8.1 Design templates for reporting scheme progress and other related activities.

8.2 Establish communication and connect with members of Standing Committees (SC) and Consultative Committees (CC) in the respective State.

9. State Performance, Best Practices & Reporting

9.1 Track the performance of SSDMs and the progress of their skill development programmes and other Ministry schemes in the State.

9.2 Design formats to capture the progress of State skill development schemes, skilling activities, best practices, events, etc.

9.3 Capture the monthly progress of State Skill Development Schemes of SSDMs, skill development schemes of other Ministries, and best practices being followed in the State.

9.4 Report a minimum of 4–5 news items monthly, including events, success stories, and inaugurations of centres in the State.

10. Operational Support – IISC, CSR, Special Projects & Other Programmes

10.1 Provide operational support to IISC, Special Projects, CSR Skilling Programmes, Market-Led Programmes, and other skilling initiatives.

10.2 Identify corporates willing to provide funds for skilling under CSR.

10.3 Generate leads for funding/no-funding partnership models.

10.4 Identify Training Partners involved in overseas placement support.

Knowledge and Experience

Education Qualifications

Post Graduate Degree in Social Sciences or MBA from a reputed institute.

  • Minimum 7+ years of experience working on skill development and livelihood programmes, with a focus on skilling and entrepreneurship in the private sector/social enterprises, with demonstrated ability to foster partnerships and work with multiple stakeholders.

  • Willingness to travel extensively to and within project locations.

  • Integrity
  • Accountability

title: Citrix Engineer
description:
Citrix Engineering and Administration: performing engineering and day-to-day Citrix Administration tasks for Citrix solutions including: Citrix CVAD, Citrix Provisioning Services, Citrix Workspace Environment Management. The following tasks are to be performed:

  • Citrix server deployment: installing, configuring, patching, upgrading Citrix infrastructure systems, delivery servers and Citrix databases.
  • Citrix administration in Virtualized environments: Citrix CVAD, PVS and WEM administration in virtual environments, e.g. VMWare, and virtual machine administration of operating systems underlying Citrix solutions.
  • Security management: Enforce data security and data protection policies by managing security and solution access, identifying and auditing user access of sensitive solutions in compliance with procedures and regulations.
  • Incident management: follow structured processes for rapidly detecting, diagnosing, and resolving service disruptions to restore availability and ensure data integrity. Manage incidents using ITSM tools, e.g. ServiceNow
  • Change and Release management: follow controlled processes for planning and validation for deploying releases of new Citrix systems or changes to existing Citrix solutions into (pre-)production environments, minimizing downtime and preventing data loss.
  • Health monitoring: defining, gathering, managing metrics for monitoring Citrix solutions, operating systems and servers to ensure systems remain healthy; checking error logs, system events, database events, disk space and storage events use monitoring tools including SCOM to identify, prevent and resolve issues.
  • Citrix Solution maintenance: installing, configuring, scheduling, monitoring Citrix infrastructure.
  • Backup and recovery: define, create, schedule Citrix solution backup plans and strategy, ensure restorability, integrate Operating System-level backup systems like NetBackup, manage Data Retention.
  • Performance monitoring, tuning, and optimization: define and gather critical performance metrics for Citrix and OS to ensure correct solution performance.
  • Business Continuity: ensure to meet SLAs by configuring High Availability & Disaster Recovery, defining, implementing, configuring, monitoring technologies including SCOM and Citrix Infra Monitoring.
  • DevOps: define, create, implement DevOps pipelines for deploying Citrix configuration changes into production using Puppet, AzureDevops, FlyWay.
  • Automation: define, implement, schedule, monitor scripts for automation of repetitive, recurring tasks using Bash, Puppet, Python, Powershell, etc.
  • Data modelling: design, reverse engineer, document conceptual Citrix solutions and models, defining and updating standard operating procedures.
  • Change management: implement Citrix solution Changes and Releases into production and other environments, in compliance with standards and procedures.

  • Communication: communicate opposing views to stakeholders and facilitate compromise solutions, display and enable teamwork.
  • Training and Knowledge Transfer: Provide technical training or knowledge transfer to internal teams, ensuring smooth handovers and self-sufficiency in routine tasks.

  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in Citrix environments.
  1. Proven track record of configuring and optimizing Citrix components (Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, Director, Citrix Gateway).
  2. Proven track record monitoring and analytics tools (Citrix Director).
  3. Proven track record of securing Citrix environments using best practices and assessing current infrastructure in order to identify optimization opportunities.
  4. Proven track record of implementing CVAD / PVS deployments or upgrades.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in the installation, implementation and configuration of Server Operating Systems (MS Windows and/or Linux) in physical or virtual format, including the interaction with Infrastructure at large (File shares with CIFS/SMB and NFS, secure LDAP integration, Public Key Certificates, Service accounts, API’s, etc.).
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in adapting Infrastructure Designs, applying/devising Security hardening for each layer of the solution (hardware/devices, Operating System, Applications/middleware), including leveraging well known frameworks (e.g., CIS guidelines), including the troubleshooting needed due to the consequences of hardening.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience with documenting technical specifications of solutions, in terms of infrastructure design material (deployment views, server and network specifications, etc.) as well as devising and documenting operational procedures.
  • Good knowledge of implementing new CVAD / PVS deployments or upgrades.
  • Knowledge of integrating PVS with hypervisors (VMware vSphere).
  • Good knowledge of managing delivery controllers, StoreFront, Director and
  • Integrating Citrix with identity providers.
  • Good knowledge of securing Citrix environments using best practices and assessing current infrastructure in order to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Good knowledge in creating Technical Designs (both at a High Level and at a Detailed level) leading to actual implementation.
  • Good knowledge of installation, implementation and configuration of Server Operating Systems (MS Windows and/or Linux) in physical or virtual format, including the interaction with Infrastructure at large (File shares with CIFS/SMB and NFS, secure LDAP integration, Public Key Certificates, Service accounts, API’s, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of implementing (applying/devising) Security hardening for hardware/devices, Operating Systems, Applications/middleware, including leveraging well-known frameworks (e.g., CIS guidelines), including the troubleshooting needed due to the consequences of hardening.

Desirable:

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in negotiation on technical level with different stake holders (e.g., ICT Security, Governance, Data Protection, ICT Operations/Solution teams, Project Management, etc.) and incorporating the results on the design deliverables.
  • Good knowledge in configuration of application servers to make usage of the different authentication systems, encryption in traffic, file access and database access. Ability to troubleshoot all of the mentioned components individually and as a set.

description:
PRODUCT MANAGER TRAINEESHIP


Become a Product Manager and Build Real-World Experience

Are you interested in developing successful products, working with cross-functional teams, and turning ideas into solutions that customers value? Do you want to gain practical experience while developing skills that are highly sought after by employers in technology and business?

We are offering a Product Manager Traineeship designed to help aspiring product professionals develop industry-relevant knowledge through structured learning and practical projects.

What You Will Learn

Throughout the traineeship, you will develop an understanding of:

  • Product Management Fundamentals

  • Product Lifecycle Management

  • Product Discovery and Validation

  • Customer Research and User Interviews

  • Market Research and Competitive Analysis

  • Product Strategy and Vision

  • Product Roadmapping

  • Requirements Gathering and Prioritisation

  • Writing User Stories and Acceptance Criteria

  • Agile and Scrum Methodologies

  • Stakeholder Management

  • Product Metrics and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Data-Driven Decision Making

  • Go-to-Market Planning

  • Product Launch and Iteration

  • AI Tools for Product Management

Practical Experience

You will work on realistic product management projects that may include:

  • Conducting customer and market research

  • Defining product requirements

  • Creating product roadmaps

  • Writing user stories and maintaining a product backlog

  • Prioritising features using industry frameworks

  • Producing product requirement documents (PRDs)

  • Analysing product performance metrics

  • Developing go-to-market strategies

  • Collaborating on simulated Agile product sprints

  • Portfolio projects demonstrating your product management capabilities

This practical experience will help you develop a professional portfolio that demonstrates your capabilities to future employers.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for individuals who:

  • Have an interest in business, technology, and innovation

  • Enjoy solving problems and making strategic decisions

  • Have strong communication and organisational skills

  • Are analytical and customer-focused

  • Are willing to learn new skills

  • Can work independently and manage their time effectively

  • Have basic computer skills

No previous Product Management experience is required. Successful applicants will undertake our paid Product Management training programme before progressing into employment. The cost of the training is the responsibility of the learner, and full guidance and support will be provided throughout the programme.

Benefits

  • Remote and flexible learning

  • Industry-relevant curriculum

  • Portfolio development opportunities

  • Practical project experience

  • Mentoring and personalised feedback

  • Career guidance and employability support

  • Opportunity to develop skills sought by modern employers

Entry Requirements

  • A good level of written English

  • Access to a computer and internet connection

  • Motivation to learn and develop professionally

Career Opportunities

Upon successful completion, learners may pursue roles such as:

  • Associate Product Manager

  • Junior Product Manager

  • Product Coordinator

  • Product Owner

  • Digital Product Executive

  • Product Analyst

  • Product Operations Coordinator

  • Innovation Associate

  • Product Development Coordinator

  • Technical Product Coordinator

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Product Management and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a rewarding career in Product Management.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations — you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.

title: Field Service Project Manager - Marine and Power
description:
NMS Recruit are seeking a Field Service Project Manager for a leading Global OEM in the Marine and Power Industry. You will be responsible for the day-to-day management and delivery of customer service orders, customer contracts, and LTSA's, including technical and commercial aspects for UK and overseas service orders and contracts for the Marine & Power Industry and On-Site Recovery business sectors. This role involves overseeing planning, execution, and invoicing to ensure successful delivery within budget, compliance, and customer satisfaction. The role is ideal for an existing Project Manager or a Field Service Engineer seeking a transition into Project Management.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities
Management of all aspects of customer field service orders (the contract) from planning through to final invoicing to ensure execution in line with the order/contract and managing all commercial requirements which includes but not limited to:

Managing Customers & Interfaces
  • Act as the first point of contact for customers regarding service orders, contracts, spares, repairs, and upgrades.
  • Ensure clear and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders throughout the contract lifecycle.
  • Attend customer site visits and commercial meetings as required to maintain relationships and ensure alignment.

Managing Enquiries & Quotations
  • Evaluate and assess initial enquiries, collaborating with internal teams.
  • Prepare detailed quotations, including tender approval documents with cost and margin considerations, delivery plans, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Present bids to customers positively and enthusiastically, ensuring alignment with business objectives.

Mobilising, Delivering & Maintaining Projects
  • Coordinate and manage all relevant activities between internal/external customers, sub-contractors, and field engineers.
  • Manage spare parts requirements and sub-contract supply for project activities.
  • Ensure projects are executed safely, on time, and within budget while adhering to company policies and regulatory requirements.

Improving Order Intake
  • Identify opportunities for emergent works and support growth strategies.
  • Work closely with customers to understand their needs and propose cost-effective solutions.

Internal Reporting
  • Maintain accurate records and manage orders on internal systems, currently C4S, FSM, SAP and Job Register.
  • Provide weekly and monthly reports on KPIs, forecasts, and financial performance to the Head of Field Service.
  • Support the upkeep of systems for order intake and revenue forecasting.

Managing Project Finances
  • Responsible for monitoring, analysing, and reporting the financial performance of all projects to ensure costs stay within approved budgets.
  • Support decision making by providing accurate and timely cost data and projects financial insights to Team Lead FS Contract Manager and Head of Field Service.

Key Responsibilities
Cost Monitoring & Reporting
  • Oversee cost management of orders to achieve agreed margins.
  • Track actual project and/or operational costs against budgets and forecasts.
  • Work closely with contracts managers and finance teams to validate cost estimates, identify deviations from plans and highlight cost risks and opportunities.
  • Prepare regular cost reports, variance analyses, and financial performance dashboards.
  • Maintain cost control tools, cost breakdown structures, and financial review data.

Governance & Compliance
  • Ensure adherence to internal financial policies and contract terms.
  • Maintain accurate cost records and audit ready documentation.

Risk & Issue Management
  • Identify and address risks/issues early in the contract lifecycle.
  • Maintain and update risk/issue registers with mitigation strategies.

Essential Experience
  • Engineering background with at least 5 years of related experience in field service for large industrial/marine mechanical equipment, or other related industries.
  • HND/Degree in a relevant engineering or technical field or comparable vocational education with significant work experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in order/contract management for field and customer service contracts.
  • Commercial awareness, including preparation of orders, contract terms, and invoicing.
  • Proficiency in engineering management systems such as SAP, C4S.
  • Microsoft Office suite.
  • Strong understanding of technical, commercial, and financial aspects of field service businesses.
  • Attention to details, with strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with the different stakeholders (e.g. CMs, Finance, Customers).

Desirable Experience
  • Experience in aftermarket services and sales.
  • Proficient in MS projects or other similar tools
  • Project management certifications (e.g., PRINCE2 or APMP) are desirable.

Other Key Aspects
  • Fluency in English
  • Clean UK Driving License + UK Passport
  • Willing and fit to travel within the UK and overseas to visit customer sites, commercial meetings etc.
  • No sponsorship available for this position.

Benefits
  • Salary up to £60,000 DOE
  • 28 days holiday plus bank holidays.
  • Birthday off
  • Pension scheme up to 18% combined after probation
  • Hybrid working 3 days office
  • Private Healthcare
  • Flexitime
  • Additional benefits


Important Information: We endeavour to process your personal data in a fair and transparent manner. In applying for this role, NMS Recruit will be acting within your interest and will contact you in relation to the role, either by email, phone or text message. For more information see our on our website. It is important you are aware of your individual rights and the provisions the company has put in place to protect your data. If you would like further information on the policy or GDPR please get in touch with us .

title: Head of Accounts
description:
Head of Accounts - £45,000 - £55,000 - Full-Time - St Ives, Cornwall

A fantastic opportunity has arisen for a finance professional to join a successful and well-established organisation as Head of Accounts. Reporting directly to the Financial Controller, this hands-on position will play a key role in the day-to-day running of the finance function, supporting accurate financial reporting, strong controls and continuous improvement across the department.

This role would suit a newly qualified, finalist or part-qualified accountant looking to take the next step in their career. Applications are also welcomed from experienced Finance Managers, Management Accountants, Senior Management Accountants and Assistant Finance Managers seeking greater responsibility and exposure across the finance function.

Responsibilities will include

* Oversee day-to-day accounting activities and support the smooth running of the finance function

* Support and develop finance colleagues whilst ensuring robust controls, procedures and reporting standards are maintained

* Manage month-end and year-end accounting activities, including balance sheet reconciliations and period-end reporting

* Prepare cash flow reports and provide meaningful commentary on financial performance and key variances

* Oversee payroll processes and coordinate cover arrangements when required

* Assist with audits, VAT returns and other compliance-related activities

* Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting, systems and operational efficiencies

* Support wider finance projects and work collaboratively with stakeholders across the business

You will have a minimum of five years' finance experience and be newly qualified, part-qualified or actively studying towards ACCA, CIMA, ACA or an equivalent qualification. Alongside strong financial accounting experience, you will have previous experience overseeing payroll processes and be comfortable providing payroll support when required. Study support is available for candidates currently working towards a professional qualification.

Strong Excel skills are essential, together with experience of Sage 200 Professional or a similar accounting system. You will be confident building relationships across the business, supporting colleagues and identifying opportunities to improve processes and reporting. Exposure to AI tools or technology-driven improvements would be advantageous.

Reporting to the Financial Controller, you will join an experienced finance team comprising specialists across payroll, purchase ledger, fleet administration, subsidiary company accounting, expenses and cashbook management.

This is a site-based role and would suit someone who enjoys working closely with colleagues in a collaborative environment. Whilst the organisation is keen to appoint as soon as possible, they are prepared to wait for the right individual.

For more information please get in touch with Elle Benjamin quoting reference EB11281.

title: Transaction Monitoring & Screening Data Analyst
description:
At M&G our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. As an international savings and investments business with roots stretching back more than 170 years, we offer a range of financial products and services through Asset Management, Life and Wealth. All three operating segments work together to deliver attractive financial outcomes for our clients, and superior shareholder returns.


Through our behaviours of telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.

AMS is a global workforce solutions partner committed to creating inclusive, dynamic, and future-ready workplaces. We help organisations adapt, grow, and thrive in an ever-evolving world by building, shaping, and optimising diverse talent strategies.

We partner with M&G to support their contingent recruitment processes. Acting as an extension of their recruitment teams, we connect them with skilled interim and temporary professionals, fostering workplaces where everyone can contribute and succeed.

On behalf of M&G, AMS are looking for a Transaction Monitoring & Screening Data Analyst, for a 6 month contract.Based inEdinburgh (preferred) or London, hybrid with 2 days per weekrequired on-site.

We will consider flexible working arrangements for any of our roles and also offer workplace accommodations to ensure you have what you need to effectively deliver in your role.

Purpose of the role

We're looking for a Transaction Monitoring & Screening Data Analyst to join a Financial Crime team, supporting the analysis and validation of transaction monitoring and screening data. You'll help ensure the data behind monitoring rules is accurate, complete and fit for purpose, while producing clear reporting and insight to support rule reviews and wider control effectiveness.

What you'll do

  • Analyse transaction monitoring and screening data to support rule validation and testing.
  • Review data quality, identify anomalies, gaps and inconsistencies, and support root cause analysis.
  • Support rule testing by analysing outputs, alert volumes, false positives and unexpected results.
  • Create and maintain Power BI dashboards and reporting to support monitoring assessments.
  • Assist the Data Scientist / Rule Validation Specialist with analysis, testing evidence and documentation.
  • Support data mapping, reconciliation and validation activities.
  • Present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

The Skills you'll need

  • Strong data analysis and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong Power BI experience.
  • Experience working with large and complex datasets.
  • Strong SQL / data interrogation capability.
  • Experience of data quality assessment, validation and reporting.
  • Financial Services experience, ideally within Financial Crime, AML, Transaction Monitoring or Screening.
  • Transaction Monitoring experience would be a strong advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to communicate analytical findings clearly.

Why M&G

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G plc, underpinned by our policies and our employee-led networks who provide networking opportunities, advice and support for the diverse communities our colleagues represent. Regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.
